import os
import json

# Path to the input JSON file
input_file = './code.json'  # or code.txt if that's the correct file

# Get the current working directory
base_dir = os.getcwd()

# Read and parse the JSON
with open(input_file, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# Create files and directories based on JSON structure
for relative_path, file_info in data.items():
    if not file_info.get("active", False):
        continue

    # Strip leading slashes to avoid writing to root
    relative_path = relative_path.lstrip("/")

    # Construct full file path
    file_path = os.path.join(base_dir, relative_path)

    # Get the code content
    code_content = file_info.get("code", "")

    # Ensure the directory exists
    dir_path = os.path.dirname(file_path)
    if dir_path:
        os.makedirs(dir_path, exist_ok=True)

    # Write the file
    with open(file_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(code_content)

    print(f"Created: {file_path}")

<file path="/lib/auth.js">
import Cookies from 'js-cookie';

const ADMIN_EMAIL = 'admin@example.com';
const ADMIN_PASSWORD = 'admin123'; // In a real app, this would be securely stored

export const login = async (email, password) => {
  // Simple mock login
  if (email === ADMIN_EMAIL && password === ADMIN_PASSWORD) {
    const user = {
      id: '1',
      email: email,
      role: 'admin'
    };
    
    // Store user in cookie
    Cookies.set('user', JSON.stringify(user), { expires: 7 });
    return user;
  }
  
  throw new Error('Invalid email or password');
};

export const logout = async () => {
  Cookies.remove('user');
};

export const getUser = async () => {
  const userCookie = Cookies.get('user');
  
  if (!userCookie) {
    return null;
  }
  
  try {
    const user = JSON.parse(userCookie);
    return user.role === 'admin' ? user : null;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error parsing user cookie:', error);
    return null;
  }
};

export const isAuthenticated = async () => {
  const user = await getUser();
  return user !== null && user.role === 'admin';
};

export const withAuth = (gssp) => {
  return async (context) => {
    // Check if user is authenticated and is admin
    const cookies = context.req.headers.cookie || '';
    let isAuth = false;
    
    // Manually parse cookies to find user
    if (cookies.includes('user=')) {
      try {
        const userCookieStr = cookies
          .split('; ')
          .find(row => row.startsWith('user='))
          .split('=')[1];
        
        const user = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(userCookieStr));
        isAuth = user && user.role === 'admin';
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error parsing user from cookies:', error);
      }
    }
    
    if (!isAuth) {
      // Redirect to login page if not authenticated
      return {
        redirect: {
          destination: '/login',
          permanent: false,
        },
      };
    }
    
    // If there is a gssp function, call it
    return gssp ? await gssp(context) : { props: {} };
  };
};

import { Button } from '../components/Button';
import { Label } from '../components/Label';

export default function Login() {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    email: '',
    password: ''
  });
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const router = useRouter();

  useEffect(() => {
    // Check if user is already logged in
    const checkSession = async () => {
      const authStatus = await isAuthenticated();
      if (authStatus) {
        router.push('/');
      }
    };
    
    checkSession();
  }, [router]);

  const handleChange = (e) => {
    const { name, value } = e.target;
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: value }));
    // Clear error when user starts typing
    if (error) setError('');
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsLoading(true);
    setError('');

    try {
      // Validate inputs
      if (!formData.email || !formData.password) {
        throw new Error('Please fill in all fields');
      }

      // Attempt to sign in
      await login(formData.email, formData.password);
      toast.success('Login successful!');
      router.push('/');
      
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message);
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-gray-50">
      <div className="w-full max-w-4xl grid md:grid-cols-2 shadow-xl rounded-xl overflow-hidden">

              alt="Office desk with computer"
              layout="fill"
              objectFit="cover"
              className="mix-blend-overlay opacity-20"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col justify-center p-12 text-white h-full">
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-4">TericSoft HR</h1>
            <p className="mb-6">
              Streamline your HR operations with our comprehensive management solution.
            </p>
            <ul className="space-y-2">
              <li className="flex items-center">
                <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-white mr-2"></span>
                Manage departments efficiently
              </li>
              <li className="flex items-center">
                <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-white mr-2"></span>
                Track employee information
              </li>
              <li className="flex items-center">
                <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-white mr-2"></span>
                Organize team structures
              </li>
            </ul>

                {error}

<file path="/pages/_app.js">
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/router';
import { ToastContainer } from 'react-toastify';
import 'react-toastify/dist/ReactToastify.css';
import '../styles/globals.css';
import Layout from '../components/Layout';
import { isAuthenticated } from '../lib/auth';

function MyApp({ Component, pageProps }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);
  const [isLoggedIn, setIsLoggedIn] = useState(false);
  
  useEffect(() => {
    const checkAuth = async () => {
      const authenticated = await isAuthenticated();
      setIsLoggedIn(authenticated);
      setLoaded(true);
      
      // Redirect to login if not authenticated and not already on login page
      if (!authenticated && router.pathname !== '/login') {
        router.push('/login');
      }
    };
    
    checkAuth();
  }, [router]);

  if (!loaded) {
    return null;
  }

  // For login page, don't show the layout
  if (router.pathname === '/login') {
    return (
      <>
        <Component {...pageProps} />
        <ToastContainer 
          position="top-right"
          autoClose={3000}
          hideProgressBar={false}
          newestOnTop
          closeOnClick
          rtl={false}
          pauseOnFocusLoss
          draggable
          pauseOnHover
        />
      </>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <Layout>
        <Component {...pageProps} />
      </Layout>
      <ToastContainer 
        position="top-right"
        autoClose={3000}
        hideProgressBar={false}
        newestOnTop
        closeOnClick
        rtl={false}
        pauseOnFocusLoss
        draggable
        pauseOnHover
      />
    </>
  );
}

export default MyApp;

-- Create tables for HR Management Application
-- Author: TericSoft HR Admin
-- Created: 2023-12-15

-- create extensions
create extension if not exists "uuid-ossp";

-- create departments table
create table if not exists departments (
  id text primary key,
  name text not null,
  "teamLeadId" text,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default now(),
  updated_at timestamp with time zone default now()
);

-- create employees table
create table if not exists employees (
  id text primary key,
  name text not null,
  email text not null,
  "phoneNumber" text not null,
  designation text not null,
  "departmentId" text references departments(id) on delete set null,
  "jobRole" text not null default 'employee',
  created_at timestamp with time zone default now(),
  updated_at timestamp with time zone default now()
);

-- add foreign key from departments to employees
do $$
begin
  if not exists (
    select 1 
    from information_schema.table_constraints 
    where constraint_name = 'fk_team_lead' 
    and table_name = 'departments'
  ) then
    alter table departments add constraint fk_team_lead
      foreign key ("teamLeadId") references employees(id) on delete set null;
  end if;
end $$;

-- create projects table
create table if not exists projects (
  id text primary key,
  name text not null,
  "startMonth" text not null,
  "startYear" text not null,
  status text not null default 'active',
  "projectManagerId" text references employees(id) on delete set null,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default now(),
  updated_at timestamp with time zone default now()
);

-- create project_members junction table
create table if not exists project_members (
  id uuid primary key default uuid_generate_v4(),
  project_id text not null references projects(id) on delete cascade,
  employee_id text not null references employees(id) on delete cascade,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default now(),
  updated_at timestamp with time zone default now(),
  unique(project_id, employee_id)
);

-- create project_allocations table
create table if not exists project_allocations (
  id text primary key,
  "projectId" text not null references projects(id) on delete cascade,
  month text not null,
  year text not null,
  "projectManagerId" text references employees(id) on delete set null,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default now(),
  updated_at timestamp with time zone default now(),
  unique("projectId", month, year)
);

-- create allocation_members junction table
create table if not exists allocation_members (
  id uuid primary key default uuid_generate_v4(),
  allocation_id text not null references project_allocations(id) on delete cascade,
  employee_id text not null references employees(id) on delete cascade,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default now(),
  updated_at timestamp with time zone default now(),
  unique(allocation_id, employee_id)
);

-- create form frequency enum
create type form_frequency as enum ('once', 'daily', 'weekly', 'biweekly', 'monthly', 'quarterly', 'yearly');

-- create form status enum
create type form_status as enum ('draft', 'published', 'archived');

-- create audience type enum
create type audience_type as enum ('employee', 'team_lead', 'project_manager', 'all');

-- create question type enum
create type question_type as enum (
  'short_text', 
  'long_text', 
  'multiple_choice', 
  'checkbox', 
  'dropdown', 
  'linear_scale', 
  'date', 
  'time'
);

-- create score_forms table
create table if not exists score_forms (
  id uuid primary key default uuid_generate_v4(),
  title text not null,
  description text,
  frequency form_frequency not null default 'once',
  audience audience_type not null default 'all',
  status form_status not null default 'draft',
  created_by uuid references auth.users(id) on delete set null,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default now(),
  updated_at timestamp with time zone default now(),
  published_at timestamp with time zone
);

-- create form_questions table
create table if not exists form_questions (
  id uuid primary key default uuid_generate_v4(),
  form_id uuid not null references score_forms(id) on delete cascade,
  question_text text not null,
  question_type question_type not null default 'short_text',
  is_required boolean not null default false,
  order_number integer not null default 0,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default now(),
  updated_at timestamp with time zone default now()
);

-- create question_options table
create table if not exists question_options (
  id uuid primary key default uuid_generate_v4(),
  question_id uuid not null references form_questions(id) on delete cascade,
  option_text text not null,
  order_number integer not null default 0,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default now(),
  updated_at timestamp with time zone default now()
);

-- create form_responses table
create table if not exists form_responses (
  id uuid primary key default uuid_generate_v4(),
  form_id uuid not null references score_forms(id) on delete cascade,
  respondent_id uuid references auth.users(id) on delete set null,
  started_at timestamp with time zone default now(),
  submitted_at timestamp with time zone,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default now(),
  updated_at timestamp with time zone default now()
);

-- create question_answers table
create table if not exists question_answers (
  id uuid primary key default uuid_generate_v4(),
  response_id uuid not null references form_responses(id) on delete cascade,
  question_id uuid not null references form_questions(id) on delete cascade,
  answer_text text,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default now(),
  updated_at timestamp with time zone default now()
);

-- create updated_at trigger function
create or replace function update_modified_column()
returns trigger as $$
begin
  new.updated_at = now();
  return new;
end;
$$ language plpgsql;

-- create triggers for all tables with updated_at column
create trigger update_departments_modified
before update on departments
for each row execute function update_modified_column();

create trigger update_employees_modified
before update on employees
for each row execute function update_modified_column();

create trigger update_projects_modified

for each row execute function update_modified_column();

create trigger update_project_members_modified
before update on project_members
for each row execute function update_modified_column();

create trigger update_project_allocations_modified
before update on project_allocations

for each row execute function update_modified_column();

before update on question_options

File: doc.txt

1. Core Functionality & Modules:

Dashboard (/pages/index.js): Provides an overview with key statistics (total employees, departments, projects), department distribution, recently added employees, and quick links to common actions.

Employee Management (/pages/employees/*):

Listing, adding, viewing, and editing employee details.

Includes information like name, email, phone, designation, department, and job role.

EmployeeCard.js is used for displaying individual employee summaries.

Department Management (/pages/departments/*):

Listing, adding, viewing, and editing departments.

Supports assigning multiple team leads to a department.

Shows member counts and team lead information.

DepartmentCard.js for department summaries.

Project Management (/pages/projects/*):

Listing, adding, viewing, and editing projects.

Includes project name, start month/year, status, and project manager.

Manages project members.

ProjectCard.js for project summaries.

Project Allocations (/pages/projects/allocations/*):

Manages monthly resource allocation for projects.

Allows creating new allocations, viewing existing ones, and assigning members and a project manager for specific months.

Includes functionality to copy allocations from a previous month.

Forms/Score Builder (/pages/forms/*):

A system for creating, managing, and viewing dynamic forms (e.g., performance reviews, feedback forms).

Users can define form details (title, description, frequency, audience) and add various types of questions (short text, multiple choice, linear scale, etc.).

Includes a preview mode for forms.

Functionality for setting up scoring for forms (/forms/[id]/scoreSettings.js) by defining categories and assigning scores/weights to questions.

Reports (/pages/reports/*):

Displays submitted form reports/scores.

Allows filtering reports by various criteria (department, employee, form, month, year, status).

Provides detailed views of individual reports (/reports/view/[id].js), including answers, scores, and reviewer feedback.

Admins/Team Leads can edit/review scores.

Analytics (/pages/analytics/*):

Presents a dashboard with visual analytics (bar charts, donut charts) for employee distribution, project allocation, and monthly trends.

Allows filtering by year.

User Profile (/pages/profile/index.js):

Allows logged-in users to view their own profile information.

2. Data Management:

Mock Data (lib/mockData.js, lib/data.js): The application primarily uses in-memory mock data for all its entities (departments, employees, projects, allocations). The lib/data.js file contains functions to get, add, update, and delete this mock data.

Supabase Integration (Intended/Partial):

lib/supabase-client.js and .env.local suggest an intended integration with Supabase for persistent data storage.

SQL files (db-setup.sql, lib/database-migration.sql, lib/database-migrations.sql, lib/db-migration.sql) define the database schema for PostgreSQL (which Supabase uses), including tables for departments, employees, projects, allocations, forms, questions, submissions, and user profiles.

Some pages (e.g., /reports/index.js, /forms/[id]/scoreSettings.js) have conditional logic to use Supabase if configured, otherwise falling back to mock data or limited functionality.

The database schema includes support for multiple team leads per department, various form types, and user roles for access control.

3. Authentication & Authorization (lib/auth.js):

Login (/pages/login.js): A dedicated login page.

Cookie-based Sessions: Uses js-cookie to store user session information.

Roles: Defines user roles: admin, employee, team_lead, project_manager.

admin@tericsoft.com (password: admin123) is a hardcoded admin.

Other users' roles are determined based on their email and job role in the mock data (e.g., if an employee is a team lead in mockDepartmentTeamLeads or has jobRole: 'project_manager').

Route Protection (/pages/_app.js):

Redirects unauthenticated users to the login page.

Implements basic page-level access control based on user roles, redirecting to /unauthorized.js if access is denied.

Permission Checks: lib/auth.js contains functions like canViewEmployee, canViewDepartment, canViewProject, canViewReport to perform more granular permission checks within pages/components.

4. UI & Styling:

Tailwind CSS: Used for styling, configured in tailwind.config.js and styles/globals.css. Custom primary colors and animations are defined.

Reusable Components (/components/*):

Layout.js: Main application layout with navigation (sidebar/header) and footer. Navigation links adapt based on user roles.

Button.js, Card.js, Input.js, Select.js, Label.js, Modal.js, Avatar.js, EmptyState.js: Common UI elements.

Entity-specific cards: DepartmentCard.js, EmployeeCard.js, ProjectCard.js, DashboardCard.js.

Icons: Uses react-icons (specifically Fi icons from Feather Icons) and lucide-react.

User Experience:

Toast notifications (react-toastify) for user feedback.

Modals for confirmations (e.g., delete operations) and adding related entities.

Empty states for when no data is available.

Fade-in/slide-in animations for page elements.

5. Technology Stack:

Frontend: Next.js (React framework)

Styling: Tailwind CSS

State Management: Primarily React's built-in state (useState, useEffect), no dedicated state management library like Redux or Zustand is explicitly used in the provided files.

Data (Current): In-memory JavaScript arrays (mock data).

Data (Intended): Supabase (PostgreSQL).

Forms: react-hook-form is listed as a dependency, but its usage is not prominent in the provided page files; direct state management is more common for forms.

Utilities: clsx, tailwind-merge, class-variance-authority for managing CSS classes. uuid for generating unique IDs. js-cookie for client-side cookies.

6. Configuration:

next.config.js: Basic Next.js configuration, including image domains.

postcss.config.js, tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS setup.

.env.local: Environment variables, primarily for Supabase credentials (currently placeholders).

// Department functions
export const getDepartments = () => {
  return [...departments];
};

export const getDepartmentById = (id) => {
  return departments.find(dept => dept.id === id) || null;
};

export const addDepartment = (departmentData) => {
  const newDepartment = {
    id: `dept-${uuidv4()}`,
    ...departmentData
  };
  
  departments.push(newDepartment);
  return newDepartment;
};

export const updateDepartment = (id, departmentData) => {
  const index = departments.findIndex(dept => dept.id === id);
  if (index === -1) return null;
  
  departments[index] = { ...departments[index], ...departmentData };
  return departments[index];
};

export const deleteDepartment = (id) => {
  const index = departments.findIndex(dept => dept.id === id);
  if (index === -1) return false;
  
  // First update any employees in this department
  employees = employees.map(emp => {
    if (emp.departmentId === id) {
      return { ...emp, departmentId: null };
    }
    return emp;
  });
  
  // Then delete the department
  departments = departments.filter(dept => dept.id !== id);
  return true;
};

export const getDepartmentMembers = (departmentId) => {
  return employees.filter(emp => emp.departmentId === departmentId);
};

export const getDepartmentTeamLead = (departmentId) => {
  const department = departments.find(dept => dept.id === departmentId);
  if (!department || !department.teamLeadId) return null;
  
  return employees.find(emp => emp.id === department.teamLeadId) || null;
};

// Employee functions
export const getEmployees = () => {
  return [...employees];
};

export const getEmployeeById = (id) => {
  return employees.find(emp => emp.id === id) || null;
};

export const addEmployee = (employeeData) => {
  const newEmployee = {
    id: `emp-${uuidv4()}`,
    ...employeeData
  };
  
  employees.push(newEmployee);
  return newEmployee;
};

export const updateEmployee = (id, employeeData) => {
  const index = employees.findIndex(emp => emp.id === id);
  if (index === -1) return null;
  
  employees[index] = { ...employees[index], ...employeeData };
  return employees[index];
};

export const deleteEmployee = (id) => {
  const index = employees.findIndex(emp => emp.id === id);
  if (index === -1) return false;

  // Update any departments where this employee is the team lead
  departments = departments.map(dept => {
    if (dept.teamLeadId === id) {
      return { ...dept, teamLeadId: null };
    }
    return dept;
  });
  
  employees = employees.filter(emp => emp.id !== id);
  return true;
};

// Auth functions
export const authenticateUser = (email, password) => {
  const user = users.find(user => user.email === email && user.password === password);
  if (!user) return null;
  
  // Don't return the password
  const { password: _, ...userWithoutPassword } = user;
  return userWithoutPassword;
};

<file path="/lib/auth.js">
import Cookies from 'js-cookie';
import { authenticateUser } from './data';

export const login = (email, password) => {
  const user = authenticateUser(email, password);
  
  if (user) {
    // In a real app, you'd use a JWT or similar token
    // For demo purposes, just save the user info
    Cookies.set('user', JSON.stringify(user), { expires: 1 }); // 1 day
    return true;
  }
  
  return false;
};

export const logout = () => {
  Cookies.remove('user');
};

export const getUser = () => {
  const userCookie = Cookies.get('user');
  return userCookie ? JSON.parse(userCookie) : null;
};

export const isAuthenticated = () => {
  return !!getUser();
};

export const withAuth = (gssp) => {
  return async (context) => {
    const { req, res } = context;
    
    // Get the user cookie from the request
    const cookies = req?.headers?.cookie;
    let isAuthenticated = false;
    
    if (cookies) {
      const userCookie = cookies.split(';').find(c => c.trim().startsWith('user='));
      isAuthenticated = !!userCookie;
    }
    
    // If not authenticated, redirect to login
    if (!isAuthenticated) {
      return {
        redirect: {
          destination: '/login',
          permanent: false,
        },
      };
    }
    
    // If there is a gssp function, call it
    return gssp ? await gssp(context) : { props: {} };
  };
};
</file>

<file path="/components/Button.js">
import { forwardRef } from 'react';
import { cva } from 'class-variance-authority';
import { cn } from '../lib/utils';

const buttonVariants = cva(
  'inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md font-medium transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:pointer-events-none',
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: 'bg-primary-600 text-white hover:bg-primary-700 focus:ring-primary-500',
        destructive: 'bg-red-600 text-white hover:bg-red-700 focus:ring-red-500',
        outline: 'border border-gray-300 bg-transparent hover:bg-gray-100 focus:ring-gray-500',
        subtle: 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-200 focus:ring-gray-500',
        ghost: 'bg-transparent hover:bg-gray-100 focus:ring-gray-500',
        link: 'bg-transparent underline-offset-4 hover:underline text-primary-600 hover:bg-transparent',
      },
      size: {
        default: 'h-10 py-2 px-4',
        sm: 'h-8 px-3 rounded-md text-sm',
        lg: 'h-12 px-8 rounded-md text-lg',
        icon: 'h-10 w-10',
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: 'default',
      size: 'default',
    },
  }
);

const Button = forwardRef(({ 
  className, 
  variant, 
  size, 
  children,
  ...props 
}, ref) => {
  return (
    <button
      className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size, className }))}
      ref={ref}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
});

Button.displayName = 'Button';

export { Button, buttonVariants };

}

  return (
    <div
      className={cn("flex flex-col space-y-1.5 p-6", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
};

      className={cn(
        "text-2xl font-semibold leading-none tracking-tight",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );

      className={cn("text-sm text-gray-500", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
};

Card.Content = function CardContent({ className, ...props }) {

      className={cn("flex items-center p-6 pt-0", className)}

    />

<file path="/components/Modal.js">
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { FiX } from 'react-icons/fi';
import { Button } from './Button';

export function Modal({ 
  isOpen, 
  onClose, 
  title, 
  description, 
  children, 
  footer 
}) {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
    
    if (isOpen) {
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    }
    
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    };
  }, [isOpen]);

  const handleBackdropClick = useCallback((e) => {
    if (e.target === e.currentTarget) {
      onClose();
    }
  }, [onClose]);

  const handleEscape = useCallback((e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      onClose();
    }
  }, [onClose]);

  useEffect(() => {
    document.addEventListener('keydown', handleEscape);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleEscape);
    };
  }, [handleEscape]);

  if (!mounted || !isOpen) return null;

  return createPortal(
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 z-50"
      onClick={handleBackdropClick}
    >
      <div 
        className="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-xl w-full max-w-md max-h-[90vh] overflow-hidden scale-in"
        onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center p-6 border-b">
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold">{title}</h2>
            {description && (
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">{description}</p>
            )}
          </div>
          <Button 
            variant="ghost" 
            size="icon" 
            onClick={onClose}
            className="h-8 w-8 rounded-full"
            aria-label="Close"
          >
            <FiX />
          </Button>
        </div>
        
        <div className="p-6 overflow-y-auto max-h-[60vh]">
          {children}
        </div>
        
        {footer && (
          <div className="p-6 border-t flex justify-end space-x-2">
            {footer}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>,
    document.body
  );
}
</file>

<file path="/components/Avatar.js">
import Image from 'next/image';
import { cn } from '../lib/utils';

export function Avatar({ 
  src = null, 
  alt = "Avatar", 
  size = "md", 
  className,
  fallback,
  ...props 
}) {
  const sizeClass = {
    sm: "h-8 w-8",
    md: "h-10 w-10",
    lg: "h-12 w-12",
    xl: "h-16 w-16"
  };

  // Fallback to initials if no image
  const getInitials = () => {
    if (!fallback) return "?";
    return fallback.split(" ").map(name => name[0]).join("").toUpperCase();
  };

  return (
    <div 
      className={cn(
        "relative rounded-full overflow-hidden bg-gray-200 flex items-center justify-center text-gray-600 font-medium",
        sizeClass[size],
        className
      )} 
      {...props}
    >
      {src ? (
        <Image 
          src={src} 
          alt={alt} 
          layout="fill" 
          objectFit="cover"
          className="transition-opacity duration-300 hover:opacity-90"
        />
      ) : (
        <span className="text-xs">{getInitials()}</span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="/lib/utils.js">
import { clsx } from 'clsx';
import { twMerge } from 'tailwind-merge';

export function cn(...inputs) {
  return twMerge(clsx(inputs));
}

export function formatDate(date) {
  return new Date(date).toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
    month: 'short',
    day: 'numeric',
    year: 'numeric'
  });
}

export function getRandomColor() {
  const colors = [
    'bg-red-100 text-red-800',
    'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800',
    'bg-green-100 text-green-800',
    'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800',
    'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800',
    'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800',
    'bg-pink-100 text-pink-800'
  ];
  
  return colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)];
}

<file path="/pages/_app.js">
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/router';
import { ToastContainer } from 'react-toastify';
import 'react-toastify/dist/ReactToastify.css';
import '../styles/globals.css';
import Layout from '../components/Layout';
import { isAuthenticated } from '../lib/auth';

function MyApp({ Component, pageProps }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  
  useEffect(() => {
    // Check authentication on route change
    const handleRouteChange = (url) => {
      // Skip auth check for login page
      if (url === '/login') return;
      
      if (!isAuthenticated()) {
        router.push('/login');
      }
    };

    // Initial auth check
    if (router.pathname !== '/login' && !isAuthenticated()) {
      router.push('/login');
    }
    
    router.events.on('routeChangeStart', handleRouteChange);
    
    return () => {
      router.events.off('routeChangeStart', handleRouteChange);
    };
  }, [router]);

  return (
    <>
      <Layout>
        <Component {...pageProps} />
      </Layout>
      <ToastContainer 
        position="top-right"
        autoClose={3000}
        hideProgressBar={false}
        newestOnTop
        closeOnClick
        rtl={false}
        pauseOnFocusLoss
        draggable
        pauseOnHover
      />
    </>
  );
}

export default MyApp;
</file>

  });

<file path="/pages/login.js">
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/router';
import Image from 'next/image';
import { FiLock, FiMail, FiAlertCircle } from 'react-icons/fi';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { login } from '../lib/auth';
import { Card } from '../components/Card';
import { Input } from '../components/Input';
import { Button } from '../components/Button';
import { Label } from '../components/Label';

export default function Login() {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    email: '',
    password: ''
  });
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const router = useRouter();

  const handleChange = (e) => {
    const { name, value } = e.target;
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: value }));
    // Clear error when user starts typing
    if (error) setError('');
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsLoading(true);
    setError('');

    try {
      // Simple validation
      if (!formData.email || !formData.password) {
        throw new Error('Please enter both email and password');
      }

      // Call login function
      const success = login(formData.email, formData.password);
      
      if (success) {
        toast.success('Login successful!');
        router.push('/');
      } else {
        throw new Error('Invalid email or password');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message);
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (

<file path="/pages/departments/index.js">
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { FiFolderPlus, FiSearch } from 'react-icons/fi';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { 
  getDepartments, 
  getDepartmentMembers, 
  getDepartmentTeamLead,
  deleteDepartment
} from '../../lib/data';
import { Button } from '../../components/Button';
import { Input } from '../../components/Input';
import { DepartmentCard } from '../../components/DepartmentCard';
import { EmptyState } from '../../components/EmptyState';
import { Modal } from '../../components/Modal';

export default function Departments() {
  const [departments, setDepartments] = useState([]);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [isDeleteModalOpen, setIsDeleteModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [departmentToDelete, setDepartmentToDelete] = useState(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadDepartments();
  }, []);

  const loadDepartments = () => {
    try {
      const deptData = getDepartments();
      
      // Enhance with member count and team lead data
      const enhancedDepts = deptData.map(dept => {
        const memberCount = getDepartmentMembers(dept.id).length;
        const teamLead = getDepartmentTeamLead(dept.id);
        
        return {
          ...dept,
          memberCount,
          teamLead
        };
      });
      
      setDepartments(enhancedDepts);
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to load departments');
      console.error(error);
    }
  };

  const handleSearchChange = (e) => {
    setSearchQuery(e.target.value);
  };

  const handleDeleteClick = (department) => {
    setDepartmentToDelete(department);
    setIsDeleteModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleEditClick = (department) => {
    // Navigate to edit page
    window.location.href = `/departments/${department.id}/edit`;
  };

  const confirmDelete = async () => {
    if (!departmentToDelete) return;
    
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const success = deleteDepartment(departmentToDelete.id);
      
      if (success) {
        toast.success(`${departmentToDelete.name} has been deleted`);
        loadDepartments();
      } else {
        toast.error('Failed to delete department');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('An error occurred while deleting');
      console.error(error);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
      setIsDeleteModalOpen(false);
      setDepartmentToDelete(null);
    }
  };

  // Filter departments based on search
  const filteredDepartments = departments.filter(dept =>
    dept.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase())
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 fade-in">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">Departments</h1>
        <Link href="/departments/new">
          <a>
            <Button className="w-full sm:w-auto flex items-center justify-center">
              <FiFolderPlus className="mr-2" />
              Add Department
            </Button>
          </a>
        </Link>
      </div>

      {/* Search */}
      <div className="relative">
        <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-gray-400">
          <FiSearch />
        </div>
        <Input
          type="text"
          placeholder="Search departments..."
          value={searchQuery}
          onChange={handleSearchChange}
          className="pl-10"
        />
      </div>

      {/* Department Grid */}
      {departments.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState 
          title="No departments yet"
          description="Get started by creating your first department"
          action={() => window.location.href = '/departments/new'}
        />
      ) : filteredDepartments.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState 
          title="No matching departments"
          description="Try a different search term"
          action={() => setSearchQuery('')}
          actionText="Clear Search"
        />
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          {filteredDepartments.map((dept) => (
            <DepartmentCard
              key={dept.id}
              department={dept}
              memberCount={dept.memberCount}
              teamLead={dept.teamLead}
              onEdit={handleEditClick}
              onDelete={handleDeleteClick}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Delete Confirmation Modal */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={isDeleteModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsDeleteModalOpen(false)}
        title="Delete Department"
        description="Are you sure you want to delete this department? This action cannot be undone."
        footer={
          <>
            <Button 
              variant="outline" 
              onClick={() => setIsDeleteModalOpen(false)}
              disabled={isLoading}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button 
              variant="destructive" 
              onClick={confirmDelete}
              disabled={isLoading}
            >
              {isLoading ? 'Deleting...' : 'Delete'}
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        {departmentToDelete && (
          <div className="text-sm text-gray-500">
            <p>
              This will permanently delete the department 
              <span className="font-semibold text-gray-700"> {departmentToDelete.name} </span>
              and remove all department associations from employees.
            </p>
            <p className="mt-2">
              The employees will not be deleted, but they will no longer be associated with this department.
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="/pages/departments/new.js">
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/router';
import { FiArrowLeft, FiSave } from 'react-icons/fi';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { addDepartment, getEmployees } from '../../lib/data';
import { Button } from '../../components/Button';
import { Input } from '../../components/Input';
import { Select } from '../../components/Select';
import { Label } from '../../components/Label';
import { Card } from '../../components/Card';

export default function NewDepartment() {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: '',
    teamLeadId: ''
  });
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [employees, setEmployees] = useState([]);
  const router = useRouter();

  // Load employees for team lead selection
  useState(() => {
    try {
      const employeeData = getEmployees();
      setEmployees(employeeData);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to load employees:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to load employees');
    }
  }, []);

  const validateForm = () => {
    const newErrors = {};
    
    if (!formData.name.trim()) {
      newErrors.name = 'Department name is required';
    }
    
    setErrors(newErrors);
    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;
  };

  const handleChange = (e) => {
    const { name, value } = e.target;
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: value }));
    
    // Clear error when field is edited
    if (errors[name]) {
      setErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: undefined }));
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if (!validateForm()) return;
    
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const newDepartment = addDepartment(formData);
      
      toast.success(`Department "${newDepartment.name}" has been created`);
      router.push('/departments');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to create department:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to create department');
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto fade-in">
      <div className="mb-6">
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          onClick={() => router.push('/departments')}
          className="mb-2"
        >
          <FiArrowLeft className="mr-2" />
          Back to Departments
        </Button>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">Create New Department</h1>
      </div>

      <Card>
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
          <Card.Content className="space-y-6">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="name">
                Department Name <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="name"
                name="name"
                value={formData.name}
                onChange={handleChange}
                placeholder="e.g. Engineering, Marketing, HR"
                className={errors.name ? 'border-red-500' : ''}
              />
              {errors.name && (
                <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-1">{errors.name}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="teamLeadId">Team Lead</Label>
              <Select
                id="teamLeadId"
                name="teamLeadId"
                value={formData.teamLeadId}
                onChange={handleChange}
              >
                <option value="">-- Select Team Lead (Optional) --</option>
                {employees.map(emp => (
                  <option key={emp.id} value={emp.id}>
                    {emp.name} - {emp.designation}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </Select>
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">
                You can assign a team lead now or update it later.
              </p>
            </div>
          </Card.Content>

          <Card.Footer className="flex justify-end space-x-2 border-t pt-6">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => router.push('/departments')}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="submit"
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              className="flex items-center"
            >
              <FiSave className="mr-2" />
              {isSubmitting ? 'Creating...' : 'Create Department'}
            </Button>
          </Card.Footer>
        </form>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/router';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { 
  FiArrowLeft, FiEdit, FiTrash2, FiPlus, 
  FiUsers, FiUser, FiMail, FiPhone, FiBriefcase 
} from 'react-icons/fi';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { 
  getDepartmentById, 
  getDepartmentMembers, 
  getDepartmentTeamLead,
  deleteDepartment
} from '../../../lib/data';
import { Button } from '../../../components/Button';
import { Card } from '../../../components/Card';
import { Avatar } from '../../../components/Avatar';
import { Modal } from '../../../components/Modal';
import { EmptyState } from '../../../components/EmptyState';

export default function DepartmentDetails() {
  const [department, setDepartment] = useState(null);
  const [members, setMembers] = useState([]);
  const [teamLead, setTeamLead] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isDeleteModalOpen, setIsDeleteModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isDeleting, setIsDeleting] = useState(false);
  const router = useRouter();
  const { id } = router.query;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (id) {
      loadDepartmentData();
    }
  }, [id]);

  const loadDepartmentData = () => {
    try {
      const deptData = getDepartmentById(id);
      
      if (!deptData) {
        toast.error('Department not found');
        router.push('/departments');
        return;
      }
      
      const memberData = getDepartmentMembers(id);
      const leadData = getDepartmentTeamLead(id);
      
      setDepartment(deptData);
      setMembers(memberData);
      setTeamLead(leadData);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to load department data:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to load department data');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    setIsDeleting(true);
    
    try {
      const success = deleteDepartment(id);
      
      if (success) {
        toast.success(`Department "${department.name}" has been deleted`);
        router.push('/departments');
      } else {
        throw new Error('Failed to delete department');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to delete department:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to delete department');
      setIsDeleting(false);
      setIsDeleteModalOpen(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex justify-center items-center h-64">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-t-2 border-b-2 border-primary-600"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!department) {
    return (
      <div className="text-center py-12">
        <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold mb-2">Department not found</h2>
        <p className="text-gray-500 mb-6">The department you're looking for doesn't exist or has been removed.</p>
        <Link href="/departments">
          <a>
            <Button>Return to Departments</Button>
          </a>
        </Link>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 fade-in">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => router.push('/departments')}
            className="mb-2"
          >
            <FiArrowLeft className="mr-2" />
            Back to Departments
          </Button>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">{department.name}</h1>
        </div>
        <div className="flex space-x-2">
          <Link href={`/departments/${id}/edit`}>
            <a>
              <Button variant="outline" className="flex items-center">
                <FiEdit className="mr-2" />
                Edit
              </Button>
            </a>
          </Link>
          <Button 
            variant="outline" 
            className="flex items-center text-red-600 border-red-200 hover:bg-red-50"
            onClick={() => setIsDeleteModalOpen(true)}
          >
            <FiTrash2 className="mr-2" />
            Delete
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Department Info */}
        <Card className="lg:col-span-1">
          <Card.Header>
            <Card.Title>Department Info</Card.Title>
          </Card.Header>
          <Card.Content>
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-500">Name</h3>
                <p className="mt-1">{department.name}</p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-500">Members</h3>
                <p className="mt-1">{members.length} employee{members.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </Card.Content>
        </Card>

        {/* Team Lead */}
        <Card className="lg:col-span-2">
          <Card.Header>
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
              <Card.Title>Team Lead</Card.Title>
              <Link href={`/departments/${id}/edit`}>
                <a>
                  <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">
                    Change
                  </Button>
                </a>
              </Link>
            </div>
          </Card.Header>
          <Card.Content>
            {teamLead ? (
              <div className="flex items-center">
                <Avatar 
                  fallback={teamLead.name} 
                  size="lg" 
                  className="mr-4"
                />
                <div>
                  <h3 className="font-medium">{teamLead.name}</h3>
                  <p className="text-gray-500">{teamLead.designation}</p>
                  <div className="flex items-center mt-2 text-sm text-gray-500">
                    <FiMail className="mr-1" />
                    <span>{teamLead.email}</span>
                  </div>

                  <tbody className="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-200">

                      <tr key={member.id} className="hover:bg-gray-50">
                        <td className="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">

                            {member.phoneNumber}

                            <FiBriefcase className="mr-2 text-gray-400" />

        title="Delete Department"

            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <div className="text-sm text-gray-500">
          <p>
            This will permanently delete the department 
            <span className="font-semibold text-gray-700"> {department.name} </span>
            and remove all department associations from its {members.length} members.
          </p>
          <p className="mt-2">
            The employees will not be deleted, but they will no longer be associated with this department.
          </p>
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="/pages/departments/[id]/edit.js">
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/router';
import { FiArrowLeft, FiSave } from 'react-icons/fi';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { 
  getDepartmentById, 
  updateDepartment, 
  getEmployees 
} from '../../../lib/data';
import { Button } from '../../../components/Button';
import { Input } from '../../../components/Input';
import { Select } from '../../../components/Select';
import { Label } from '../../../components/Label';
import { Card } from '../../../components/Card';

export default function EditDepartment() {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: '',
    teamLeadId: ''
  });
  const [originalData, setOriginalData] = useState(null);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [employees, setEmployees] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const router = useRouter();
  const { id } = router.query;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (id) {
      loadData();
    }
  }, [id]);

  const loadData = async () => {
    try {
      // Load department data
      const departmentData = getDepartmentById(id);
      
      if (!departmentData) {
        toast.error('Department not found');
        router.push('/departments');
        return;
      }
      
      // Load employees for team lead selection
      const employeeData = getEmployees();
      
      setFormData({
        name: departmentData.name,
        teamLeadId: departmentData.teamLeadId || ''
      });
      setOriginalData(departmentData);
      setEmployees(employeeData);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to load data:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to load data');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const validateForm = () => {
    const newErrors = {};
    
    if (!formData.name.trim()) {
      newErrors.name = 'Department name is required';
    }
    
    setErrors(newErrors);
    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;
  };

  const handleChange = (e) => {
    const { name, value } = e.target;
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: value }));
    
    // Clear error when field is edited
    if (errors[name]) {
      setErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: undefined }));
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if (!validateForm()) return;
    
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const updatedDepartment = updateDepartment(id, formData);
      
      if (updatedDepartment) {
        toast.success(`Department "${updatedDepartment.name}" has been updated`);
        router.push(`/departments/${id}`);
      } else {
        throw new Error('Failed to update department');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to update department:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to update department');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex justify-center items-center h-64">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-t-2 border-b-2 border-primary-600"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto fade-in">
      <div className="mb-6">
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          onClick={() => router.push(`/departments/${id}`)}
          className="mb-2"
        >
          <FiArrowLeft className="mr-2" />
          Back to Department
        </Button>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">Edit Department</h1>
      </div>

      <Card>
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
          <Card.Content className="space-y-6">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="name">
                Department Name <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="name"
                name="name"
                value={formData.name}
                onChange={handleChange}
                placeholder="e.g. Engineering, Marketing, HR"
                className={errors.name ? 'border-red-500' : ''}
              />
              {errors.name && (
                <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-1">{errors.name}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="teamLeadId">Team Lead</Label>
              <Select
                id="teamLeadId"
                name="teamLeadId"
                value={formData.teamLeadId}
                onChange={handleChange}
              >
                <option value="">-- No Team Lead --</option>
                {employees.map(emp => (
                  <option key={emp.id} value={emp.id}>
                    {emp.name} - {emp.designation}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </Select>
            </div>
          </Card.Content>

          <Card.Footer className="flex justify-end space-x-2 border-t pt-6">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => router.push(`/departments/${id}`)}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="submit"
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              className="flex items-center"
            >
              <FiSave className="mr-2" />
              {isSubmitting ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Changes'}
            </Button>
          </Card.Footer>
        </form>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="/pages/employees/index.js">
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { FiUserPlus, FiSearch, FiFilter, FiX } from 'react-icons/fi';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { 
  getEmployees, 
  getDepartments,
  getDepartmentById,
  deleteEmployee
} from '../../lib/data';
import { Button } from '../../components/Button';
import { Input } from '../../components/Input';
import { Select } from '../../components/Select';
import { EmployeeCard } from '../../components/EmployeeCard';
import { EmptyState } from '../../components/EmptyState';
import { Modal } from '../../components/Modal';

export default function Employees() {
  const [employees, setEmployees] = useState([]);
  const [departments, setDepartments] = useState([]);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [departmentFilter, setDepartmentFilter] = useState('');
  const [isDeleteModalOpen, setIsDeleteModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [employeeToDelete, setEmployeeToDelete] = useState(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, []);

  const loadData = () => {
    try {
      const employeeData = getEmployees();
      const departmentData = getDepartments();
      
      // Enhance employees with department data
      const enhancedEmployees = employeeData.map(emp => {
        const department = emp.departmentId 
          ? getDepartmentById(emp.departmentId) 
          : null;
        
        return {
          ...emp,
          department
        };
      });
      
      setEmployees(enhancedEmployees);
      setDepartments(departmentData);
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to load data');
      console.error(error);
    }
  };

  const handleSearchChange = (e) => {
    setSearchQuery(e.target.value);
  };

  const handleDepartmentFilterChange = (e) => {
    setDepartmentFilter(e.target.value);
  };

  const clearFilters = () => {
    setSearchQuery('');
    setDepartmentFilter('');
  };

  const handleDeleteClick = (employee) => {
    setEmployeeToDelete(employee);
    setIsDeleteModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleEditClick = (employee) => {
    // Navigate to edit page
    window.location.href = `/employees/${employee.id}/edit`;
  };

  const confirmDelete = async () => {
    if (!employeeToDelete) return;
    
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const success = deleteEmployee(employeeToDelete.id);
      
      if (success) {
        toast.success(`${employeeToDelete.name} has been deleted`);
        loadData();
      } else {
        toast.error('Failed to delete employee');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('An error occurred while deleting');
      console.error(error);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
      setIsDeleteModalOpen(false);
      setEmployeeToDelete(null);
    }
  };

  // Filter employees based on search and department filter
  const filteredEmployees = employees.filter(emp => {
    const matchesSearch = emp.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
                          emp.email.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
                          emp.designation.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
    
    const matchesDepartment = !departmentFilter || emp.departmentId === departmentFilter;
    
    return matchesSearch && matchesDepartment;
  });

  const hasActiveFilters = searchQuery || departmentFilter;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 fade-in">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">Employees</h1>
        <Link href="/employees/new">
          <a>
            <Button className="w-full sm:w-auto flex items-center justify-center">
              <FiUserPlus className="mr-2" />
              Add Employee
            </Button>
          </a>
        </Link>
      </div>

      {/* Search and Filter */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        <div className="sm:col-span-2 relative">
          <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-gray-400">
            <FiSearch />
          </div>
          <Input
            type="text"
            placeholder="Search employees by name, email, or designation..."
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={handleSearchChange}
            className="pl-10"
          />
        </div>
        
        <div className="relative">
          <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-gray-400">
            <FiFilter />
          </div>
          <Select
            value={departmentFilter}
            onChange={handleDepartmentFilterChange}
            className="pl-10"
          >
            <option value="">All Departments</option>
            {departments.map(dept => (
              <option key={dept.id} value={dept.id}>
                {dept.name}
              </option>
            ))}
          </Select>
        </div>
      </div>
      
      {/* Filter indicator */}
      {hasActiveFilters && (
        <div className="flex items-center bg-gray-100 px-4 py-2 rounded-md">
          <span className="text-sm text-gray-600 mr-2">Filters applied:</span>
          {searchQuery && (
            <span className="bg-primary-100 text-primary-800 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-full flex items-center mr-2">
              Search: "{searchQuery}"
              <button 
                onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')}
                className="ml-1 text-primary-600 hover:text-primary-800"
              >
                <FiX size={14} />
              </button>
            </span>
          )}
          {departmentFilter && (
            <span className="bg-primary-100 text-primary-800 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-full flex items-center mr-2">
              Department: {departments.find(d => d.id === departmentFilter)?.name}
              <button 
                onClick={() => setDepartmentFilter('')}
                className="ml-1 text-primary-600 hover:text-primary-800"
              >
                <FiX size={14} />
              </button>
            </span>
          )}
          <button 
            onClick={clearFilters}
            className="text-xs text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 ml-auto"
          >
            Clear all
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Employee Grid */}
      {employees.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState 
          title="No employees yet"
          description="Get started by adding your first employee"
          action={() => window.location.href = '/employees/new'}
        />
      ) : filteredEmployees.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState 
          title="No matching employees"
          description="Try different search terms or filters"
          action={clearFilters}
          actionText="Clear Filters"
        />
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          {filteredEmployees.map((emp) => (
            <EmployeeCard
              key={emp.id}
              employee={emp}
              department={emp.department}
              onEdit={handleEditClick}
              onDelete={handleDeleteClick}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Delete Confirmation Modal */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={isDeleteModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsDeleteModalOpen(false)}
        title="Delete Employee"
        description="Are you sure you want to delete this employee? This action cannot be undone."
        footer={
          <>
            <Button 
              variant="outline" 
              onClick={() => setIsDeleteModalOpen(false)}
              disabled={isLoading}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button 
              variant="destructive" 
              onClick={confirmDelete}
              disabled={isLoading}
            >
              {isLoading ? 'Deleting...' : 'Delete'}
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        {employeeToDelete && (
          <div className="text-sm text-gray-500">
            <p>
              This will permanently delete the employee 
              <span className="font-semibold text-gray-700"> {employeeToDelete.name} </span>
              from the system.
            </p>
            {employeeToDelete.department && (
              <p className="mt-2">
                They will also be removed from the {employeeToDelete.department.name} department.
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/router';
import { FiArrowLeft, FiSave } from 'react-icons/fi';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { addEmployee, getDepartments } from '../../lib/data';
import { Button } from '../../components/Button';
import { Input } from '../../components/Input';
import { Select } from '../../components/Select';
import { Label } from '../../components/Label';
import { Card } from '../../components/Card';

export default function NewEmployee() {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: '',
    email: '',
    departmentId: '',
    phoneNumber: '',
    designation: ''
  });
  const [departments, setDepartments] = useState([]);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const router = useRouter();

  useEffect(() => {
    loadDepartments();
  }, []);

  const loadDepartments = () => {
    try {
      const departmentData = getDepartments();
      setDepartments(departmentData);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to load departments:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to load departments');
    }
  };

  const validateForm = () => {
    const newErrors = {};
    
    if (!formData.name.trim()) {
      newErrors.name = 'Name is required';
    }
    
    if (!formData.email.trim()) {
      newErrors.email = 'Email is required';
    } else if (!/\S+@\S+\.\S+/.test(formData.email)) {
      newErrors.email = 'Email is invalid';
    }
    
    if (!formData.phoneNumber.trim()) {
      newErrors.phoneNumber = 'Phone number is required';
    }
    
    if (!formData.designation.trim()) {
      newErrors.designation = 'Designation is required';
    }
    
    setErrors(newErrors);
    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;
  };

  const handleChange = (e) => {
    const { name, value } = e.target;
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: value }));
    
    // Clear error when field is edited
    if (errors[name]) {
      setErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: undefined }));
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if (!validateForm()) return;
    
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const newEmployee = addEmployee(formData);
      
      toast.success(`Employee "${newEmployee.name}" has been created`);
      router.push('/employees');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to create employee:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to create employee');
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto fade-in">
      <div className="mb-6">
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          onClick={() => router.push('/employees')}
          className="mb-2"
        >
          <FiArrowLeft className="mr-2" />
          Back to Employees
        </Button>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">Add New Employee</h1>
      </div>

      <Card>
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
          <Card.Content className="space-y-6">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="name">
                Full Name <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="name"
                name="name"
                value={formData.name}
                onChange={handleChange}
                placeholder="John Doe"
                className={errors.name ? 'border-red-500' : ''}
              />
              {errors.name && (
                <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-1">{errors.name}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="email">
                Email <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="email"
                name="email"
                type="email"
                value={formData.email}
                onChange={handleChange}
                placeholder="john.doe@tericsoft.com"
                className={errors.email ? 'border-red-500' : ''}
              />
              {errors.email && (
                <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-1">{errors.email}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="phoneNumber">
                Phone Number <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="phoneNumber"
                name="phoneNumber"
                value={formData.phoneNumber}
                onChange={handleChange}
                placeholder="555-123-4567"
                className={errors.phoneNumber ? 'border-red-500' : ''}
              />
              {errors.phoneNumber && (
                <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-1">{errors.phoneNumber}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="designation">
                Designation <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="designation"
                name="designation"
                value={formData.designation}
                onChange={handleChange}
                placeholder="Software Engineer"
                className={errors.designation ? 'border-red-500' : ''}
              />

              )}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="departmentId">Department</Label>
              <Select
                id="departmentId"
                name="departmentId"
                value={formData.departmentId}
                onChange={handleChange}
              >
                <option value="">-- Select Department (Optional) --</option>
                {departments.map(dept => (
                  <option key={dept.id} value={dept.id}>
                    {dept.name}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </Select>
            </div>
          </Card.Content>

          <Card.Footer className="flex justify-end space-x-2 border-t pt-6">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => router.push('/employees')}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="submit"
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              className="flex items-center"
            >
              <FiSave className="mr-2" />
              {isSubmitting ? 'Creating...' : 'Create Employee'}
            </Button>
          </Card.Footer>
        </form>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
