-- Migration: Role-based access controls
-- Description: Create roles and permissions tables and add RLS policies
-- Author: HR Admin
-- Created: 2023-12-30

-- create user roles type
create type user_role as enum ('admin', 'employee', 'team_lead', 'project_manager');

-- create user_profiles table to link auth users to employees
create table if not exists user_profiles (
  id uuid primary key default uuid_generate_v4(),
  auth_user_id uuid references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
  employee_id text references employees(id) on delete cascade,
  role user_role not null default 'employee',
  created_at timestamp with time zone default now(),
  updated_at timestamp with time zone default now()
);

-- add update trigger for user_profiles
create trigger update_user_profiles_updated_at
before update on user_profiles
for each row execute function update_modified_column();

-- create indexes for faster queries
create index if not exists idx_user_profiles_auth_user_id on user_profiles(auth_user_id);
create index if not exists idx_user_profiles_employee_id on user_profiles(employee_id);

-- rls function: check if user is an admin
create or replace function is_admin() 
returns boolean as $$
begin
  return exists (
    select 1 
    from user_profiles
    where auth_user_id = auth.uid() 
    and role = 'admin'
  );
end;
$$ language plpgsql security definer;

-- rls function: check if user is a team lead of a department
create or replace function is_team_lead_of_department(department_id text) 
returns boolean as $$
begin
  return exists (
    select 1 
    from department_team_leads dtl
    join user_profiles up on up.employee_id = dtl.employee_id
    where up.auth_user_id = auth.uid() 
    and dtl.department_id = department_id
  );
end;
$$ language plpgsql security definer;

-- rls function: check if user is a project manager of a project
create or replace function is_project_manager_of_project(project_id text) 
returns boolean as $$
begin
  return exists (
    select 1 
    from projects p
    join user_profiles up on up.employee_id = p.projectManagerId
    where up.auth_user_id = auth.uid() 
    and p.id = project_id
  );
end;
$$ language plpgsql security definer;

-- rls function: check if user can view employee
create or replace function can_view_employee(employee_id text) 
returns boolean as $$
declare
  viewer_employee_id text;
  viewer_role user_role;
begin
  -- Get the current user's employee ID and role
  select up.employee_id, up.role into viewer_employee_id, viewer_role
  from user_profiles up
  where up.auth_user_id = auth.uid();
  
  -- Admin can view all employees
  if viewer_role = 'admin' then
    return true;
  end if;
  
  -- Users can always view themselves
  if viewer_employee_id = employee_id then
    return true;
  end if;
  
  -- Team leads can view employees in their departments
  if viewer_role = 'team_lead' then
    return exists (
      select 1 
      from department_team_leads dtl
      join employees e on e.departmentId = dtl.department_id
      where dtl.employee_id = viewer_employee_id
      and e.id = employee_id
    );
  end if;
  
  -- Project managers can view employees in their projects
  if viewer_role = 'project_manager' then
    return exists (
      select 1 
      from projects p
      join project_members pm on pm.project_id = p.id
      where p.projectManagerId = viewer_employee_id
      and pm.employee_id = employee_id
    );
  end if;
  
  return false;
end;
$$ language plpgsql security definer;

-- rls function: check if user can view report
create or replace function can_view_report(report_employee_id text) 
returns boolean as $$
declare
  viewer_employee_id text;
  viewer_role user_role;
begin
  -- Get the current user's employee ID and role
  select up.employee_id, up.role into viewer_employee_id, viewer_role
  from user_profiles up
  where up.auth_user_id = auth.uid();
  
  -- Admin can view all reports
  if viewer_role = 'admin' then
    return true;
  end if;
  
  -- Users can always view their own reports
  if viewer_employee_id = report_employee_id then
    return true;
  end if;
  
  -- Use the can_view_employee function to determine if user can view reports
  -- This leverages the same permission logic
  return can_view_employee(report_employee_id);
end;
$$ language plpgsql security definer;

alter table user_profiles enable row level security;

insert into user_profiles (auth_user_id, employee_id, role)
select 
  id as auth_user_id,
  'admin-1' as employee_id,
  'admin' as role
from auth.users
where email = 'admin@tericsoft.com'
on conflict do nothing;

-- function to sync user profiles with employees
create or replace function sync_employee_user_profiles()
returns trigger as $$
begin
  -- for new employees, check if there's a matching auth user and create profile
  if TG_OP = 'INSERT' or TG_OP = 'UPDATE' then
    insert into user_profiles (auth_user_id, employee_id, role)
    select 
      u.id as auth_user_id,
      new.id as employee_id,
      case 
        when new.jobRole = 'team_lead' then 'team_lead'::user_role
        when new.jobRole = 'project_manager' then 'project_manager'::user_role
        else 'employee'::user_role
      end as role
    from auth.users u
    where u.email = new.email
    and not exists (
      select 1 from user_profiles up where up.employee_id = new.id
    )
    on conflict do nothing;
    
    -- if employee role changed, update user profile
    if TG_OP = 'UPDATE' and old.jobRole != new.jobRole then
      update user_profiles
      set role = case 
        when new.jobRole = 'team_lead' then 'team_lead'::user_role
        when new.jobRole = 'project_manager' then 'project_manager'::user_role
        else 'employee'::user_role
      end
      where employee_id = new.id;
    end if;
  end if;
  
  -- if employee is deleted, update user profile
  if TG_OP = 'DELETE' then
    update user_profiles
    set employee_id = null
    where employee_id = old.id;
  end if;
  
  return coalesce(new, old);
end;
$$ language plpgsql security definer;

-- trigger to sync employees with user profiles
create trigger sync_employee_profiles
after insert or update or delete on employees
for each row execute function sync_employee_user_profiles();

import mongoose from 'mongoose';

const MONGODB_URI = process.env.MONGODB_URI;

if (!MONGODB_URI) {
  throw new Error(
    'Please define the MONGODB_URI environment variable inside .env.local'
  );
}

/**
 * Global is used here to maintain a cached connection across hot reloads
 * in development. This prevents connections growing exponentially
 * during API Route usage.
 */
let cached = global.mongoose;

if (!cached) {
  cached = global.mongoose = { conn: null, promise: null };
}

async function dbConnect() {
  if (cached.conn) {
    return cached.conn;
  }

  if (!cached.promise) {
    const opts = {
      bufferCommands: false,
    };

    cached.promise = mongoose.connect(MONGODB_URI, opts).then((mongoose) => {
      return mongoose;
    });
  }
  cached.conn = await cached.promise;
  return cached.conn;
}

export default dbConnect;

import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import pool from './db';

export async function initializeDatabase() {
  try {
    // Read the schema file
    const schemaPath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'lib', 'schema.sql');
    const schema = fs.readFileSync(schemaPath, 'utf8');

    // Execute the schema
    const client = await pool.connect();
    try {
      await client.query(schema);
      console.log('Database schema initialized successfully');
    } finally {
      client.release();
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error initializing database:', error);
    throw error;
  }
}

require('dotenv').config({ path: '.env.local' });
const { query, testConnection } = require('./postgres.js');

async function migrateDatabase() {
  try {
    console.log('Testing database connection...');
    const isConnected = await testConnection();
    
    if (!isConnected) {
      console.error('Failed to connect to database. Please check your connection settings.');
      return false;
    }

    console.log('Starting database migration...');
    
    // Check existing tables
    const existingTables = await query(`
      SELECT table_name 
      FROM information_schema.tables 
      WHERE table_schema = 'public' 
      ORDER BY table_name
    `);
    
    console.log('Existing tables:', existingTables.rows.map(r => r.table_name));
    
    // Drop existing tables if they exist (in correct order to handle foreign keys)
    const tablesToDrop = [
      'submission_answers',
      'form_submissions', 
      'question_options',
      'form_questions',
      'score_categories',
      'score_forms',
      'allocation_members',
      'project_allocations',
      'project_members',
      'projects',
      'department_team_leads',
      'employees',
      'departments',
      'scores',
      'otps'
    ];
    
    for (const table of tablesToDrop) {
      try {
        await query(`DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${table} CASCADE`);
        console.log(`Dropped table: ${table}`);
      } catch (error) {
        console.log(`Table ${table} doesn't exist or couldn't be dropped:`, error.message);
      }
    }
    
    // Drop existing types if they exist
    const typesToDrop = [
      'user_role',
      'form_frequency', 
      'form_status',
      'audience_type',
      'question_type',
      'reporting_period'
    ];
    
    for (const type of typesToDrop) {
      try {
        await query(`DROP TYPE IF EXISTS ${type} CASCADE`);
        console.log(`Dropped type: ${type}`);
      } catch (error) {
        console.log(`Type ${type} doesn't exist or couldn't be dropped:`, error.message);
      }
    }
    
    console.log('Migration completed successfully!');
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error during migration:', error);
    return false;
  }
}

// Run migration if this file is executed directly
if (require.main === module) {
  migrateDatabase()
    .then((success) => {
      if (success) {
        console.log('Migration completed. Now run: node lib/setup-db.js');
      }
      process.exit(success ? 0 : 1);
    })
    .catch((error) => {
      console.error('Migration failed:', error);
      process.exit(1);
    });
}

module.exports = { migrateDatabase };

// Store OTPs temporarily (in production, use a proper database)
const otpStore = new Map();

// Generate a 6-digit OTP
export const generateOTP = () => {
  return Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000).toString();
};

// Send OTP via email
export const sendOTP = async (email) => {
  try {
    const response = await fetch('/api/send-otp', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ email }),
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      const data = await response.json();
      throw new Error(data.message || 'Failed to send OTP');
    }

    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to send OTP:', error);
    return false;
  }
};

// Verify OTP
export const verifyOTP = async (email, otp) => {
  try {
    const response = await fetch('/api/verify-otp', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ email, otp }),
    });

    const data = await response.json();
    return data;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to verify OTP:', error);
    return { valid: false, message: 'Failed to verify OTP' };
  }
};

File: lib/postgres.js

const { Pool } = require('pg');

// Global connection pool
let pool;

// Function to create and configure connection pool
function createPool() {
  if (!pool) {
    pool = new Pool({
      connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL,
      ssl: false, // Set to true if your PostgreSQL server requires SSL
      max: 20, // Maximum number of clients in the pool
      idleTimeoutMillis: 30000, // Close idle clients after 30 seconds
      connectionTimeoutMillis: 2000, // Return an error after 2 seconds if connection cannot be established
    });

    // Handle pool errors
    pool.on('error', (err, client) => {
      console.error('Unexpected error on idle client', err);
      process.exit(-1);
    });
  }
  return pool;
}

// Get a client from the pool
async function getClient() {
  const pool = createPool();
  return await pool.connect();
}

// Execute a query with the pool
async function query(text, params) {
  const pool = createPool();
  const start = Date.now();
  
  try {
    const res = await pool.query(text, params);
    const duration = Date.now() - start;
    
    // Log query for debugging (remove in production)
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {
      console.log('Executed query', { text: text.substring(0, 100) + '...', duration, rows: res.rowCount });
    }
    
    return res;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Database query error:', error);
    throw error;
  }
}

// Close the pool (usually called when the application shuts down)
async function closePool() {
  if (pool) {
    await pool.end();
    pool = null;
  }
}

// Test database connection
async function testConnection() {
  try {
    const result = await query('SELECT NOW()');
    console.log('Database connection successful:', result.rows[0]);
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Database connection failed:', error);
    return false;
  }
}

// Execute schema setup
async function setupDatabase() {
  try {
    // Check if tables exist
    const result = await query(`
      SELECT table_name 
      FROM information_schema.tables 
      WHERE table_schema = 'public' 
      AND table_name = 'employees'
    `);
    
    if (result.rows.length === 0) {
      console.log('Database tables not found. Please run the schema setup first.');
      return false;
    }
    
    console.log('Database schema is already set up.');
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error checking database schema:', error);
    return false;
  }
}

module.exports = {
  getClient,
  query,
  closePool,
  testConnection,
  setupDatabase
}; 


================================================
File: lib/schema.sql

-- Enable UUID extension
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp";

-- Departments table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS departments (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- Employees table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS employees (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    email VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    first_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    last_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    department_id UUID REFERENCES departments(id),
    position VARCHAR(255),
    is_admin BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- OTP table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS otps (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    otp VARCHAR(6) NOT NULL,
    attempts INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '10 minutes')
);

-- Scores table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scores (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    employee_id UUID REFERENCES employees(id),
    score INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (score >= 0 AND score <= 100),
    month INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (month >= 1 AND month <= 12),
    year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    UNIQUE(employee_id, month, year)
);

-- Create indexes
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_employees_email ON employees(email);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_employees_department ON employees(department_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_otps_email ON otps(email);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_scores_employee ON scores(employee_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_scores_month_year ON scores(month, year);

-- Create function to update updated_at timestamp
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    NEW.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ language 'plpgsql';

-- Create triggers for updated_at
CREATE TRIGGER update_departments_updated_at
    BEFORE UPDATE ON departments
    FOR EACH ROW
    EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column();

CREATE TRIGGER update_employees_updated_at
    BEFORE UPDATE ON employees
    FOR EACH ROW
    EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column();

CREATE TRIGGER update_scores_updated_at
    BEFORE UPDATE ON scores
    FOR EACH ROW
    EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column();

require('dotenv').config({ path: '.env.local' });
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { query, testConnection } = require('./postgres.js');

async function setupDatabase() {
  try {
    console.log('Testing database connection...');
    const isConnected = await testConnection();
    
    if (!isConnected) {
      console.error('Failed to connect to database. Please check your connection settings.');
      return false;
    }

    console.log('Reading schema file...');
    const schemaPath = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'setup-database.sql');
    const schema = fs.readFileSync(schemaPath, 'utf8');

    console.log('Setting up database schema...');
    await query(schema);

    console.log('Database setup completed successfully!');
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error setting up database:', error);
    return false;
  }
}

// Run setup if this file is executed directly
if (require.main === module) {
  setupDatabase()
    .then((success) => {
      process.exit(success ? 0 : 1);
    })
    .catch((error) => {
      console.error('Setup failed:', error);
      process.exit(1);
    });
}

module.exports = { setupDatabase };

import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';

// Initialize Supabase client
const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
const supabaseAnonKey = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY;

// Check if Supabase is configured
export const isSupabaseConfigured = () => {
  return supabaseUrl && supabaseAnonKey && supabaseUrl !== 'https://your-project-id.supabase.co';
};

// Export Supabase client if configured, otherwise export null
export const supabase = isSupabaseConfigured() 
  ? createClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseAnonKey) 
  : null;

================================================
File: lib/supabase.js

import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';

const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
const supabaseAnonKey = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY;

if (!supabaseUrl || !supabaseAnonKey) {
  throw new Error('Missing Supabase environment variables');
}

// Create a single supabase client for interacting with your database
export const supabase = createClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseAnonKey, {
  auth: {
    persistSession: false
  },
  global: {
    headers: {
      'x-my-custom-header': 'my-app-name'
    }
  }
});

import { clsx } from 'clsx';
import { twMerge } from 'tailwind-merge';

export function cn(...inputs) {
  return twMerge(clsx(inputs));
}

export function formatDate(date) {
  return new Date(date).toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
    month: 'short',
    day: 'numeric',
    year: 'numeric'
  });
}

export function getRandomColor() {
  const colors = [
    'bg-red-100 text-red-800',
    'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800',
    'bg-green-100 text-green-800',
    'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800',
    'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800',
    'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800',
    'bg-pink-100 text-pink-800'
  ];
  
  return colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)];
}

-- This migration creates the necessary tables and functions for admin authentication
-- Schema: public
-- Tables: users, user_roles
-- Functions: handle_new_user

-- Create users table with role column
create table if not exists public.users (
  id uuid references auth.users on delete cascade not null primary key,
  email text not null unique,
  role text not null check (role in ('admin', 'user')),
  created_at timestamp with time zone default now() not null,
  updated_at timestamp with time zone default now() not null
);

-- Create a secure function to handle new user signups
create or replace function public.handle_new_user() 
returns trigger as $$
begin
  -- By default assign the 'user' role to new users
  -- Admins will need to be manually upgraded by another admin
  insert into public.users (id, email, role)
  values (new.id, new.email, 'user');
  return new;
end;
$$ language plpgsql security definer;

-- Trigger the function every time a user is created
drop trigger if exists on_auth_user_created on auth.users;
create trigger on_auth_user_created
  after insert on auth.users
  for each row execute function public.handle_new_user();

-- Create RLS policies for users table
alter table public.users enable row level security;

-- Allow users to see their own data
create policy "Users can view their own data"
  on public.users for select
  using (auth.uid() = id);

-- Allow admins to see all user data
create policy "Admins can view all user data"
  on public.users for select
  using (
    exists (
      select 1 from public.users 
      where id = auth.uid() and role = 'admin'
    )
  );

-- Allow admins to update user roles
create policy "Admins can update user roles"
  on public.users for update
  using (
    exists (
      select 1 from public.users 
      where id = auth.uid() and role = 'admin'
    )
  );

-- Insert an initial admin user (change the email and UUID as needed)
-- This is for demonstration purposes; in production, use a secure method to add admin users
insert into auth.users (id, email)
values ('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', 'admin@example.com')
on conflict do nothing;

-- Assign admin role to the initial user
insert into public.users (id, email, role)
values ('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', 'admin@example.com', 'admin')
on conflict (id) do update set role = 'admin';

-- Enable Supabase authentication for email/password
update auth.config
set enable_sign_up = true;

-- Add comments to tables and columns for better documentation
comment on table public.users is 'Stores user profile data with role-based access control';
comment on column public.users.id is 'References the auth.users table';
comment on column public.users.role is 'User role: admin or user';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/router';
import { ToastContainer } from 'react-toastify';
import 'react-toastify/dist/ReactToastify.css';
import '../styles/globals.css';
import Layout from '../components/Layout';
import { isAuthenticated, getUser } from '../lib/auth';

function MyApp({ Component, pageProps }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
  
  useEffect(() => {
    // Check if user is authenticated
    const checkAuth = async () => {
      const isAuthed = isAuthenticated();
      const currentUser = getUser();
      setUser(currentUser);
      
      // If not authenticated and not on login page, redirect to login
      if (!isAuthed && router.pathname !== '/login') {
        router.push('/login');
      }
      
      // Handle role-based access restrictions
      if (isAuthed && currentUser && !canAccessPage(currentUser, router.pathname)) {
        router.push('/unauthorized');
      }
      
      setLoaded(true);
    };
    
    checkAuth();
  }, [router.pathname]);

  // Function to check if user can access the current page based on their role
  const canAccessPage = (user, path) => {
    if (!user) return false;
    
    // Admin can access everything
    if (user.role === 'admin') return true;
    
    // Public pages that anyone can access when logged in
    const publicPages = ['/', '/profile', '/unauthorized'];
    if (publicPages.some(p => path === p || path.startsWith('/profile/'))) return true;
    
    // Path-specific permissions
    if (path.startsWith('/employees')) {
      // Team leads and project managers can view employees
      return ['team_lead', 'project_manager'].includes(user.role);
    }
    
    if (path.startsWith('/departments')) {
      // Only team leads and admins can view departments
      return user.role === 'team_lead';
    }
    
    if (path.startsWith('/projects')) {
      // Project managers, team leads can view projects
      return ['project_manager', 'team_lead'].includes(user.role);
    }
    
    if (path.startsWith('/reports')) {
      // Everyone can access reports (access control is handled in the reports page)
      return true;
    }
    
    // Forms, analytics are admin only
    if (path.startsWith('/forms') || path.startsWith('/analytics')) {
      return false;
    }
    
    // Default deny access if not specifically allowed
    return false;
  };

  if (!loaded) {
    return null;
  }
  
  // If the path is /login, don't wrap with Layout
  if (router.pathname === '/login') {
    return (
      <>
        <Component {...pageProps} />
        <ToastContainer 
          position="top-right"
          autoClose={3000}
          hideProgressBar={false}
          newestOnTop
          closeOnClick
          rtl={false}
          pauseOnFocusLoss
          draggable
          pauseOnHover
        />
      </>
    );
  }

  // For unauthorized page
  if (router.pathname === '/unauthorized') {
    return (
      <>
        <Component {...pageProps} />
        <ToastContainer 
          position="top-right"
          autoClose={3000}
          hideProgressBar={false}
          newestOnTop
          closeOnClick
          rtl={false}
          pauseOnFocusLoss
          draggable
          pauseOnHover
        />
      </>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <Layout>
        <Component {...pageProps} user={user} />
      </Layout>
      <ToastContainer 
        position="top-right"
        autoClose={3000}
        hideProgressBar={false}
        newestOnTop
        closeOnClick
        rtl={false}
        pauseOnFocusLoss
        draggable
        pauseOnHover
      />
    </>
  );
}

export default MyApp;

export async function getServerSideProps() {
  // Import database functions only on server-side
  const { getDepartments, getEmployees, getProjects } = require('../lib/data');

  try {
    const [departments, employees, projects] = await Promise.all([
      getDepartments(),
      getEmployees(),
      getProjects()
    ]);

    // Serialize dates
    const serializedDepartments = departments.map(dept => ({
      ...dept,
      created_at: dept.created_at ? dept.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: dept.updated_at ? dept.updated_at.toISOString() : null
    }));

    const serializedEmployees = employees.map(emp => ({
      ...emp,
      created_at: emp.created_at ? emp.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: emp.updated_at ? emp.updated_at.toISOString() : null
    }));

    const serializedProjects = projects.map(proj => ({
      ...proj,
      created_at: proj.created_at ? proj.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: proj.updated_at ? proj.updated_at.toISOString() : null
    }));

    return {
      props: {
        departments: serializedDepartments,
        employees: serializedEmployees,
        projects: serializedProjects
      }
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching analytics data:', error);
    return {
      props: {
        departments: [],
        employees: [],
        projects: []
      }
    };
  }
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

export default function Analytics({ departments, employees, projects }) {

  const deptDistribution = departments.map(dept => ({

  }));

  // Team lead distribution
  const teamLeadCounts = departments.map(dept => ({
    name: dept.name,
    count: (dept.teamLeadIds || []).length
  }));

    return <div className="flex justify-center items-center h-64">Loading analytics...</div>;

  return (

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

import { Card } from '../components/Card';
import { Button } from '../components/Button';
import { Avatar } from '../components/Avatar';

export async function getServerSideProps() {
  // Import database functions only on server-side
  const { getDepartments, getEmployees, getProjects, getDepartmentMembers, getProjectMembers, getForms } = require('../lib/data');

  try {
    const [departments, employees, projects, forms] = await Promise.all([
      getDepartments(),
      getEmployees(),
      getProjects(),
      getForms()
    ]);
    
    // Calculate department distribution
    const distribution = Array.isArray(departments) ? await Promise.all(
      departments.map(async (dept) => ({
        id: dept.id,
        name: dept.name,
        count: (await getDepartmentMembers(dept.id)).length
      }))
    ) : [];
    
    // Sort by count (descending)
    distribution.sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count);
    
    // Get recent employees and serialize dates
    const recentEmps = Array.isArray(employees) ? [...employees].slice(0, 3).map(emp => ({
      ...emp,
      created_at: emp.created_at ? emp.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: emp.updated_at ? emp.updated_at.toISOString() : null
    })) : [];
    
    const stats = {
      totalEmployees: Array.isArray(employees) ? employees.length : 0,
      totalDepartments: Array.isArray(departments) ? departments.length : 0,
      totalProjects: Array.isArray(projects) ? projects.length : 0,
      totalForms: Array.isArray(forms) ? forms.length : 0,
      recentEmployees: recentEmps,
      departmentDistribution: distribution
    };

    return {
      props: {
        initialStats: stats
      }
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching dashboard data:', error);
    return {
      props: {
        initialStats: {
          totalEmployees: 0,
          totalDepartments: 0,
          totalProjects: 0,
          totalForms: 0,
          recentEmployees: [],
          departmentDistribution: []
        }
      }
    };
  }
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/router';
import Image from 'next/image';
import { FiLock, FiMail, FiAlertCircle } from 'react-icons/fi';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { login, isAuthenticated } from '../lib/auth';
import { sendOTP, verifyOTP } from '../lib/otp';
import { Card } from '../components/Card';
import { Input } from '../components/Input';
import { Button } from '../components/Button';
import { Label } from '../components/Label';

export default function Login() {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    email: '',
    password: '',
    otp: ''
  });
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [showOTPInput, setShowOTPInput] = useState(false);
  const router = useRouter();

  // If already logged in, redirect to dashboard
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isAuthenticated()) {
      console.log('User is authenticated, redirecting to dashboard');
      router.push('/');
    }
  }, [router]);

  const handleChange = (e) => {
    const { name, value } = e.target;
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: value }));
    // Clear error when user starts typing
    if (error) setError('');
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsLoading(true);
    setError('');

    try {
      // Simple validation
      if (!formData.email) {
        throw new Error('Please enter your email');
      }

      // Check if it's admin login
      if (formData.email === 'admin@tericsoft.com') {
        if (!formData.password) {
          throw new Error('Please enter your password');
        }
        const success = login(formData.email, formData.password);
        if (success) {
          toast.success('Login successful!');
          router.push('/');
        } else {
          throw new Error('Invalid email or password');
        }
      } else {
        // For non-admin users, handle OTP flow
        if (!showOTPInput) {
          // First step: Send OTP
          console.log('Sending OTP to:', formData.email);
          const otpSent = await sendOTP(formData.email);
          if (otpSent) {
            setShowOTPInput(true);
            toast.info('OTP sent to your email');
          } else {
            throw new Error('Failed to send OTP');
          }
        } else {
          // Second step: Verify OTP
          if (!formData.otp) {
            throw new Error('Please enter the OTP');
          }
          console.log('Verifying OTP for:', formData.email);
          const response = await verifyOTP(formData.email, formData.otp);
          console.log('OTP verification response:', response);
          
          if (response.valid || response.message === 'OTP verified successfully') {
            console.log('OTP verified, attempting login');
            const success = login(formData.email, 'otp-verified');
            console.log('Login result:', success);
            
            if (success) {
              console.log('Login successful, redirecting to dashboard');
              toast.success('Login successful!');
              // Force a page reload to ensure auth state is updated
              window.location.href = '/';
            } else {
              throw new Error('Login failed');
            }
          } else {
            throw new Error(response.message || 'Invalid OTP');
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Login error:', err);
      setError(err.message);
      toast.error(err.message);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-gray-50">
      <div className="w-full max-w-4xl grid md:grid-cols-2 shadow-xl rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
        {/* Left: Image Side */}
        <div className="hidden md:block relative bg-primary-600">
          <div className="absolute inset-0">
            <Image
              src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1497215728101-856f4ea42174?ixlib=rb-4.0.3&ixid=MnwxMjA3fDB8MHxwaG90by1wYWdlfHx8fGVufDB8fHx8&auto=format&fit=crop&w=1170&q=80"
              alt="Office desk with computer"
              layout="fill"
              objectFit="cover"
              className="mix-blend-overlay opacity-20"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col justify-center p-12 text-white h-full">
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-4">TericSoft HR</h1>
            <p className="mb-6">
              Streamline your HR operations with our comprehensive management solution.
            </p>
            <ul className="space-y-2">
              <li className="flex items-center">
                <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-white mr-2"></span>
                Manage departments efficiently
              </li>
              <li className="flex items-center">
                <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-white mr-2"></span>
                Track employee information
              </li>
              <li className="flex items-center">
                <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-white mr-2"></span>
                Organize team structures
              </li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
        
        {/* Right: Login Form */}
        <div className="bg-white p-8 md:p-12 flex flex-col justify-center">
          <div className="text-center mb-8">
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-2">Welcome Back</h2>
            <p className="text-gray-500">Sign in to your account</p>
          </div>
          
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
            {error && (
              <div className="bg-red-50 text-red-600 p-3 rounded-md flex items-center text-sm mb-4">
                <FiAlertCircle className="mr-2 flex-shrink-0" />
                {error}
              </div>
            )}
            
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="email">Email</Label>
              <div className="relative">
                <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-gray-400">
                  <FiMail />
                </div>
                <Input
                  id="email"

                  onChange={handleChange}
                  className="pl-10"
                  required
                  autoComplete="email"
                  disabled={showOTPInput}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
            
            {!showOTPInput && formData.email === 'admin@tericsoft.com' && (
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <Label htmlFor="password">Password</Label>

                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {showOTPInput && (
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="otp">Verification Code</Label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-gray-400">

                    id="otp"

                    onChange={handleChange}
                    className="pl-10"

                    pattern="[0-9]*"
                    inputMode="numeric"
                  />

              <div className="mb-1">Admin Login: admin@tericsoft.com</div>
              <div className="font-medium text-gray-600">Password: admin123</div>
            </div>

      </div>

  );
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

// Chart component to display a simple bar chart
const BarChart = ({ data, title, color = 'primary' }) => {
  const maxValue = Math.max(...data.map(item => item.value));

  return (
    <div className="w-full">
      {title && <h3 className="text-sm font-medium mb-2">{title}</h3>}
      <div className="space-y-2">
        {data.map((item, index) => (
          <div key={index} className="space-y-1">
            <div className="flex justify-between text-xs">
              <span className="truncate">{item.label}</span>
              <span className="font-medium">{item.value}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="w-full bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-2">
              <div 
                className={`bg-${color}-600 h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-500 ease-out`}
                style={{ width: `${(item.value / maxValue) * 100}%` }}
              ></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// Donut chart component
const DonutChart = ({ data, title, colors = ['primary', 'indigo', 'green', 'amber', 'red'] }) => {
  const total = data.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.value, 0);
  let startAngle = 0;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
      {title && <h3 className="text-sm font-medium mb-2">{title}</h3>}
      <div className="relative w-48 h-48">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" className="w-full h-full">
          {data.map((item, index) => {
            const percentage = (item.value / total) * 100;
            const angle = (percentage / 100) * 360;
            const largeArcFlag = angle > 180 ? 1 : 0;
            
            // Convert from polar to cartesian coordinates
            const x1 = 50 + 40 * Math.cos((Math.PI * startAngle) / 180);
            const y1 = 50 + 40 * Math.sin((Math.PI * startAngle) / 180);
            const x2 = 50 + 40 * Math.cos((Math.PI * (startAngle + angle)) / 180);
            const y2 = 50 + 40 * Math.sin((Math.PI * (startAngle + angle)) / 180);
            
            const pathData = [
              `M 50 50`,
              `L ${x1} ${y1}`,
              `A 40 40 0 ${largeArcFlag} 1 ${x2} ${y2}`,
              `Z`
            ].join(' ');
            
            const segment = (
              <path
                key={index}
                d={pathData}
                fill={`var(--color-${colors[index % colors.length]}-600)`}
                stroke="#fff"
                strokeWidth="1"
              />
            );
            
            startAngle += angle;
            return segment;
          })}
          <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="25" fill="white" />
        </svg>
        <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">
          <span className="text-xl font-bold">{total}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 w-full">
        {data.map((item, index) => (
          <div key={index} className="flex items-center text-sm">
            <div className={`w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-${colors[index % colors.length]}-600 mr-2`}></div>
            <span className="truncate">{item.label}</span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export async function getServerSideProps() {
  // Import database functions only on server-side
  const { 
    getEmployees, 
    getDepartments, 
    getProjects,
    getProjectAllocations
  } = require('../../lib/data');

  try {
    const [employees, departments, projects, allocations] = await Promise.all([
      getEmployees(),
      getDepartments(),
      getProjects(),
      getProjectAllocations()
    ]);

    const stats = {
      totalEmployees: employees.length,
      totalDepartments: departments.length,
      totalProjects: projects.length,
      totalAllocations: allocations.length
    };

    // Department distribution
    const deptData = departments.map(dept => {
      const memberCount = employees.filter(emp => emp.departmentId === dept.id || emp.department_id === dept.id).length;
      return {
        label: dept.name,
        value: memberCount
      };
    }).sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value);

    // Project allocation data
    const projData = projects.slice(0, 5).map(proj => {
      const memberCount = employees.filter(emp => {
        // Check if employee is allocated to this project
        return allocations.some(alloc => 
          alloc.projectId === proj.id && 
          alloc.members && 
          alloc.members.some(m => m.id === emp.id)
        );
      }).length;
      
      return {
        label: proj.name,
        value: memberCount
      };
    }).sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value);

    return {
      props: {
        initialStats: stats,
        initialDepartmentDistribution: deptData,
        initialProjectAllocation: projData
      }
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching analytics data:', error);
    return {
      props: {
        initialStats: {
          totalEmployees: 0,
          totalDepartments: 0,
          totalProjects: 0,
          totalAllocations: 0
        },
        initialDepartmentDistribution: [],
        initialProjectAllocation: []
      }
    };
  }
}

import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  try {
    // Check if the otps table exists
    const { data: tableInfo, error: tableError } = await supabase
      .from('otps')
      .select('*')
      .limit(1);

    if (tableError) {
      console.error('Database Check Error:', tableError);
      return res.status(500).json({
        status: 'error',
        message: 'Database check failed',
        error: tableError.message
      });
    }

    // Try to insert a test record
    const { error: insertError } = await supabase
      .from('otps')
      .insert([
        {
          email: 'test@example.com',
          otp: '123456',
          attempts: 0,
          created_at: new Date().toISOString()
        }
      ]);

    if (insertError) {
      console.error('Insert Test Error:', insertError);
      return res.status(500).json({
        status: 'error',
        message: 'Insert test failed',
        error: insertError.message
      });
    }

    // Clean up test record
    await supabase
      .from('otps')
      .delete()
      .eq('email', 'test@example.com');

    res.status(200).json({
      status: 'success',
      message: 'Database is working correctly',
      tableExists: true,
      canInsert: true,
      canDelete: true
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Check DB Error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({
      status: 'error',
      message: 'Failed to check database',
      error: error.message
    });
  }
}

File: pages/api/init-db.js

import pool from '../../lib/db';
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  if (req.method !== 'POST') {
    return res.status(405).json({ message: 'Method not allowed' });
  }

  let client;
  try {
    // Read the schema file
    const schemaPath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'lib', 'schema.sql');
    const schema = fs.readFileSync(schemaPath, 'utf8');

    // Connect to the database
    client = await pool.connect();

    // Execute the schema
    await client.query(schema);

    console.log('Database schema initialized successfully');
    res.status(200).json({ message: 'Database schema initialized successfully' });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Database Initialization Error:', {
      message: error.message,
      stack: error.stack,
      code: error.code
    });
    res.status(500).json({ 
      message: 'Failed to initialize database schema',
      error: error.message 
    });
  } finally {
    if (client) {
      client.release();
    }
  }
}

    try {
      const allocations = await getProjectAllocations();
      res.status(200).json(allocations);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching project allocations:', error);
      res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to fetch project allocations' });
    }
  } else if (req.method === 'POST') {
    try {
      const { projectId, month, year, projectManagerId, employeeIds } = req.body;
      
      // Validate required fields
      if (!projectId || !month || !year) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Project ID, month, and year are required' });
      }

      // Check if allocation already exists
      try {
        const existingAllocation = await getProjectAllocation(projectId, month, year);
        if (existingAllocation) {
          return res.status(400).json({ error: 'An allocation already exists for this project, month, and year' });
        }
      } catch (error) {
        // If getProjectAllocation throws an error, it means no allocation exists, which is what we want
      }

      // Create the allocation
      const allocationData = {
        projectId,
        month,
        year,
        projectManagerId: projectManagerId || null
      };

      const newAllocation = await addProjectAllocation(allocationData);
      
      // Add selected employees as members
      if (employeeIds && employeeIds.length > 0) {
        for (const employeeId of employeeIds) {
          await addAllocationMember(newAllocation.id, employeeId);
        }
      }

      res.status(201).json(newAllocation);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating project allocation:', error);
      res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to create project allocation' });
    }
  } else {
    res.setHeader('Allow', ['GET', 'POST']);
    res.status(405).end(`Method ${req.method} Not Allowed`);
  }
}

const generateOTP = () => {
  return Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000).toString();
};

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  if (req.method !== 'POST') {
    return res.status(405).json({ message: 'Method not allowed' });
  }

  try {
    const { email } = req.body;

    if (!email) {
      return res.status(400).json({ message: 'Email is required' });
    }

    // Generate new OTP
    const otp = generateOTP();
    console.log('Generated OTP:', otp);

    // First, try to send the email
    const mailOptions = {
      from: {
        name: 'SuperEngineer.ai Verification Code',
        address: 'noreply@superengineer.ai'
      },
      to: email,
      subject: 'Your Super Engineer Verification Code',
      text: `Hello,\n\nYour verification code is: ${otp}\n\nPlease enter this code to complete your verification. The code is valid for 10 minutes.\n\nThank you,\nSuper Engineer Team`,
      html: `
        <div style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto;">
          <h2>Verification Code</h2>
          <p>Hello,</p>
          <p>Your verification code is: <strong style="font-size: 24px; letter-spacing: 2px;">${otp}</strong></p>
          <p>Please enter this code to complete your verification. The code is valid for 10 minutes.</p>
          <p>Thank you,<br>Super Engineer Team</p>
        </div>
      `
    };

    try {
      await transporter.sendMail(mailOptions);
      console.log(`Email sent successfully to ${email}`);
    } catch (emailError) {
      console.error('Email Send Error:', emailError);
      return res.status(500).json({ 
        message: 'Failed to send email',
        error: emailError.message 
      });
    }

    // If email was sent successfully, then handle database operations
    let client;
    try {
      client = await pool.connect();
      
      // Delete any existing OTP for this email
      await client.query('DELETE FROM otps WHERE email = $1', [email]);

      // Save new OTP
      await client.query(
        'INSERT INTO otps (email, otp, attempts) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)',
        [email, otp, 0]
      );

      res.status(200).json({ message: 'OTP sent successfully' });
    } catch (dbError) {
      console.error('Database Error:', dbError);
      // Still return success since the email was sent
      res.status(200).json({ 
        message: 'OTP sent successfully (database operation failed)',
        warning: 'Database operation failed, but email was sent',
        otp: otp // Include OTP in response for development
      });
    } finally {
      if (client) {
        client.release();
      }
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Send OTP Error:', {
      message: error.message,
      stack: error.stack,
      code: error.code
    });
    res.status(500).json({ 
      message: 'Failed to send OTP',
      error: error.message 
    });
  }
}

File: pages/api/verify-otp.js
================================================
import pool from '../../lib/db';

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  if (req.method !== 'POST') {
    return res.status(405).json({ message: 'Method not allowed' });
  }

  const { email, otp } = req.body;

  if (!email || !otp) {
    return res.status(400).json({ message: 'Email and OTP are required' });
  }

  let client;
  try {
    client = await pool.connect();

    // Get the OTP record
    const result = await client.query(
      'SELECT * FROM otps WHERE email = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1',
      [email]
    );

    const otpRecord = result.rows[0];

    if (!otpRecord) {
      return res.status(400).json({ message: 'No OTP found for this email' });
    }

    // Check if too many attempts
    if (otpRecord.attempts >= 3) {
      return res.status(400).json({ message: 'Too many attempts. Please request a new OTP' });
    }

    // Check if OTP matches
    if (otpRecord.otp !== otp) {
      // Increment attempts
      await client.query(
        'UPDATE otps SET attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE id = $1',
        [otpRecord.id]
      );

      return res.status(400).json({ message: 'Invalid OTP' });
    }

    // OTP is valid, delete it
    await client.query('DELETE FROM otps WHERE id = $1', [otpRecord.id]);

    res.status(200).json({ message: 'OTP verified successfully' });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Verify OTP Error:', {
      message: error.message,
      stack: error.stack,
      code: error.code
    });
    res.status(500).json({ 
      message: 'Failed to verify OTP',
      error: error.message 
    });
  } finally {
    if (client) {
      client.release();
    }
  }
}

// Load environment variables
require('dotenv').config({ path: '.env.local' });

import { getEmployeeById, deleteEmployee, updateEmployee, getEmployees } from '../../../lib/data';

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  const { id } = req.query;

  if (req.method === 'GET') {
    try {
      const employee = await getEmployeeById(id);
      if (!employee) {
        return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Employee not found' });
      }
      res.status(200).json(employee);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching employee:', error);
      res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to fetch employee' });
    }
  } else if (req.method === 'PUT') {
    try {
      const employeeData = req.body;
      
      // Validate required fields
      if (!employeeData.name || !employeeData.email) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Name and email are required' });
      }

      // Check if another employee with same email already exists (excluding current employee)
      const existingEmployees = await getEmployees();
      const duplicateEmail = existingEmployees.find(emp => 
        emp.email.toLowerCase() === employeeData.email.toLowerCase() && emp.id !== id
      );
      
      if (duplicateEmail) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'An employee with this email already exists' });
      }

      const updatedEmployee = await updateEmployee(id, employeeData);
      if (!updatedEmployee) {
        return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Employee not found' });
      }
      res.status(200).json(updatedEmployee);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error updating employee:', error);
      
      // Check for PostgreSQL unique constraint violation
      if (error.code === '23505') {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'An employee with this email already exists' });
      }
      
      res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to update employee', details: error.message });
    }
  } else if (req.method === 'DELETE') {
    try {
      const success = await deleteEmployee(id);
      if (success) {
        res.status(200).json({ message: 'Employee deleted successfully' });
      } else {
        res.status(404).json({ error: 'Employee not found' });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error deleting employee:', error);
      res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to delete employee' });
    }
  } else {
    res.setHeader('Allow', ['GET', 'PUT', 'DELETE']);
    res.status(405).end(`Method ${req.method} Not Allowed`);
  }
}

File: pages/api/project-allocations/copy.js
================================================
// Load environment variables
require('dotenv').config({ path: '.env.local' });

import { 
  copyAllocationFromMonth,
  getProjectAllocation,
  getProjects
} from '../../../lib/data';

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  if (req.method === 'POST') {
    try {
      const { sourceMonth, sourceYear, targetMonth, targetYear } = req.body;
      
      // Validate required fields
      if (!sourceMonth || !sourceYear || !targetMonth || !targetYear) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Source and target month/year are required' });
      }

      // Validate that source and target aren't the same
      if (sourceMonth === targetMonth && sourceYear === targetYear) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Source and target months cannot be the same' });
      }

      // Get all projects
      const projects = await getProjects();
      
      if (projects.length === 0) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'No projects found in the system' });
      }

      // Copy allocations for each project from source to target month/year
      const copyResults = [];
      let hasSourceAllocations = false;
      
      for (const project of projects) {
        try {
          // Check if source allocation exists
          const sourceAllocation = await getProjectAllocation(
            project.id,
            sourceMonth,
            sourceYear
          );
          
          if (sourceAllocation) {
            hasSourceAllocations = true;
            // Copy allocation to target month/year
            const result = await copyAllocationFromMonth(
              project.id,
              sourceMonth,
              sourceYear,
              targetMonth,
              targetYear
            );
            
            if (result) {
              copyResults.push({
                projectId: project.id,
                projectName: project.name,
                success: true,
                allocationId: result.id
              });
            } else {
              copyResults.push({
                projectId: project.id,
                projectName: project.name,
                success: false
              });
            }
          } else {
            // Add project to results even if it has no allocation in source month
            copyResults.push({
              projectId: project.id,
              projectName: project.name,
              success: false,
              noSourceAllocation: true
            });
          }
        } catch (error) {
          console.error(`Error processing project ${project.id}:`, error);
          copyResults.push({
            projectId: project.id,
            projectName: project.name,
            success: false,
            error: error.message
          });
        }
      }

      res.status(200).json({
        results: copyResults,
        hasSourceAllocations,
        successCount: copyResults.filter(r => r.success).length
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error copying project allocations:', error);
      res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to copy project allocations' });
    }
  } else {
    res.setHeader('Allow', ['POST']);
    res.status(405).end(`Method ${req.method} Not Allowed`);
  }
}

export default async function handler(req, res) {

    try {
      const members = await getProjectMembers(id);
      res.status(200).json(members);
    } catch (error) {

      res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to fetch project members' });
    }
  } else if (req.method === 'POST') {

        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Employee ID is required' });
      }

      if (result) {
        res.status(200).json({ message: 'Member added successfully' });

        res.status(400).json({ error: 'Failed to add member' });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error adding project member:', error);
      res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to add project member' });
    }
  } else if (req.method === 'DELETE') {
    try {
      const { employeeId } = req.body;
      
      if (!employeeId) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Employee ID is required' });
      }

      const result = await removeProjectMember(id, employeeId);
      if (result) {
        res.status(200).json({ message: 'Member removed successfully' });
      } else {
        res.status(400).json({ error: 'Failed to remove member' });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error removing project member:', error);
      res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to remove project member' });
    }
  } else {
    res.setHeader('Allow', ['GET', 'POST', 'DELETE']);
    res.status(405).end(`Method ${req.method} Not Allowed`);
  }
}

export async function getServerSideProps() {
  // Import database functions only on server-side
  const { 
    getDepartments, 
    getEmployees 
  } = require('../../lib/data');

  try {
    const [departments, employees] = await Promise.all([
      getDepartments(),
      getEmployees()
    ]);

    // Calculate member counts and serialize dates
    const enhancedDepartments = Array.isArray(departments) ? departments.map(dept => {
      const memberCount = employees.filter(emp => emp.department_id === dept.id || emp.departmentId === dept.id).length;
      return {
        ...dept,
        memberCount,
        created_at: dept.created_at ? dept.created_at.toISOString() : null,
        updated_at: dept.updated_at ? dept.updated_at.toISOString() : null
      };
    }) : [];

    return {
      props: {
        initialDepartments: enhancedDepartments
      }
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching departments data:', error);
    return {
      props: {
        initialDepartments: []
      }
    };
  }
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/router';
import { FiLayers, FiFolderPlus, FiPlus, FiSearch, FiFilter, FiX, FiEdit, FiTrash2, FiEye, FiUsers } from 'react-icons/fi';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { Button } from '../../components/Button';
import { Input } from '../../components/Input';
import { Select } from '../../components/Select';
import { Card } from '../../components/Card';
import { EmptyState } from '../../components/EmptyState';
import { Modal } from '../../components/Modal';

export default function Departments({ initialDepartments }) {
  const [departments, setDepartments] = useState(initialDepartments);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [isDeleteModalOpen, setIsDeleteModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [departmentToDelete, setDepartmentToDelete] = useState(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);

  const refreshDepartments = async () => {
    try {
      setIsLoading(true);
      const response = await fetch('/api/departments');
      if (response.ok) {
        const deptData = await response.json();
        setDepartments(deptData);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to refresh departments:', error);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSearchChange = (e) => {
    setSearchQuery(e.target.value);
  };

  const handleDeleteClick = (department) => {
    setDepartmentToDelete(department);
    setIsDeleteModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleEditClick = (department) => {
    // Navigate to edit page
    window.location.href = `/departments/${department.id}/edit`;
  };

  const confirmDelete = async () => {
    if (!departmentToDelete) return;
    
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`/api/departments/${departmentToDelete.id}`, {
        method: 'DELETE'
      });
      
      if (response.ok) {
        toast.success(`${departmentToDelete.name} has been deleted`);
        await refreshDepartments();
      } else {
        toast.error('Failed to delete department');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('An error occurred while deleting');
      console.error(error);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
      setIsDeleteModalOpen(false);
      setDepartmentToDelete(null);
    }
  };

  // Filter departments based on search
  const filteredDepartments = departments.filter(dept =>
    dept.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase())
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 fade-in">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">Departments</h1>
        <Link href="/departments/new">
          <a>
            <Button className="w-full sm:w-auto flex items-center justify-center">
              <FiFolderPlus className="mr-2" />
              Add Department
            </Button>
          </a>
        </Link>
      </div>

      {/* Search */}
      <div className="relative">
        <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-gray-400">
          <FiSearch />
        </div>
        <Input
          type="text"
          placeholder="Search departments..."
          value={searchQuery}
          onChange={handleSearchChange}
          className="pl-10"
        />
      </div>

      {/* Department Grid */}
      {isLoading ? (
        <div className="flex justify-center items-center h-64">
          <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-t-2 border-b-2 border-primary-600"></div>
        </div>
      ) : departments.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState 
          title="No departments yet"
          description="Get started by creating your first department"
          action={() => window.location.href = '/departments/new'}
        />
      ) : filteredDepartments.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState 
          title="No matching departments"
          description="Try a different search term"
          action={() => setSearchQuery('')}
          actionText="Clear Search"
        />
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          {filteredDepartments.map((dept) => (
            <Card
              key={dept.id}
              className="transition-all duration-300 hover:shadow-md hover:border-primary-200"
            >
              <Card.Header>
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                  <Card.Title>{dept.name}</Card.Title>
                  <div className="flex items-center text-sm text-gray-500">
                    <FiUsers className="mr-1" />
                    <span>{dept.memberCount} members</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </Card.Header>
              <Card.Content>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">Department ID</p>
                    <p className="font-medium">{dept.id}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">Created</p>
                    <p className="text-sm">{new Date(dept.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </Card.Content>
              <Card.Footer>
                <div className="flex justify-end space-x-2">
                  <Link href={`/departments/${dept.id}`}>
                    <a>
                      <Button variant="outline" size="sm">
                        <FiEye className="mr-1" />
                        View
                      </Button>
                    </a>
                  </Link>
                  <Button 
                    variant="outline" 
                    size="sm" 
                    onClick={() => handleEditClick(dept)}
                  >
                    <FiEdit className="mr-1" />
                    Edit
                  </Button>
                  <Button 
                    variant="outline" 
                    size="sm" 
                    className="text-red-600 border-red-200 hover:bg-red-50"
                    onClick={() => handleDeleteClick(dept)}
                  >
                    <FiTrash2 className="mr-1" />
                    Delete
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </Card.Footer>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Delete Confirmation Modal */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={isDeleteModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsDeleteModalOpen(false)}
        title="Delete Department"
        description="Are you sure you want to delete this department? This action cannot be undone."
        footer={
          <>
            <Button 
              variant="outline" 
              onClick={() => setIsDeleteModalOpen(false)}
              disabled={isLoading}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button 
              variant="destructive" 
              onClick={confirmDelete}
              disabled={isLoading}
            >
              {isLoading ? 'Deleting...' : 'Delete'}
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        {departmentToDelete && (
          <div className="text-sm text-gray-500">
            <p>
              This will permanently delete the department 
              <span className="font-semibold text-gray-700"> {departmentToDelete.name} </span>
              and remove all department associations from employees.
            </p>
            <p className="mt-2">
              The employees will not be deleted, but they will no longer be associated with this department.
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

export async function getServerSideProps() {
  // Import database functions only on server-side
  const { getEmployees } = require('../../lib/data');

  try {
    const employeeData = await getEmployees();
    
    // Serialize dates
    const serializedEmployees = Array.isArray(employeeData) ? employeeData.map(emp => ({
      ...emp,
      created_at: emp.created_at ? emp.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: emp.updated_at ? emp.updated_at.toISOString() : null
    })) : [];

    return {
      props: {
        employees: serializedEmployees
      }
    };
  } catch (error) {

    return {
      props: {

      }

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/router';
import { FiArrowLeft, FiSave, FiPlus, FiX } from 'react-icons/fi';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { Button } from '../../components/Button';
import { Input } from '../../components/Input';
import { Select } from '../../components/Select';
import { Label } from '../../components/Label';
import { Card } from '../../components/Card';
import { Avatar } from '../../components/Avatar';

export default function NewDepartment({ employees }) {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: '',
    teamLeadIds: []
  });
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [teamLeads, setTeamLeads] = useState([]);
  const router = useRouter();

  const validateForm = () => {
    const newErrors = {};
    
    if (!formData.name.trim()) {
      newErrors.name = 'Department name is required';
    }
    
    setErrors(newErrors);
    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;
  };

  const handleChange = (e) => {
    const { name, value } = e.target;
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: value }));
    
    // Clear error when field is edited
    if (errors[name]) {
      setErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: undefined }));
    }
  };

  const handleAddTeamLead = (e) => {
    const leadId = e.target.value;
    if (!leadId) return;
    
    // Check if already in the list
    if (formData.teamLeadIds.includes(leadId)) {
      toast.info('This employee is already a team lead for this department');
      return;
    }
    
    setFormData(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      teamLeadIds: [...prev.teamLeadIds, leadId]
    }));
    
    // Update team leads display list
    const employee = employees.find(emp => emp.id === leadId);
    if (employee) {
      setTeamLeads(prev => [...prev, employee]);
    }
    
    // Reset select
    e.target.value = '';
  };

  const handleRemoveTeamLead = (leadId) => {
    setFormData(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      teamLeadIds: prev.teamLeadIds.filter(id => id !== leadId)
    }));
    
    setTeamLeads(prev => prev.filter(lead => lead.id !== leadId));
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if (!validateForm()) return;
    
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/departments', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(formData),
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        const newDepartment = await response.json();
        toast.success(`Department "${newDepartment.name}" has been created`);
        router.push('/departments');
      } else {
        const error = await response.json();
        throw new Error(error.message || 'Failed to create department');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to create department:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to create department');
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto fade-in">
      <div className="mb-6">
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          onClick={() => router.push('/departments')}
          className="mb-2"
        >
          <FiArrowLeft className="mr-2" />
          Back to Departments
        </Button>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">Create New Department</h1>
      </div>

      <Card>
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
          <Card.Content className="space-y-6">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="name">
                Department Name <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="name"
                name="name"
                value={formData.name}
                onChange={handleChange}
                placeholder="e.g. Engineering, Marketing, HR"
                className={errors.name ? 'border-red-500' : ''}
              />
              {errors.name && (
                <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-1">{errors.name}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="teamLeads">Team Leads</Label>
              <Select
                id="teamLeads"
                onChange={handleAddTeamLead}
                defaultValue=""
              >
                <option value="">-- Select Team Lead to Add --</option>
                {employees.map(emp => (
                  <option 
                    key={emp.id} 
                    value={emp.id}
                    disabled={formData.teamLeadIds.includes(emp.id)}
                  >
                    {emp.name} - {emp.designation}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </Select>
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">
                You can assign one or more team leads now or update it later.
              </p>
              
              {teamLeads.length > 0 && (
                <div className="mt-4">
                  <Label>Selected Team Leads</Label>
                  <div className="space-y-2 mt-2">
                    {teamLeads.map(lead => (
                      <div key={lead.id} className="flex items-center justify-between p-2 bg-gray-50 rounded-md">
                        <div className="flex items-center">
                          <Avatar 
                            fallback={lead.name} 
                            size="sm" 
                            className="mr-2"
                          />
                          <span>{lead.name}</span>
                        </div>
                        <Button 
                          variant="ghost" 
                          size="sm" 
                          onClick={() => handleRemoveTeamLead(lead.id)}
                          className="text-red-500 hover:text-red-700 hover:bg-red-50 h-8 w-8 p-0"
                        >
                          <FiX className="h-4 w-4" />
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </Card.Content>

          <Card.Footer className="flex justify-end space-x-2 border-t pt-6">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => router.push('/departments')}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="submit"
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              className="flex items-center"
            >
              <FiSave className="mr-2" />
              {isSubmitting ? 'Creating...' : 'Create Department'}
            </Button>
          </Card.Footer>
        </form>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
