export async function getServerSideProps(context) {
  // Import database functions only on server-side
  const { 
    getDepartmentById, 
    getEmployees,
    getDepartmentTeamLeads
  } = require('../../../lib/data');
  const { id } = context.params;

  try {
    const [departmentData, employeeData, teamLeadData] = await Promise.all([
      getDepartmentById(id),
      getEmployees(),
      getDepartmentTeamLeads(id)
    ]);
    
    if (!departmentData) {
      return {
        notFound: true
      };
    }
    
    // Serialize dates
    const serializedDepartment = {
      ...departmentData,
      created_at: departmentData.created_at ? departmentData.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: departmentData.updated_at ? departmentData.updated_at.toISOString() : null
    };

    const serializedEmployees = employeeData.map(emp => ({
      ...emp,
      created_at: emp.created_at ? emp.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: emp.updated_at ? emp.updated_at.toISOString() : null
    }));

    const serializedTeamLeads = teamLeadData.map(lead => ({
      ...lead,
      created_at: lead.created_at ? lead.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: lead.updated_at ? lead.updated_at.toISOString() : null
    }));

    const teamLeadIds = teamLeadData.map(lead => lead.id);

    return {
      props: {
        department: serializedDepartment,
        employees: serializedEmployees,
        teamLeads: serializedTeamLeads,
        teamLeadIds
      }
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching department data:', error);
    return {
      notFound: true
    };
  }
}

export async function getServerSideProps(context) {
  // Import database functions only on server-side
  const { 
    getDepartmentById, 
    getDepartmentMembers, 
    getDepartmentTeamLeads,
    getEmployees
  } = require('../../../lib/data');
  const { id } = context.params;

  try {
    const [deptData, memberData, teamLeadData, allEmployees] = await Promise.all([
      getDepartmentById(id),
      getDepartmentMembers(id),
      getDepartmentTeamLeads(id),
      getEmployees()
    ]);
    
    if (!deptData) {
      return {
        notFound: true
      };
    }
    
    // Get available employees (employees not in this department)
    const availableEmps = allEmployees.filter(emp => emp.departmentId !== id && emp.department_id !== id);
    
    // Serialize dates
    const serializedDepartment = {
      ...deptData,
      created_at: deptData.created_at ? deptData.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: deptData.updated_at ? deptData.updated_at.toISOString() : null
    };

    const serializedMembers = memberData.map(member => ({
      ...member,
      created_at: member.created_at ? member.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: member.updated_at ? member.updated_at.toISOString() : null
    }));

    const serializedTeamLeads = teamLeadData.map(lead => ({
      ...lead,
      created_at: lead.created_at ? lead.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: lead.updated_at ? lead.updated_at.toISOString() : null
    }));

    const serializedAvailableEmployees = availableEmps.map(emp => ({
      ...emp,
      created_at: emp.created_at ? emp.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: emp.updated_at ? emp.updated_at.toISOString() : null
    }));

    return {
      props: {
        department: serializedDepartment,
        members: serializedMembers,
        teamLeads: serializedTeamLeads,
        availableEmployees: serializedAvailableEmployees
      }
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching department data:', error);
    return {
      notFound: true
    };
  }
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/router';
import Link from 'next/link';

export default function DepartmentDetails({ department: initialDepartment, members: initialMembers, teamLeads: initialTeamLeads, availableEmployees: initialAvailableEmployees }) {
  const [department, setDepartment] = useState(initialDepartment);
  const [members, setMembers] = useState(initialMembers);
  const [teamLeads, setTeamLeads] = useState(initialTeamLeads);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [isDeleteModalOpen, setIsDeleteModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isDeleting, setIsDeleting] = useState(false);
  const [isAddEmployeeModalOpen, setIsAddEmployeeModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [availableEmployees, setAvailableEmployees] = useState(initialAvailableEmployees);
  const [selectedEmployeeId, setSelectedEmployeeId] = useState('');
  const [isAddingEmployee, setIsAddingEmployee] = useState(false);
  const [isRemoveMemberModalOpen, setIsRemoveMemberModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [memberToRemove, setMemberToRemove] = useState(null);
  const [isRemovingMember, setIsRemovingMember] = useState(false);
  const [isRemoveTeamLeadModalOpen, setIsRemoveTeamLeadModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [teamLeadToRemove, setTeamLeadToRemove] = useState(null);
  const router = useRouter();
  const { id } = router.query;

  const loadDepartmentData = async () => {
    try {
      // Refresh data via API calls
      const response = await fetch(`/api/departments/${id}`);
      if (response.ok) {
        const deptData = await response.json();
        setDepartment(deptData);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to load department data:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to load department data');
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    setIsDeleting(true);
    
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`/api/departments/${id}`, {
        method: 'DELETE'
      });
      
      if (response.ok) {
        toast.success(`Department "${department.name}" has been deleted`);
        router.push('/departments');
      } else {
        throw new Error('Failed to delete department');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to delete department:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to delete department');
      setIsDeleting(false);
      setIsDeleteModalOpen(false);
    }
  };

  const handleAddEmployeeClick = () => {
    setSelectedEmployeeId('');
    setIsAddEmployeeModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleEmployeeSelect = (e) => {
    setSelectedEmployeeId(e.target.value);
  };

  const handleAddEmployee = async () => {
    if (!selectedEmployeeId) {
      toast.error('Please select an employee');
      return;
    }

    setIsAddingEmployee(true);
    try {
      // First, get the current employee data
      const employeeResponse = await fetch(`/api/employees/${selectedEmployeeId}`);
      if (!employeeResponse.ok) {
        throw new Error('Failed to fetch employee data');
      }
      
      const currentEmployee = await employeeResponse.json();
      
      // Update the employee's department with all required fields
      const response = await fetch(`/api/employees/${selectedEmployeeId}`, {
        method: 'PUT',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          name: currentEmployee.name,
          email: currentEmployee.email,
          phoneNumber: currentEmployee.phoneNumber || currentEmployee.phone_number,
          designation: currentEmployee.designation,
          jobRole: currentEmployee.jobRole || currentEmployee.job_role,
          departmentId: id
        }),
      });
      
      if (response.ok) {
        const updatedEmployee = await response.json();
        toast.success(`${updatedEmployee.name} has been added to this department`);
        setIsAddEmployeeModalOpen(false);
        
        // Update the local state
        setMembers(prev => [...prev, updatedEmployee]);
        setAvailableEmployees(prev => prev.filter(emp => emp.id !== selectedEmployeeId));
        
        await loadDepartmentData(); // Reload department data
      } else {
        const errorData = await response.json();
        toast.error(errorData.error || 'Failed to add employee to department');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to add employee:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to add employee to department');
    } finally {
      setIsAddingEmployee(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRemoveTeamLeadClick = (teamLead) => {
    setTeamLeadToRemove(teamLead);
    setIsRemoveTeamLeadModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleRemoveTeamLead = async () => {
    if (!teamLeadToRemove) return;

    try {
      // Remove team lead via API call - this would need to be implemented
      toast.success(`${teamLeadToRemove.name} has been removed as a team lead`);
      setIsRemoveTeamLeadModalOpen(false);
      await loadDepartmentData(); // Reload department data
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to remove team lead:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to remove team lead');
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex justify-center items-center h-64">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-t-2 border-b-2 border-primary-600"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!department) {
    return (
      <div className="text-center py-12">
        <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold mb-2">Department not found</h2>
        <p className="text-gray-500 mb-6">The department you're looking for doesn't exist or has been removed.</p>
        <Link href="/departments">
          <a>
            <Button>Return to Departments</Button>
          </a>
        </Link>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 fade-in">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => router.push('/departments')}
            className="mb-2"
          >
            <FiArrowLeft className="mr-2" />
            Back to Departments
          </Button>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">{department.name}</h1>
        </div>
        <div className="flex space-x-2">
          <Link href={`/departments/${id}/edit`}>
            <a>
              <Button variant="outline" className="flex items-center">
                <FiEdit className="mr-2" />
                Edit
              </Button>
            </a>
          </Link>
          <Button 
            variant="outline" 
            className="flex items-center text-red-600 border-red-200 hover:bg-red-50"
            onClick={() => setIsDeleteModalOpen(true)}
          >
            <FiTrash2 className="mr-2" />
            Delete
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Department Info */}
        <Card className="lg:col-span-1">
          <Card.Header>
            <Card.Title>Department Info</Card.Title>
          </Card.Header>
          <Card.Content>
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-500">Name</h3>
                <p className="mt-1">{department.name}</p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-500">Members</h3>
                <p className="mt-1">{members.length} employee{members.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-500">Team Leads</h3>
                <p className="mt-1">{teamLeads.length} lead{teamLeads.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </Card.Content>
        </Card>

        {/* Team Leads */}
        <Card className="lg:col-span-2">
          <Card.Header>
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
              <Card.Title>Team Leads</Card.Title>
              <Link href={`/departments/${id}/edit`}>
                <a>
                  <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">
                    Manage Team Leads
                  </Button>
                </a>
              </Link>
            </div>
          </Card.Header>
          <Card.Content>
            {teamLeads.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="text-center py-6 text-gray-500">
                <FiUser className="mx-auto h-12 w-12 text-gray-400 mb-3" />

                <Link href={`/departments/${id}/edit`}>

            </p>
            <p className="mt-2">
              The employee will still remain a member of the department, but will no longer have team lead privileges.
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

export async function getServerSideProps() {
  // Import database functions only on server-side
  const { 
    getEmployees, 
    getDepartments 
  } = require('../../lib/data');

  try {
    const [employees, departments] = await Promise.all([
      getEmployees(),
      getDepartments()
    ]);

    // Serialize dates
    const serializedEmployees = Array.isArray(employees) ? employees.map(emp => ({
      ...emp,
      created_at: emp.created_at ? emp.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: emp.updated_at ? emp.updated_at.toISOString() : null
    })) : [];

    const serializedDepartments = Array.isArray(departments) ? departments.map(dept => ({
      ...dept,
      created_at: dept.created_at ? dept.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: dept.updated_at ? dept.updated_at.toISOString() : null
    })) : [];

    return {
      props: {
        initialEmployees: serializedEmployees,
        initialDepartments: serializedDepartments
      }
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching employees data:', error);
    return {
      props: {
        initialEmployees: [],
        initialDepartments: []
      }
    };
  }
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/router';
import { FiUsers, FiUserPlus, FiPlus, FiSearch, FiFilter, FiX, FiEdit, FiTrash2, FiEye, FiChevronDown, FiChevronUp } from 'react-icons/fi';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { Button } from '../../components/Button';
import { Input } from '../../components/Input';
import { Select } from '../../components/Select';
import { Card } from '../../components/Card';
import { Avatar } from '../../components/Avatar';
import { EmptyState } from '../../components/EmptyState';
import { Modal } from '../../components/Modal';

export default function Employees({ initialEmployees, initialDepartments }) {
  const [employees, setEmployees] = useState(initialEmployees);
  const [departments, setDepartments] = useState(initialDepartments);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [departmentFilter, setDepartmentFilter] = useState('');
  const [isDeleteModalOpen, setIsDeleteModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [employeeToDelete, setEmployeeToDelete] = useState(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [expandedEmployee, setExpandedEmployee] = useState(null);

  const refreshData = async () => {
    try {
      // Use API routes for client-side data updates
      const [employeesRes, departmentsRes] = await Promise.all([
        fetch('/api/employees'),
        fetch('/api/departments')
      ]);
      
      if (employeesRes.ok && departmentsRes.ok) {
        const employeeData = await employeesRes.json();
        const departmentData = await departmentsRes.json();
        
        setEmployees(employeeData);
        setDepartments(departmentData);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to refresh data:', error);
    }
  };

  const handleSearchChange = (e) => {
    setSearchQuery(e.target.value);
  };

  const handleDepartmentFilterChange = (e) => {
    setDepartmentFilter(e.target.value);
  };

  const clearFilters = () => {
    setSearchQuery('');
    setDepartmentFilter('');
  };

  const handleDeleteClick = (employee) => {
    setEmployeeToDelete(employee);
    setIsDeleteModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleEditClick = (employee) => {
    // Navigate to edit page
    window.location.href = `/employees/${employee.id}/edit`;
  };

  const confirmDelete = async () => {
    if (!employeeToDelete) return;
    
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`/api/employees/${employeeToDelete.id}`, {
        method: 'DELETE'
      });
      
      if (response.ok) {
        toast.success(`${employeeToDelete.name} has been deleted`);
        await refreshData();
      } else {
        toast.error('Failed to delete employee');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('An error occurred while deleting');
      console.error(error);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
      setIsDeleteModalOpen(false);
      setEmployeeToDelete(null);
    }
  };

  const toggleEmployeeDetails = (employeeId) => {
    if (expandedEmployee === employeeId) {
      setExpandedEmployee(null);
    } else {
      setExpandedEmployee(employeeId);
    }
  };

  // Filter employees based on search and department filter
  const filteredEmployees = employees.filter(emp => {
    const matchesSearch = emp.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
                          emp.email.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
                          emp.designation.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
    
    const matchesDepartment = !departmentFilter || emp.departmentId === departmentFilter || emp.department_id === departmentFilter;
    
    return matchesSearch && matchesDepartment;
  });

  const hasActiveFilters = searchQuery || departmentFilter;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 fade-in">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">Employees</h1>
        <Link href="/employees/new">
          <a>
            <Button className="w-full sm:w-auto flex items-center justify-center">
              <FiUserPlus className="mr-2" />
              Add Employee
            </Button>
          </a>
        </Link>
      </div>

      {/* Search and Filter */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        <div className="sm:col-span-2 relative">
          <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-gray-400">
            <FiSearch />
          </div>
          <Input
            type="text"
            placeholder="Search employees by name, email, or designation..."
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={handleSearchChange}
            className="pl-10"
          />
        </div>
        
        <div className="relative">
          <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-gray-400">
            <FiFilter />
          </div>
          <Select
            value={departmentFilter}
            onChange={handleDepartmentFilterChange}
            className="pl-10"
          >
            <option value="">All Departments</option>
            {departments.map(dept => (
              <option key={dept.id} value={dept.id}>
                {dept.name}
              </option>
            ))}
          </Select>
        </div>
      </div>
      
      {/* Filter indicator */}
      {hasActiveFilters && (
        <div className="flex items-center bg-gray-100 px-4 py-2 rounded-md">
          <span className="text-sm text-gray-600 mr-2">Filters applied:</span>
          {searchQuery && (
            <span className="bg-primary-100 text-primary-800 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-full flex items-center mr-2">
              Search: "{searchQuery}"
              <button 
                onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')}
                className="ml-1 text-primary-600 hover:text-primary-800"
              >
                <FiX size={14} />
              </button>
            </span>
          )}
          {departmentFilter && (
            <span className="bg-primary-100 text-primary-800 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-full flex items-center mr-2">
              Department: {departments.find(d => d.id === departmentFilter)?.name}
              <button 
                onClick={() => setDepartmentFilter('')}
                className="ml-1 text-primary-600 hover:text-primary-800"
              >
                <FiX size={14} />
              </button>
            </span>
          )}
          <button 
            onClick={clearFilters}
            className="text-xs text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 ml-auto"
          >
            Clear all
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Employee List */}
      {employees.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState 
          title="No employees yet"
          description="Get started by adding your first employee"
          action={() => window.location.href = '/employees/new'}
        />
      ) : filteredEmployees.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState 
          title="No matching employees"
          description="Try different search terms or filters"
          action={clearFilters}
          actionText="Clear Filters"
        />
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {filteredEmployees.map((employee) => (
            <Card key={employee.id} className="overflow-hidden">
              <div 
                onClick={() => toggleEmployeeDetails(employee.id)}
                className="p-4 flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center">
                  <Avatar 
                    fallback={employee.name} 
                    size="md" 
                    className="mr-4"
                  />
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="font-medium">{employee.name}</h3>
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">{employee.designation}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center">
                  <span className="text-sm text-gray-500 mr-3">
                    {employee.department ? employee.department.name : 'No Department'}
                  </span>
                  {expandedEmployee === employee.id ? (
                    <FiChevronUp className="text-gray-400" />
                  ) : (
                    <FiChevronDown className="text-gray-400" />
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
              
              {expandedEmployee === employee.id && (
                <div className="border-t border-gray-100 p-4 bg-gray-50 fade-in">
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      <div>
                        <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Email</p>
                        <p className="text-sm">{employee.email}</p>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Phone</p>
                        <p className="text-sm">{employee.phoneNumber}</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      <div>
                        <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Department</p>
                        <p className="text-sm">{employee.department ? employee.department.name : 'None'}</p>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Employee ID</p>
                        <p className="text-sm">{employee.id}</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  
                  <div className="flex justify-end mt-4 space-x-2">
                    <Button 
                      variant="outline" 
                      size="sm" 
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        handleEditClick(employee);
                      }}
                    >
                      Edit
                    </Button>
                    <Button 
                      variant="outline" 
                      size="sm" 
                      className="text-red-600 border-red-200 hover:bg-red-50"
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        handleDeleteClick(employee);
                      }}
                    >
                      Delete
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Delete Confirmation Modal */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={isDeleteModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsDeleteModalOpen(false)}
        title="Delete Employee"
        description="Are you sure you want to delete this employee? This action cannot be undone."
        footer={
          <>
            <Button 
              variant="outline" 
              onClick={() => setIsDeleteModalOpen(false)}
              disabled={isLoading}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button 
              variant="destructive" 
              onClick={confirmDelete}
              disabled={isLoading}
            >
              {isLoading ? 'Deleting...' : 'Delete'}
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        {employeeToDelete && (
          <div className="text-sm text-gray-500">
            <p>
              This will permanently delete the employee 
              <span className="font-semibold text-gray-700"> {employeeToDelete.name} </span>
              from the system.
            </p>
            {employeeToDelete.department && (
              <p className="mt-2">
                They will also be removed from the {employeeToDelete.department.name} department.
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

export async function getServerSideProps() {
  // Import database functions only on server-side
  const { getDepartments } = require('../../lib/data');

  try {
    const departmentData = await getDepartments();
    
    // Serialize dates
    const serializedDepartments = Array.isArray(departmentData) ? departmentData.map(dept => ({
      ...dept,
      created_at: dept.created_at ? dept.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: dept.updated_at ? dept.updated_at.toISOString() : null
    })) : [];

    return {
      props: {
        departments: serializedDepartments
      }
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching departments:', error);
    return {
      props: {
        departments: []
      }
    };
  }
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/router';
import { FiArrowLeft, FiSave } from 'react-icons/fi';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { Button } from '../../components/Button';
import { Input } from '../../components/Input';
import { Select } from '../../components/Select';
import { Label } from '../../components/Label';
import { Card } from '../../components/Card';
import { getJobRoles } from '../../lib/utils';

export default function NewEmployee({ departments }) {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: '',
    email: '',
    departmentId: '',
    phoneNumber: '',
    designation: '',
    jobRole: 'employee'
  });
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const router = useRouter();
  const jobRoles = getJobRoles();

  const validateForm = () => {
    const newErrors = {};
    
    if (!formData.name.trim()) {
      newErrors.name = 'Name is required';
    }
    
    if (!formData.email.trim()) {
      newErrors.email = 'Email is required';
    } else if (!/\S+@\S+\.\S+/.test(formData.email)) {
      newErrors.email = 'Email is invalid';
    }
    
    if (!formData.phoneNumber.trim()) {
      newErrors.phoneNumber = 'Phone number is required';
    }
    
    if (!formData.designation.trim()) {
      newErrors.designation = 'Designation is required';
    }
    
    if (!formData.jobRole) {
      newErrors.jobRole = 'Job role is required';
    }
    
    setErrors(newErrors);
    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;
  };

  const handleChange = (e) => {
    const { name, value } = e.target;
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: value }));
    
    // Clear error when field is edited
    if (errors[name]) {
      setErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: undefined }));
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if (!validateForm()) return;
    
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/employees', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(formData),
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        const newEmployee = await response.json();
        toast.success(`Employee "${newEmployee.name}" has been created`);
        router.push('/employees');
      } else {
        const errorData = await response.json();
        toast.error(errorData.error || 'Failed to create employee');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to create employee:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to create employee. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto fade-in">
      <div className="mb-6">
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          onClick={() => router.push('/employees')}
          className="mb-2"
        >
          <FiArrowLeft className="mr-2" />
          Back to Employees
        </Button>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">Add New Employee</h1>
      </div>

      <Card>
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
          <Card.Content className="space-y-6">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="name">
                Full Name <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="name"
                name="name"
                value={formData.name}
                onChange={handleChange}
                placeholder="John Doe"
                className={errors.name ? 'border-red-500' : ''}
              />
              {errors.name && (
                <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-1">{errors.name}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="email">
                Email <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="email"
                name="email"
                type="email"
                value={formData.email}
                onChange={handleChange}
                placeholder="john.doe@tericsoft.com"
                className={errors.email ? 'border-red-500' : ''}
              />
              {errors.email && (
                <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-1">{errors.email}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="phoneNumber">
                Phone Number <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="phoneNumber"
                name="phoneNumber"
                value={formData.phoneNumber}
                onChange={handleChange}
                placeholder="555-123-4567"
                className={errors.phoneNumber ? 'border-red-500' : ''}
              />
              {errors.phoneNumber && (
                <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-1">{errors.phoneNumber}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="designation">
                Designation <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="designation"
                name="designation"
                value={formData.designation}
                onChange={handleChange}
                placeholder="Software Engineer"
                className={errors.designation ? 'border-red-500' : ''}
              />
              {errors.designation && (
                <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-1">{errors.designation}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="jobRole">
                Job Role <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </Label>
              <Select
                id="jobRole"
                name="jobRole"
                value={formData.jobRole}
                onChange={handleChange}
                className={errors.jobRole ? 'border-red-500' : ''}
              >
                {jobRoles.map((role) => (
                  <option key={role.value} value={role.value}>
                    {role.label}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </Select>
              {errors.jobRole && (
                <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-1">{errors.jobRole}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="departmentId">Department</Label>
              <Select
                id="departmentId"
                name="departmentId"
                value={formData.departmentId}
                onChange={handleChange}
              >
                <option value="">-- Select Department (Optional) --</option>
                {Array.isArray(departments) && departments.map(dept => (
                  <option key={dept.id} value={dept.id}>
                    {dept.name}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </Select>
            </div>
          </Card.Content>

          <Card.Footer className="flex justify-end space-x-2 border-t pt-6">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => router.push('/employees')}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="submit"
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              className="flex items-center"
            >
              <FiSave className="mr-2" />
              {isSubmitting ? 'Creating...' : 'Create Employee'}
            </Button>
          </Card.Footer>
        </form>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/router';
import { FiArrowLeft, FiSave } from 'react-icons/fi';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { Button } from '../../../components/Button';
import { Input } from '../../../components/Input';
import { Select } from '../../../components/Select';
import { Label } from '../../../components/Label';
import { Card } from '../../../components/Card';
import { getJobRoles } from '../../../lib/utils';

export async function getServerSideProps(context) {
  // Import database functions only on server-side
  const { getEmployeeById, getDepartments } = require('../../../lib/data');
  const { id } = context.params;

  try {
    const [employeeData, departmentData] = await Promise.all([
      getEmployeeById(id),
      getDepartments()
    ]);
    
    if (!employeeData) {
      return {
        notFound: true
      };
    }
    
    // Serialize dates
    const serializedEmployee = {
      ...employeeData,
      created_at: employeeData.created_at ? employeeData.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: employeeData.updated_at ? employeeData.updated_at.toISOString() : null
    };

    const serializedDepartments = Array.isArray(departmentData) ? departmentData.map(dept => ({
      ...dept,
      created_at: dept.created_at ? dept.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: dept.updated_at ? dept.updated_at.toISOString() : null
    })) : [];

    return {
      props: {
        employee: serializedEmployee,
        departments: serializedDepartments
      }
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching employee data:', error);
    return {
      notFound: true
    };
  }
}

export default function EditEmployee({ employee, departments }) {

    phoneNumber: employee.phoneNumber || employee.phone_number,
    designation: employee.designation,
    jobRole: employee.jobRole || employee.job_role || 'employee'
  });
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const router = useRouter();
  const { id } = router.query;
  const jobRoles = getJobRoles();

  const validateForm = () => {
    const newErrors = {};
    
    if (!formData.name.trim()) {
      newErrors.name = 'Name is required';
    }

      newErrors.email = 'Email is required';
    } else if (!/\S+@\S+\.\S+/.test(formData.email)) {
      newErrors.email = 'Email is invalid';
    }
    
    if (!formData.phoneNumber.trim()) {
      newErrors.phoneNumber = 'Phone number is required';
    }
    
    if (!formData.designation.trim()) {
      newErrors.designation = 'Designation is required';
    }
    
    if (!formData.jobRole) {
      newErrors.jobRole = 'Job role is required';
    }
    
    setErrors(newErrors);
    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;
  };

  const handleChange = (e) => {
    const { name, value } = e.target;

    if (errors[name]) {
      setErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: undefined }));

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if (!validateForm()) return;
    
    setIsSubmitting(true);

        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',

        body: JSON.stringify(formData),

              <Label htmlFor="name">
                Full Name <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="name"
                name="name"
                value={formData.name}
                onChange={handleChange}
                placeholder="John Doe"
                className={errors.name ? 'border-red-500' : ''}
              />
              {errors.name && (
                <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-1">{errors.name}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="email">
                Email <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </Label>

                className={errors.email ? 'border-red-500' : ''}

            </div>

                Designation <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </Label>
              <Input

              />
              {errors.designation && (
                <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-1">{errors.designation}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="jobRole">
                Job Role <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </Label>
              <Select
                id="jobRole"
                name="jobRole"
                value={formData.jobRole}
                onChange={handleChange}
                className={errors.jobRole ? 'border-red-500' : ''}
              >
                {jobRoles.map((role) => (
                  <option key={role.value} value={role.value}>
                    {role.label}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </Select>
              {errors.jobRole && (
                <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-1">{errors.jobRole}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="departmentId">Department</Label>
              <Select
                id="departmentId"
                name="departmentId"
                value={formData.departmentId}
                onChange={handleChange}
              >
                <option value="">-- No Department --</option>
                {departments.map(dept => (
                  <option key={dept.id} value={dept.id}>
                    {dept.name}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </Select>
            </div>
          </Card.Content>

          <Card.Footer className="flex justify-end space-x-2 border-t pt-6">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => router.push(`/employees/${id}`)}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="submit"
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              className="flex items-center"
            >
              <FiSave className="mr-2" />
              {isSubmitting ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Changes'}
            </Button>
          </Card.Footer>
        </form>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/router';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { 
  FiArrowLeft, FiMail, FiPhone, FiBriefcase, 
  FiEdit, FiTrash2, FiCheck, FiX
} from 'react-icons/fi';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { 
  getEmployeeById, 
  getDepartmentById,
  deleteEmployee
} from '../../../lib/data';
import { Button } from '../../../components/Button';
import { Card } from '../../../components/Card';
import { Avatar } from '../../../components/Avatar';
import { Modal } from '../../../components/Modal';

export default function EmployeeDetails() {
  const [employee, setEmployee] = useState(null);
  const [department, setDepartment] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isDeleteModalOpen, setIsDeleteModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isDeleting, setIsDeleting] = useState(false);
  const router = useRouter();
  const { id } = router.query;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (id) {
      loadEmployeeData();
    }
  }, [id]);

  const loadEmployeeData = () => {
    try {
      const employeeData = getEmployeeById(id);
      
      if (!employeeData) {
        toast.error('Employee not found');
        router.push('/employees');
        return;
      }
      
      // Load department if exists
      let departmentData = null;
      if (employeeData.departmentId) {
        departmentData = getDepartmentById(employeeData.departmentId);
      }
      
      setEmployee(employeeData);
      setDepartment(departmentData);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to load employee data:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to load employee data');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    setIsDeleting(true);
    
    try {
      const success = deleteEmployee(id);
      
      if (success) {
        toast.success(`Employee "${employee.name}" has been deleted`);
        router.push('/employees');
      } else {
        throw new Error('Failed to delete employee');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to delete employee:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to delete employee');
      setIsDeleting(false);
      setIsDeleteModalOpen(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex justify-center items-center h-64">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-t-2 border-b-2 border-primary-600"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!employee) {
    return (
      <div className="text-center py-12">
        <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold mb-2">Employee not found</h2>
        <p className="text-gray-500 mb-6">The employee you're looking for doesn't exist or has been removed.</p>
        <Link href="/employees">
          <a>
            <Button>Return to Employees</Button>
          </a>
        </Link>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 fade-in">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => router.push('/employees')}
            className="mb-2"
          >
            <FiArrowLeft className="mr-2" />
            Back to Employees
          </Button>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">{employee.name}</h1>

            <div className="flex justify-center mb-4">

                fallback={employee.name} 
                size="xl" 
              />

                  <p className="font-medium">{employee.email}</p>

                <FiPhone className="text-gray-400 mr-3" />

                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">Phone</p>

                    <Link href={`/departments/${department.id}`}>
                      <a className="font-medium text-primary-600 hover:text-primary-700">
                        {department.name}
                      </a>

                  ) : (
                    <p className="text-gray-500">No department assigned</p>

            </div>
          </Card.Content>
        </Card>
      </div>

        description="Are you sure you want to delete this employee? This action cannot be undone."

              variant="outline"

              disabled={isDeleting}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button 
              variant="destructive" 
              onClick={handleDelete}
              disabled={isDeleting}
            >

          </>

          <p>

            <span className="font-semibold text-gray-700"> {employee.name} </span>

          </p>

              <p>
                This employee is currently the Team Lead for {department.name}.
                Deleting them will remove their team lead status.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

export async function getServerSideProps() {
  // Import database functions only on server-side
  const { getForms } = require('../../lib/data');

  try {
    const formsData = await getForms();
    
    // Serialize dates
    const serializedForms = Array.isArray(formsData) ? formsData.map(form => ({
      ...form,
      created_at: form.created_at ? form.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: form.updated_at ? form.updated_at.toISOString() : null,
      published_at: form.published_at ? form.published_at.toISOString() : null
    })) : [];

    return {
      props: {
        initialForms: serializedForms
      }
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching forms:', error);
    return {
      props: {
        initialForms: []
      }
    };
  }
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/router';
import { FiFileText, FiPlus, FiSearch, FiFilter, FiX, FiEdit, FiEdit2, FiTrash2, FiEye, FiCalendar, FiUsers } from 'react-icons/fi';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { Button } from '../../components/Button';
import { Input } from '../../components/Input';
import { Select } from '../../components/Select';
import { Card } from '../../components/Card';
import { EmptyState } from '../../components/EmptyState';
import { Modal } from '../../components/Modal';

export default function Forms({ initialForms }) {
  const [forms, setForms] = useState(initialForms);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState('');
  const [audienceFilter, setAudienceFilter] = useState('');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [isDeleteModalOpen, setIsDeleteModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [formToDelete, setFormToDelete] = useState(null);
  const [isDeleting, setIsDeleting] = useState(false);
  const router = useRouter();

  const refreshForms = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/forms');
      if (response.ok) {
        const formData = await response.json();
        setForms(formData);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to refresh forms:', error);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteClick = (form) => {
    setFormToDelete(form);
    setIsDeleteModalOpen(true);
  };

  const confirmDelete = async () => {
    if (!formToDelete) return;
    
    setIsDeleting(true);
    
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`/api/forms/${formToDelete.id}`, {
        method: 'DELETE'
      });
      
      if (response.ok) {
        toast.success(`Form "${formToDelete.title}" has been deleted`);
        await refreshForms();
      } else {
        toast.error('Failed to delete form');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('An error occurred while deleting');
      console.error(error);
    } finally {
      setIsDeleting(false);
      setIsDeleteModalOpen(false);
      setFormToDelete(null);
    }
  };

  const handleSearchChange = (e) => {
    setSearchQuery(e.target.value);
  };

  const handleStatusFilterChange = (e) => {
    setStatusFilter(e.target.value);
  };

  const handleAudienceFilterChange = (e) => {
    setAudienceFilter(e.target.value);
  };

  const clearFilters = () => {
    setSearchQuery('');
    setStatusFilter('');
    setAudienceFilter('');
  };

  // Filter forms based on search and filters
  const filteredForms = forms.filter(form => {
    const matchesSearch = form.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
                         (form.description && form.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()));
    
    const matchesStatus = !statusFilter || form.status === statusFilter;
    const matchesAudience = !audienceFilter || form.audience === audienceFilter;
    
    return matchesSearch && matchesStatus && matchesAudience;
  });

  const getStatusBadgeClass = (status) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'published':
        return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';
      case 'draft':
        return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800';
      case 'archived':
        return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';
      default:
        return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';
    }
  };

  const getAudienceLabel = (audience) => {
    switch (audience) {
      case 'employee':
        return 'Employee';
      case 'team_lead':
        return 'Team Lead';
      case 'project_manager':
        return 'Project Manager';
      case 'all':
        return 'All';
      default:
        return audience;
    }
  };

  const hasActiveFilters = searchQuery || statusFilter || audienceFilter;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 fade-in">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">Score Builder Forms</h1>
        <Link href="/forms/new">
          <a>
            <Button className="w-full sm:w-auto flex items-center justify-center">
              <FiPlus className="mr-2" />
              Create New Form
            </Button>
          </a>
        </Link>
      </div>

      {/* Search and Filter Controls */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        <div className="sm:col-span-1 relative">
          <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-gray-400">
            <FiSearch />
          </div>
          <Input
            type="text"
            placeholder="Search forms..."
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={handleSearchChange}
            className="pl-10"
          />
        </div>
        
        <div className="relative">
          <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-gray-400">
            <FiFilter />
          </div>
          <Select
            value={statusFilter}
            onChange={handleStatusFilterChange}
            className="pl-10"
          >
            <option value="">All Statuses</option>
            <option value="draft">Draft</option>
            <option value="published">Published</option>
            <option value="archived">Archived</option>
          </Select>
        </div>

        <div className="relative">
          <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-gray-400">
            <FiFilter />
          </div>
          <Select
            value={audienceFilter}
            onChange={handleAudienceFilterChange}
            className="pl-10"
          >
            <option value="">All Audiences</option>
            <option value="employee">Employee</option>
            <option value="team_lead">Team Lead</option>
            <option value="project_manager">Project Manager</option>
            <option value="all">All Users</option>
          </Select>
        </div>
      </div>
      
      {/* Filter indicator */}
      {hasActiveFilters && (
        <div className="flex items-center bg-gray-100 px-4 py-2 rounded-md">
          <span className="text-sm text-gray-600 mr-2">Filters applied:</span>
          {searchQuery && (
            <span className="bg-primary-100 text-primary-800 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-full flex items-center mr-2">
              Search: "{searchQuery}"
              <button 
                onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')}
                className="ml-1 text-primary-600 hover:text-primary-800"
              >
                <FiX size={14} />
              </button>
            </span>
          )}
          {statusFilter && (
            <span className="bg-primary-100 text-primary-800 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-full flex items-center mr-2">
              Status: {statusFilter.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + statusFilter.slice(1)}
              <button 
                onClick={() => setStatusFilter('')}
                className="ml-1 text-primary-600 hover:text-primary-800"
              >
                <FiX size={14} />
              </button>
            </span>
          )}
          {audienceFilter && (
            <span className="bg-primary-100 text-primary-800 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-full flex items-center mr-2">
              Audience: {getAudienceLabel(audienceFilter)}
              <button 
                onClick={() => setAudienceFilter('')}
                className="ml-1 text-primary-600 hover:text-primary-800"
              >
                <FiX size={14} />
              </button>
            </span>
          )}
          <button 
            onClick={clearFilters}
            className="text-xs text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 ml-auto"
          >
            Clear all
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Forms List */}
      {isLoading ? (
        <div className="flex justify-center items-center h-64">
          <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-t-2 border-b-2 border-primary-600"></div>
        </div>
      ) : forms.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState 
          title="No forms yet"
          description="Get started by creating your first score builder form"
          action={() => router.push('/forms/new')}
        />
      ) : filteredForms.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState 
          title="No matching forms"
          description="Try different search terms or filters"
          action={clearFilters}
          actionText="Clear Filters"
        />
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          {filteredForms.map((form) => (
            <Card key={form.id} className="h-full transition-all duration-300 hover:shadow-md hover:border-primary-200">
              <Card.Header>
                <div className="flex justify-between items-start">
                  <div>
                    <Card.Title className="truncate">{form.title}</Card.Title>
                    <span className={`inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium mt-2 ${getStatusBadgeClass(form.status)}`}>
                      {form.status.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + form.status.slice(1)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex space-x-1">
                    <Button 
                      variant="ghost" 
                      size="sm" 
                      onClick={() => router.push(`/forms/${form.id}/preview`)}
                      className="h-7 w-7 p-0"
                      aria-label="Preview form"
                    >
                      <FiEye className="h-4 w-4" />
                    </Button>
                    <Button 
                      variant="ghost" 
                      size="sm" 
                      onClick={() => router.push(`/forms/${form.id}/edit`)}
                      className="h-7 w-7 p-0"
                      aria-label="Edit form"
                    >
                      <FiEdit2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                    </Button>
                    <Button 
                      variant="ghost" 
                      size="sm" 
                      onClick={() => handleDeleteClick(form)}
                      className="h-7 w-7 p-0 text-red-500 hover:text-red-700 hover:bg-red-50"
                      aria-label="Delete form"
                    >
                      <FiTrash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </Card.Header>
              
              <Card.Content>
                {form.description && (
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 line-clamp-2 mb-4">{form.description}</p>
                )}

                  <div className="flex justify-between">
