import { useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/router';
import { FiArrowLeft, FiSave, FiPlus, FiTrash2, FiEye, FiCheck, FiEdit2 } from 'react-icons/fi';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { Button } from '../../components/Button';
import { Input } from '../../components/Input';
import { Select } from '../../components/Select';
import { Label } from '../../components/Label';
import { Card } from '../../components/Card';
import { Modal } from '../../components/Modal';

export default function NewForm() {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    title: '',
    description: '',
    frequency: 'once',
    audience: 'all',
    status: 'draft'
  });
  
  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState([]);
  const [currentQuestion, setCurrentQuestion] = useState({
    question_text: '',
    question_type: 'short_text',
    is_required: false,
    options: []
  });
  
  const [isAddingQuestion, setIsAddingQuestion] = useState(false);
  const [editingQuestionIndex, setEditingQuestionIndex] = useState(null);
  const [currentOption, setCurrentOption] = useState('');
  const [isPreviewModalOpen, setIsPreviewModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  
  const router = useRouter();

  const questionTypes = [
    { value: 'short_text', label: 'Short Text' },
    { value: 'long_text', label: 'Long Text' },
    { value: 'multiple_choice', label: 'Multiple Choice' },
    { value: 'checkbox', label: 'Checkboxes' },
    { value: 'dropdown', label: 'Dropdown' },
    { value: 'linear_scale', label: 'Linear Scale' },
    { value: 'date', label: 'Date' },
    { value: 'time', label: 'Time' }
  ];

  const frequencies = [
    { value: 'once', label: 'Once' },
    { value: 'daily', label: 'Daily' },
    { value: 'weekly', label: 'Weekly' },
    { value: 'biweekly', label: 'Bi-weekly' },
    { value: 'monthly', label: 'Monthly' },
    { value: 'quarterly', label: 'Quarterly' },
    { value: 'yearly', label: 'Yearly' }
  ];

  const audiences = [
    { value: 'employee', label: 'Employee' },
    { value: 'team_lead', label: 'Team Lead' },
    { value: 'project_manager', label: 'Project Manager' },
    { value: 'all', label: 'All' }
  ];

  const validateForm = () => {
    const newErrors = {};
    
    if (!formData.title.trim()) {
      newErrors.title = 'Form title is required';
    }
    
    setErrors(newErrors);
    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;
  };

  const validateQuestion = () => {
    const newErrors = {};
    
    if (!currentQuestion.question_text.trim()) {
      newErrors.question_text = 'Question text is required';
    }
    
    if (['multiple_choice', 'checkbox', 'dropdown'].includes(currentQuestion.question_type) && 
        currentQuestion.options.length < 2) {
      newErrors.options = 'At least two options are required';
    }
    
    setErrors(newErrors);
    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;
  };

  const handleFormChange = (e) => {
    const { name, value } = e.target;
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: value }));
    
    // Clear error when field is edited
    if (errors[name]) {
      setErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: undefined }));
    }
  };

  const handleQuestionChange = (e) => {
    const { name, value, type, checked } = e.target;
    const val = type === 'checkbox' ? checked : value;
    
    setCurrentQuestion(prev => ({ 
      ...prev, 
      [name]: val,
      // Reset options if changing from a type with options to one without
      ...(name === 'question_type' && 
        !['multiple_choice', 'checkbox', 'dropdown'].includes(value) && 
        { options: [] })
    }));
    
    // Clear error when field is edited
    if (errors[name]) {
      setErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: undefined }));
    }
  };

  const handleOptionChange = (e) => {
    setCurrentOption(e.target.value);
  };

  const addOption = () => {
    if (!currentOption.trim()) return;
    
    setCurrentQuestion(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      options: [...prev.options, currentOption.trim()]
    }));
    
    setCurrentOption('');
    
    // Clear option error if it exists
    if (errors.options) {
      setErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, options: undefined }));
    }
  };

  const removeOption = (index) => {
    setCurrentQuestion(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      options: prev.options.filter((_, i) => i !== index)
    }));
  };

  const addQuestion = () => {
    if (!validateQuestion()) return;
    
    if (editingQuestionIndex !== null) {
      // Update existing question
      setQuestions(prev => prev.map((q, i) => 
        i === editingQuestionIndex ? { ...currentQuestion } : q
      ));
      setEditingQuestionIndex(null);
    } else {
      // Add new question
      setQuestions(prev => [...prev, { ...currentQuestion }]);
    }
    
    // Reset current question
    setCurrentQuestion({
      question_text: '',
      question_type: 'short_text',
      is_required: false,
      options: []
    });
    
    setIsAddingQuestion(false);
  };

  const editQuestion = (index) => {
    setCurrentQuestion({ ...questions[index] });
    setEditingQuestionIndex(index);
    setIsAddingQuestion(true);
  };

  const removeQuestion = (index) => {
    setQuestions(prev => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  };

  const saveForm = async (status = 'draft') => {
    if (!validateForm()) return;
    
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    
    try {
      const formToSave = {
        ...formData,
        status,
        questions,
        published_at: status === 'published' ? new Date().toISOString() : null
      };

      const response = await fetch('/api/forms', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(formToSave),
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        const newForm = await response.json();
        toast.success(`Form ${status === 'published' ? 'published' : 'saved as draft'} successfully`);
        router.push('/forms');
      } else {
        const error = await response.json();
        throw new Error(error.message || 'Failed to save form');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error saving form:', error);
      toast.error(`Failed to ${status === 'published' ? 'publish' : 'save'} form`);
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleAddNewQuestion = () => {
    setIsAddingQuestion(true);
    setEditingQuestionIndex(null);
    setCurrentQuestion({
      question_text: '',
      question_type: 'short_text',
      is_required: false,
      options: []
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto fade-in pb-12">
      <div className="mb-6">
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          onClick={() => router.push('/forms')}
          className="mb-2"
        >
          <FiArrowLeft className="mr-2" />
          Back to Forms
        </Button>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">Create New Score Builder Form</h1>
      </div>

      <Card className="mb-6">
        <Card.Header>
          <Card.Title>Form Details</Card.Title>
        </Card.Header>
        <Card.Content className="space-y-6">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="title">
              Form Title <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
            </Label>
            <Input
              id="title"
              name="title"
              value={formData.title}
              onChange={handleFormChange}
              placeholder="Enter form title"
              className={errors.title ? 'border-red-500' : ''}
            />
            {errors.title && (
              <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-1">{errors.title}</p>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="description">Description</Label>
            <textarea
              id="description"
              name="description"
              value={formData.description}
              onChange={handleFormChange}
              placeholder="Enter form description (optional)"
              rows={3}
              className="flex w-full rounded-md border border-gray-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="frequency">Frequency</Label>
              <Select
                id="frequency"
                name="frequency"
                value={formData.frequency}
                onChange={handleFormChange}
              >
                {frequencies.map(option => (
                  <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>
                    {option.label}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </Select>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="audience">Target Audience</Label>
              <Select
                id="audience"
                name="audience"
                value={formData.audience}
                onChange={handleFormChange}
              >
                {audiences.map(option => (
                  <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>
                    {option.label}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </Select>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Card.Content>
      </Card>

      <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-6">
        <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold">Form Questions</h2>
        <Button
          onClick={handleAddNewQuestion}
          disabled={isAddingQuestion}
          className="flex items-center"
        >
          <FiPlus className="mr-2" />
          Add Question
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Question List */}
      {questions.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="bg-gray-50 border-2 border-dashed border-gray-300 rounded-lg p-8 text-center mb-6">
          <p className="text-gray-500">No questions added yet. Click the "Add Question" button to create your first question.</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-4 mb-6">
          {questions.map((question, index) => (
            <Card key={index} className="transition-all duration-300 hover:shadow-sm">
              <Card.Content className="flex justify-between items-start">
                <div className="flex-1">
                  <div className="flex items-center mb-1">
                    <h3 className="font-medium mr-2">{question.question_text}</h3>
                    {question.is_required && (
                      <span className="text-red-500 text-sm">*</span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center text-sm text-gray-500">
                    <span className="bg-gray-100 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs">
                      {questionTypes.find(t => t.value === question.question_type)?.label || question.question_type}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  
                  {['multiple_choice', 'checkbox', 'dropdown'].includes(question.question_type) && question.options.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="mt-3">
                      <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mb-1">Options:</p>
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                        {question.options.map((option, optIndex) => (
                          <span key={optIndex} className="bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded">
                            {option}
                          </span>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="flex space-x-2">
                  <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    size="sm"
                    onClick={() => editQuestion(index)}
                    className="flex items-center"
                  >
                    <FiEdit2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    size="sm"
                    onClick={() => removeQuestion(index)}
                    className="flex items-center text-red-600 border-red-200 hover:bg-red-50"
                  >
                    <FiTrash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </Card.Content>
            </Card>
          ))}
          
          {/* Add Question Button at the bottom */}
          {!isAddingQuestion && questions.length > 0 && (
            <div className="flex justify-center mt-6">
              <Button
                onClick={handleAddNewQuestion}
                className="flex items-center"
              >
                <FiPlus className="mr-2" />
                Add Question
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Add/Edit Question Form */}
      {isAddingQuestion && (
        <Card className="mb-6 border-primary-200 shadow-md">
          <Card.Header>
            <Card.Title>{editingQuestionIndex !== null ? 'Edit Question' : 'Add New Question'}</Card.Title>
          </Card.Header>
          <Card.Content className="space-y-6">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="question_text">
                Question Text <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="question_text"
                name="question_text"
                value={currentQuestion.question_text}
                onChange={handleQuestionChange}
                placeholder="Enter your question"
                className={errors.question_text ? 'border-red-500' : ''}
              />
              {errors.question_text && (
                <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-1">{errors.question_text}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="question_type">Question Type</Label>
                <Select
                  id="question_type"
                  name="question_type"
                  value={currentQuestion.question_type}
                  onChange={handleQuestionChange}
                >
                  {questionTypes.map(option => (
                    <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>
                      {option.label}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </Select>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-end space-x-2">
                <div className="flex items-center h-10">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    id="is_required"
                    name="is_required"
                    checked={currentQuestion.is_required}
                    onChange={handleQuestionChange}
                    className="h-4 w-4 text-primary-600 focus:ring-primary-500 border-gray-300 rounded"
                  />
                  <Label htmlFor="is_required" className="ml-2">
                    Required Question
                  </Label>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Options for multiple choice, checkbox, and dropdown */}
            {['multiple_choice', 'checkbox', 'dropdown'].includes(currentQuestion.question_type) && (
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <Label>
                  Options <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                </Label>
                
                <div className="flex space-x-2">
                  <Input
                    value={currentOption}
                    onChange={handleOptionChange}
                    placeholder="Enter an option"
                    className="flex-1"
                    onKeyPress={(e) => {
                      if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        addOption();
                      }
                    }}
                  />
                  <Button
                    onClick={addOption}
                    disabled={!currentOption.trim()}
                    className="flex-shrink-0"
                  >
                    Add
                  </Button>
                </div>
                
                {errors.options && (
                  <p className="text-red-500 text-sm">{errors.options}</p>
                )}
                
                {currentQuestion.options.length > 0 ? (
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    {currentQuestion.options.map((option, index) => (
                      <div key={index} className="flex items-center justify-between bg-gray-50 p-2 rounded">
                        <span>{option}</span>
                        <Button
                          variant="ghost"
                          size="sm"
                          onClick={() => removeOption(index)}
                          className="text-red-500 hover:text-red-700 hover:bg-red-50 h-8 w-8 p-0"
                        >
                          <FiTrash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">No options added yet.</p>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </Card.Content>
          <Card.Footer className="flex justify-end space-x-2 border-t pt-6">
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => {
                setIsAddingQuestion(false);
                setEditingQuestionIndex(null);
                setCurrentQuestion({
                  question_text: '',
                  question_type: 'short_text',
                  is_required: false,
                  options: []
                });
                setErrors({});
              }}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={addQuestion}>
              {editingQuestionIndex !== null ? 'Update Question' : 'Add Question'}
            </Button>
          </Card.Footer>
        </Card>
      )}

      <div className="flex justify-between mt-8">
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          onClick={() => setIsPreviewModalOpen(true)}
          className="flex items-center"
          disabled={questions.length === 0}
        >
          <FiEye className="mr-2" />
          Preview Form
        </Button>
        
        <div className="space-x-2">
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            onClick={() => router.push('/forms')}
            disabled={isSubmitting}
          >
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            onClick={() => saveForm('draft')}
            disabled={isSubmitting}
            className="flex items-center"
          >
            <FiSave className="mr-2" />
            {isSubmitting && formData.status === 'draft' ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Draft'}
          </Button>
          <Button
            onClick={() => saveForm('published')}
            disabled={isSubmitting || questions.length === 0}
            className="flex items-center"
          >
            <FiCheck className="mr-2" />
            {isSubmitting && formData.status === 'published' ? 'Publishing...' : 'Publish Form'}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Preview Modal */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={isPreviewModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsPreviewModalOpen(false)}
        title={formData.title || 'Form Preview'}
        description={formData.description}
        size="2xl"
        footer={
          <Button 
            onClick={() => setIsPreviewModalOpen(false)}
          >
            Close Preview
          </Button>
        }
      >
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {questions.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-center text-gray-500">No questions to preview.</p>
          ) : (
            questions.map((question, index) => (
              <div key={index} className="space-y-2">
                <div className="flex items-center">
                  <Label className="text-md font-medium">{question.question_text}</Label>
                  {question.is_required && <span className="text-red-500 ml-1">*</span>}
                </div>
                
                {question.question_type === 'short_text' && (
                  <Input disabled placeholder="Short text answer" />
                )}
                
                {question.question_type === 'long_text' && (
                  <textarea 
                    disabled 
                    placeholder="Long text answer" 
                    className="flex w-full rounded-md border border-gray-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
                    rows={3}
                  />
                )}
                
                {question.question_type === 'multiple_choice' && (
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    {question.options.map((option, optIndex) => (
                      <div key={optIndex} className="flex items-center">
                        <input 
                          type="radio" 
                          name={`question-${index}`} 
                          id={`option-${index}-${optIndex}`} 
                          disabled 
                          className="h-4 w-4 text-primary-600 focus:ring-primary-500 border-gray-300"
                        />
                        <label htmlFor={`option-${index}-${optIndex}`} className="ml-2 text-sm text-gray-700">
                          {option}
                        </label>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
                
                {question.question_type === 'checkbox' && (
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    {question.options.map((option, optIndex) => (
                      <div key={optIndex} className="flex items-center">
                        <input 
                          type="checkbox" 
                          id={`option-${index}-${optIndex}`} 
                          disabled 
                          className="h-4 w-4 text-primary-600 focus:ring-primary-500 border-gray-300 rounded"
                        />
                        <label htmlFor={`option-${index}-${optIndex}`} className="ml-2 text-sm text-gray-700">
                          {option}
                        </label>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
                
                {question.question_type === 'dropdown' && (
                  <Select disabled>
                    <option>Select an option</option>
                    {question.options.map((option, optIndex) => (
                      <option key={optIndex}>{option}</option>
                    ))}
                  </Select>
                )}
                
                {question.question_type === 'linear_scale' && (
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-4">
                    {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(num => (
                      <div key={num} className="flex flex-col items-center">
                        <input 
                          type="radio" 
                          name={`question-${index}`} 
                          id={`scale-${index}-${num}`} 
                          disabled 
                          className="h-4 w-4 text-primary-600 focus:ring-primary-500 border-gray-300"
                        />
                        <label htmlFor={`scale-${index}-${num}`} className="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-700">
                          {num}
                        </label>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
                
                {question.question_type === 'date' && (
                  <Input type="date" disabled />
                )}
                
                {question.question_type === 'time' && (
                  <Input type="time" disabled />
                )}
              </div>
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

File: pages/forms/[id]/edit.js

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/router';
import { FiArrowLeft, FiSave, FiPlus, FiTrash2, FiEye, FiCheck, FiEdit2 } from 'react-icons/fi';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { Button } from '../../../components/Button';
import { Input } from '../../../components/Input';
import { Select } from '../../../components/Select';
import { Label } from '../../../components/Label';
import { Card } from '../../../components/Card';
import { Modal } from '../../../components/Modal';

// Mock data for form
const mockForm = {
  id: 'form-1',
  title: 'Employee Performance Review',
  description: 'Quarterly performance evaluation form',
  status: 'published',
  audience: 'all',
  frequency: 'quarterly'
};

// Mock data for questions
const mockQuestions = [
  {
    id: 'q1',
    question_text: 'How would you rate your overall performance?',
    question_type: 'linear_scale',
    is_required: true,
    order_number: 0,
    options: []
  },
  {
    id: 'q2',
    question_text: 'What skills have you improved in the last quarter?',
    question_type: 'multiple_choice',
    is_required: true,
    order_number: 1,
    options: ['Technical skills', 'Communication', 'Leadership', 'Problem solving']
  },
  {
    id: 'q3',
    question_text: 'What are your goals for the next quarter?',
    question_type: 'long_text',
    is_required: false,
    order_number: 2,
    options: []
  }
];

export default function EditForm() {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    title: '',
    description: '',
    frequency: 'once',
    audience: 'all',
    status: 'draft'
  });
  
  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState([]);
  const [currentQuestion, setCurrentQuestion] = useState({
    id: null,
    question_text: '',
    question_type: 'short_text',
    is_required: false,
    options: []
  });
  
  const [originalQuestions, setOriginalQuestions] = useState([]);
  const [deletedQuestionIds, setDeletedQuestionIds] = useState([]);
  const [isAddingQuestion, setIsAddingQuestion] = useState(false);
  const [editingQuestionIndex, setEditingQuestionIndex] = useState(null);
  const [currentOption, setCurrentOption] = useState('');
  const [isPreviewModalOpen, setIsPreviewModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  
  const router = useRouter();
  const { id } = router.query;

  const questionTypes = [
    { value: 'short_text', label: 'Short Text' },
    { value: 'long_text', label: 'Long Text' },
    { value: 'multiple_choice', label: 'Multiple Choice' },
    { value: 'checkbox', label: 'Checkboxes' },
    { value: 'dropdown', label: 'Dropdown' },
    { value: 'linear_scale', label: 'Linear Scale' },
    { value: 'date', label: 'Date' },
    { value: 'time', label: 'Time' }
  ];

  const frequencies = [
    { value: 'once', label: 'Once' },
    { value: 'daily', label: 'Daily' },
    { value: 'weekly', label: 'Weekly' },
    { value: 'biweekly', label: 'Bi-weekly' },
    { value: 'monthly', label: 'Monthly' },
    { value: 'quarterly', label: 'Quarterly' },
    { value: 'yearly', label: 'Yearly' }
  ];

  const audiences = [
    { value: 'employee', label: 'Employee' },
    { value: 'team_lead', label: 'Team Lead' },
    { value: 'project_manager', label: 'Project Manager' },
    { value: 'all', label: 'All' }
  ];

  useEffect(() => {
    if (id) {
      fetchFormData();
    }
  }, [id]);

  const fetchFormData = async () => {
    try {
      setIsLoading(true);
      
      // Simulate API call delay
      setTimeout(() => {
        setFormData(mockForm);
        setQuestions(mockQuestions);
        setOriginalQuestions(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(mockQuestions)));
        setIsLoading(false);
      }, 800);
      
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching form data:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to load form data');
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const validateForm = () => {
    const newErrors = {};
    
    if (!formData.title.trim()) {
      newErrors.title = 'Form title is required';
    }
    
    setErrors(newErrors);
    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;
  };

  const validateQuestion = () => {
    const newErrors = {};
    
    if (!currentQuestion.question_text.trim()) {
      newErrors.question_text = 'Question text is required';
    }
    
    if (['multiple_choice', 'checkbox', 'dropdown'].includes(currentQuestion.question_type) && 
        currentQuestion.options.length < 2) {
      newErrors.options = 'At least two options are required';
    }
    
    setErrors(newErrors);
    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;
  };

  const handleFormChange = (e) => {
    const { name, value } = e.target;
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: value }));
    
    // Clear error when field is edited
    if (errors[name]) {
      setErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: undefined }));
    }
  };

  const handleQuestionChange = (e) => {
    const { name, value, type, checked } = e.target;
    const val = type === 'checkbox' ? checked : value;
    
    setCurrentQuestion(prev => ({ 
      ...prev, 
      [name]: val,
      // Reset options if changing from a type with options to one without
      ...(name === 'question_type' && 
        !['multiple_choice', 'checkbox', 'dropdown'].includes(value) && 
        { options: [] })
    }));
    
    // Clear error when field is edited
    if (errors[name]) {
      setErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: undefined }));
    }
  };

  const handleOptionChange = (e) => {
    setCurrentOption(e.target.value);
  };

  const addOption = () => {
    if (!currentOption.trim()) return;
    
    setCurrentQuestion(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      options: [...prev.options, currentOption.trim()]
    }));
    
    setCurrentOption('');
    
    // Clear option error if it exists
    if (errors.options) {
      setErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, options: undefined }));
    }
  };

  const removeOption = (index) => {
    setCurrentQuestion(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      options: prev.options.filter((_, i) => i !== index)
    }));
  };

  const addQuestion = () => {
    if (!validateQuestion()) return;
    
    if (editingQuestionIndex !== null) {
      // Update existing question
      setQuestions(prev => prev.map((q, i) => 
        i === editingQuestionIndex ? { ...currentQuestion } : q
      ));
      setEditingQuestionIndex(null);
    } else {
      // Add new question
      setQuestions(prev => [...prev, { ...currentQuestion }]);
    }
    
    // Reset current question
    setCurrentQuestion({
      id: null,
      question_text: '',
      question_type: 'short_text',
      is_required: false,
      options: []
    });
    
    setIsAddingQuestion(false);
  };

  const editQuestion = (index) => {
    setCurrentQuestion({ ...questions[index] });
    setEditingQuestionIndex(index);
    setIsAddingQuestion(true);
  };

  const removeQuestion = (index) => {
    const questionToRemove = questions[index];
    
    // If the question has an ID (exists in the database), add it to deletedQuestionIds
    if (questionToRemove.id) {
      setDeletedQuestionIds(prev => [...prev, questionToRemove.id]);
    }
    
    setQuestions(prev => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  };

  const saveForm = async (status = null) => {
    if (!validateForm()) return;
    
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    
    try {
      // Simulate form update
      setTimeout(() => {
        const statusText = status === 'published' ? 'published' : 'updated';
        toast.success(`Form ${statusText} successfully`);
        router.push(`/forms/${id}`);
      }, 1000);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error saving form:', error);
      toast.error(`Failed to ${status === 'published' ? 'publish' : 'update'} form`);
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleAddNewQuestion = () => {
    setIsAddingQuestion(true);
    setEditingQuestionIndex(null);
    setCurrentQuestion({
      id: null,
      question_text: '',
      question_type: 'short_text',
      is_required: false,
      options: []
    });
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex justify-center items-center h-64">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-t-2 border-b-2 border-primary-600"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto fade-in pb-12">
      <div className="mb-6">
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          onClick={() => router.push(`/forms/${id}`)}
          className="mb-2"
        >
          <FiArrowLeft className="mr-2" />
          Back to Form
        </Button>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">Edit Form</h1>
      </div>

      <Card className="mb-6">
        <Card.Header>
          <Card.Title>Form Details</Card.Title>
        </Card.Header>
        <Card.Content className="space-y-6">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="title">
              Form Title <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
            </Label>
            <Input
              id="title"
              name="title"
              value={formData.title}
              onChange={handleFormChange}
              placeholder="Enter form title"
              className={errors.title ? 'border-red-500' : ''}
            />
            {errors.title && (
              <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-1">{errors.title}</p>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="description">Description</Label>
            <textarea
              id="description"
              name="description"
              value={formData.description}
              onChange={handleFormChange}
              placeholder="Enter form description (optional)"
              rows={3}
              className="flex w-full rounded-md border border-gray-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="frequency">Frequency</Label>
              <Select
                id="frequency"
                name="frequency"
                value={formData.frequency}
                onChange={handleFormChange}
              >
                {frequencies.map(option => (
                  <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>
                    {option.label}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </Select>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="audience">Target Audience</Label>
              <Select
                id="audience"
                name="audience"
                value={formData.audience}
                onChange={handleFormChange}
              >
                {audiences.map(option => (
                  <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>
                    {option.label}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </Select>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Card.Content>
      </Card>

      <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-6">
        <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold">Form Questions</h2>
        <Button
          onClick={handleAddNewQuestion}
          disabled={isAddingQuestion}
          className="flex items-center"
        >
          <FiPlus className="mr-2" />
          Add Question
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Question List */}
      {questions.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="bg-gray-50 border-2 border-dashed border-gray-300 rounded-lg p-8 text-center mb-6">
          <p className="text-gray-500">No questions added yet. Click the "Add Question" button to create your first question.</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-4 mb-6">
          {questions.map((question, index) => (
            <Card key={index} className="transition-all duration-300 hover:shadow-sm">
              <Card.Content className="flex justify-between items-start">
                <div className="flex-1">
                  <div className="flex items-center mb-1">
                    <h3 className="font-medium mr-2">{question.question_text}</h3>
                    {question.is_required && (
                      <span className="text-red-500 text-sm">*</span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center text-sm text-gray-500">
                    <span className="bg-gray-100 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs">
                      {questionTypes.find(t => t.value === question.question_type)?.label || question.question_type}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  
                  {['multiple_choice', 'checkbox', 'dropdown'].includes(question.question_type) && question.options.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="mt-3">
                      <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mb-1">Options:</p>
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                        {question.options.map((option, optIndex) => (
                          <span key={optIndex} className="bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded">
                            {option}
                          </span>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="flex space-x-2">
                  <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    size="sm"
                    onClick={() => editQuestion(index)}
                    className="flex items-center"
                  >
                    <FiEdit2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    size="sm"
                    onClick={() => removeQuestion(index)}
                    className="flex items-center text-red-600 border-red-200 hover:bg-red-50"
                  >
                    <FiTrash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </Card.Content>
            </Card>
          ))}
          
          {/* Add Question Button at the bottom */}
          {!isAddingQuestion && questions.length > 0 && (
            <div className="flex justify-center mt-6">
              <Button
                onClick={handleAddNewQuestion}
                className="flex items-center"
              >
                <FiPlus className="mr-2" />
                Add Question
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Add/Edit Question Form */}
      {isAddingQuestion && (
        <Card className="mb-6 border-primary-200 shadow-md">
          <Card.Header>
            <Card.Title>{editingQuestionIndex !== null ? 'Edit Question' : 'Add New Question'}</Card.Title>
          </Card.Header>
          <Card.Content className="space-y-6">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="question_text">
                Question Text <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="question_text"
                name="question_text"
                value={currentQuestion.question_text}
                onChange={handleQuestionChange}
                placeholder="Enter your question"
                className={errors.question_text ? 'border-red-500' : ''}
              />
              {errors.question_text && (
                <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-1">{errors.question_text}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="question_type">Question Type</Label>
                <Select
                  id="question_type"
                  name="question_type"
                  value={currentQuestion.question_type}
                  onChange={handleQuestionChange}
                >
                  {questionTypes.map(option => (
                    <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>
                      {option.label}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </Select>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-end space-x-2">
                <div className="flex items-center h-10">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    id="is_required"
                    name="is_required"
                    checked={currentQuestion.is_required}
                    onChange={handleQuestionChange}
                    className="h-4 w-4 text-primary-600 focus:ring-primary-500 border-gray-300 rounded"
                  />
                  <Label htmlFor="is_required" className="ml-2">
                    Required Question
                  </Label>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Options for multiple choice, checkbox, dropdown */}
            {['multiple_choice', 'checkbox', 'dropdown'].includes(currentQuestion.question_type) && (
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <Label>
                  Options <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                </Label>
                
                <div className="flex space-x-2">
                  <Input
                    value={currentOption}
                    onChange={handleOptionChange}
                    placeholder="Enter an option"
                    className="flex-1"
                    onKeyPress={(e) => {
                      if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        addOption();
                      }
                    }}
                  />
                  <Button
                    onClick={addOption}
                    disabled={!currentOption.trim()}
                    className="flex-shrink-0"
                  >
                    Add
                  </Button>
                </div>
                
                {errors.options && (
                  <p className="text-red-500 text-sm">{errors.options}</p>
                )}
                
                {currentQuestion.options.length > 0 ? (
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    {currentQuestion.options.map((option, index) => (
                      <div key={index} className="flex items-center justify-between bg-gray-50 p-2 rounded">
                        <span>{option}</span>
                        <Button
                          variant="ghost"
                          size="sm"
                          onClick={() => removeOption(index)}
                          className="text-red-500 hover:text-red-700 hover:bg-red-50 h-8 w-8 p-0"
                        >
                          <FiTrash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">No options added yet.</p>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </Card.Content>
          <Card.Footer className="flex justify-end space-x-2 border-t pt-6">
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => {
                setIsAddingQuestion(false);
                setEditingQuestionIndex(null);
                setCurrentQuestion({
                  id: null,
                  question_text: '',
                  question_type: 'short_text',
                  is_required: false,
                  options: []
                });
                setErrors({});
              }}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={addQuestion}>
              {editingQuestionIndex !== null ? 'Update Question' : 'Add Question'}
            </Button>
          </Card.Footer>
        </Card>
      )}

      <div className="flex justify-between mt-8">
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          onClick={() => router.push(`/forms/${id}/preview`)}
          className="flex items-center"
          disabled={questions.length === 0}
        >
          <FiEye className="mr-2" />
          Preview Form
        </Button>
        
        <div className="space-x-2">
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            onClick={() => router.push(`/forms/${id}`)}
            disabled={isSubmitting}
          >
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            onClick={() => saveForm('draft')}
            disabled={isSubmitting}
            className="flex items-center"
          >
            <FiSave className="mr-2" />
            {isSubmitting ? 'Saving...' : 'Save as Draft'}
          </Button>
          <Button
            onClick={() => saveForm('published')}
            disabled={isSubmitting || questions.length === 0}
            className="flex items-center"
          >
            <FiCheck className="mr-2" />
            {isSubmitting ? 'Publishing...' : 'Publish Form'}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export async function getServerSideProps(context) {
  // Import database functions only on server-side
  const { getFormById } = require('../../../lib/data');
  const { id } = context.params;

  try {
    const formData = await getFormById(id);
    
    if (!formData) {
      return {
        notFound: true
      };
    }
    
    // Serialize dates
    const serializedForm = {
      ...formData,
      created_at: formData.created_at ? formData.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: formData.updated_at ? formData.updated_at.toISOString() : null,
      published_at: formData.published_at ? formData.published_at.toISOString() : null
    };

    return {
      props: {
        form: serializedForm
      }
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching form:', error);
    return {
      notFound: true
    };
  }
}

                  View Submissions
                </a>
              </Link>
            </div>
          </Card.Footer>
        )}
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

// Add this to the handleSubmit function before the last return statement in the existing file

const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  
  if (!validateForm()) {
    toast.error('Please fill in all required fields');
    return;
  }
  
  // In preview mode, we just show a success message
  setIsSubmitting(true);
  
  // For real submissions in a non-preview mode, we would save to the database
  if (!isPreviewMode && isSupabaseConfigured()) {
    try {
      // Create submission record
      const { data: submission, error: submissionError } = await supabase
        .from('form_submissions')
        .insert([
          {
            form_id: id,
            user_id: currentUser?.id,
            user_email: currentUser?.email,
            employee_id: currentUser?.employeeId, // Assuming this is available
            status: 'pending',
            submission_month: new Date().getMonth() + 1 < 10 
              ? `0${new Date().getMonth() + 1}` 
              : `${new Date().getMonth() + 1}`,
            submission_year: new Date().getFullYear().toString()
          }
        ])
        .select()
        .single();
      
      if (submissionError) throw submissionError;
      
      // Save answers
      const answerPromises = questions.map(question => {
        const answer = answers[question.id];
        return supabase
          .from('submission_answers')
          .insert([
            {
              submission_id: submission.id,
              question_id: question.id,
              answer_text: answer,
              max_score: question.max_score || 0
            }
          ]);
      });
      
      await Promise.all(answerPromises);
      
      toast.success('Form submitted successfully!');
      router.push('/dashboard');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error submitting form:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to submit form');
      setIsSubmitting(false);
      return;
    }
  }
  
  // Simulate submission delay
  setTimeout(() => {
    setIsPreviewSubmitted(true);
    setIsSubmitting(false);
  }, 1000);
};

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/router';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { FiArrowLeft, FiSave, FiList, FiAlertCircle } from 'react-icons/fi';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { Button } from '../../../components/Button';
import { Input } from '../../../components/Input';
import { Select } from '../../../components/Select';
import { Label } from '../../../components/Label';
import { Card } from '../../../components/Card';
import { isSupabaseConfigured, supabase } from '../../../lib/supabase-client';

export default function FormScoreSettings() {
  const [form, setForm] = useState(null);
  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState([]);
  const [categories, setCategories] = useState([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const [newCategory, setNewCategory] = useState({ name: '', description: '', weight: 1 });
  
  const router = useRouter();
  const { id } = router.query;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (id) {
      fetchFormData();
    }
  }, [id]);

  const fetchFormData = async () => {
    try {
      setIsLoading(true);
      
      if (isSupabaseConfigured()) {
        // Fetch form data from Supabase
        const { data: formData, error: formError } = await supabase
          .from('score_forms')
          .select('*')
          .eq('id', id)
          .single();
        
        if (formError) throw formError;
        
        // Fetch questions
        const { data: questionsData, error: questionsError } = await supabase
          .from('form_questions')
          .select('*')
          .eq('form_id', id)
          .order('order_number');
        
        if (questionsError) throw questionsError;
        
        // Fetch categories
        const { data: categoriesData, error: categoriesError } = await supabase
          .from('score_categories')
          .select('*')
          .eq('form_id', id);
        
        if (categoriesError) throw categoriesError;
        
        setForm(formData);
        setQuestions(questionsData.map(q => ({
          ...q,
          category_id: q.category_id || '',
          max_score: q.max_score || 5,
          score_weight: q.score_weight || 1
        })));
        setCategories(categoriesData);
      } else {
        // Mock data for demo
        const mockForm = {
          id: id,
          title: 'Employee Performance Review',
          description: 'Quarterly performance evaluation form',
          status: 'published'
        };
        
        const mockQuestions = [
          {
            id: 'q1',
            question_text: 'How would you rate your overall performance?',
            question_type: 'linear_scale',
            is_required: true,
            order_number: 0,
            category_id: '',
            max_score: 5,
            score_weight: 1
          },
          {
            id: 'q2',
            question_text: 'What skills have you improved in the last quarter?',
            question_type: 'multiple_choice',
            is_required: true,
            order_number: 1,
            category_id: '',
            max_score: 5,
            score_weight: 2
          },
          {
            id: 'q3',
            question_text: 'What are your goals for the next quarter?',
            question_type: 'long_text',
            is_required: false,
            order_number: 2,
            category_id: '',
            max_score: 5,
            score_weight: 1
          }
        ];
        
        const mockCategories = [
          {
            id: 'cat1',
            form_id: id,
            name: 'Technical Skills',
            description: 'Assessment of technical abilities and competencies',
            weight: 3
          },
          {
            id: 'cat2',
            form_id: id,
            name: 'Communication',
            description: 'Assessment of communication skills and effectiveness',
            weight: 2
          },
          {
            id: 'cat3',
            form_id: id,
            name: 'Teamwork',
            description: 'Assessment of collaboration and team contributions',
            weight: 2
          }
        ];
        
        setForm(mockForm);
        setQuestions(mockQuestions);
        setCategories(mockCategories);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching form data:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to load form data');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleQuestionChange = (questionId, field, value) => {
    setQuestions(prev => 
      prev.map(q => 
        q.id === questionId 
          ? { ...q, [field]: value } 
          : q
      )
    );
  };

  const handleCategoryChange = (categoryId, field, value) => {
    setCategories(prev => 
      prev.map(c => 
        c.id === categoryId 
          ? { ...c, [field]: value } 
          : c
      )
    );
  };

  const handleAddCategory = async () => {
    if (!newCategory.name.trim()) {
      toast.error('Category name is required');
      return;
    }
    
    try {
      if (isSupabaseConfigured()) {
        const { data, error } = await supabase
          .from('score_categories')
          .insert([
            { 
              form_id: id,
              name: newCategory.name,
              description: newCategory.description,
              weight: parseInt(newCategory.weight) || 1
            }
          ])
          .select()
          .single();
        
        if (error) throw error;
        
        setCategories(prev => [...prev, data]);
      } else {
        // Mock for demo
        const newCat = {
          id: `cat${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 9)}`,
          form_id: id,
          name: newCategory.name,
          description: newCategory.description,
          weight: parseInt(newCategory.weight) || 1
        };
        
        setCategories(prev => [...prev, newCat]);
      }
      
      setNewCategory({ name: '', description: '', weight: 1 });
      toast.success('Category added successfully');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error adding category:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to add category');
    }
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    setIsSaving(true);
    
    try {
      if (isSupabaseConfigured()) {
        // Update questions with scoring settings
        const updates = questions.map(q => ({
          id: q.id,
          category_id: q.category_id || null,
          max_score: parseInt(q.max_score) || 5,
          score_weight: parseInt(q.score_weight) || 1
        }));
        
        const { error } = await supabase
          .from('form_questions')
          .upsert(updates);
        
        if (error) throw error;
        
        // Update categories
        const categoryUpdates = categories.map(c => ({
          id: c.id,
          name: c.name,
          description: c.description,
          weight: parseInt(c.weight) || 1
        }));
        
        const { error: categoryError } = await supabase
          .from('score_categories')
          .upsert(categoryUpdates);
        
        if (categoryError) throw categoryError;
      }
      
      toast.success('Score settings saved successfully');
      router.push(`/forms/${id}`);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error saving score settings:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to save score settings');
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex justify-center items-center h-64">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-t-2 border-b-2 border-primary-600"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto fade-in pb-12">
      <div className="mb-6">
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          onClick={() => router.push(`/forms/${id}`)}
          className="mb-2"
        >
          <FiArrowLeft className="mr-2" />
          Back to Form
        </Button>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">Score Settings: {form?.title}</h1>
        <p className="text-gray-500">Configure how questions are scored and categorized for reports</p>
      </div>

      <div className="bg-yellow-50 border border-yellow-200 rounded-lg p-4 mb-6">
        <div className="flex items-start">
          <FiAlertCircle className="text-yellow-500 mt-1 mr-3 flex-shrink-0" />
          <div>
            <h3 className="font-medium text-yellow-800">Scoring Configuration</h3>
            <p className="text-sm text-yellow-700 mt-1">
              Assign scoring weights and categories to questions to generate meaningful reports.
              Each question can have a maximum score and a weight that determines its importance.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Categories Section */}
      <Card className="mb-6">
        <Card.Header>
          <Card.Title>Score Categories</Card.Title>
          <Card.Description>
            Create categories to group questions for reporting
          </Card.Description>
        </Card.Header>
        <Card.Content className="space-y-6">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="categoryName">Category Name</Label>
              <Input
                id="categoryName"
                value={newCategory.name}
                onChange={(e) => setNewCategory({...newCategory, name: e.target.value})}
                placeholder="e.g. Technical Skills"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="categoryDescription">Description</Label>
              <Input
                id="categoryDescription"
                value={newCategory.description}
                onChange={(e) => setNewCategory({...newCategory, description: e.target.value})}
                placeholder="Brief description"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="categoryWeight">Weight</Label>
              <div className="flex space-x-2">
                <Input
                  id="categoryWeight"
                  type="number"
                  min="1"
                  max="5"
                  value={newCategory.weight}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewCategory({...newCategory, weight: e.target.value})}
                  className="flex-1"
                />
                <Button onClick={handleAddCategory}>Add</Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {categories.length > 0 ? (
            <div className="mt-4 border rounded-md overflow-hidden">
              <table className="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-200">
                <thead className="bg-gray-50">
                  <tr>
                    <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                      Category Name
                    </th>
                    <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                      Description
                    </th>
                    <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                      Weight
                    </th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-200">
                  {categories.map((category) => (
                    <tr key={category.id}>
                      <td className="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                        <Input
                          value={category.name}
                          onChange={(e) => handleCategoryChange(category.id, 'name', e.target.value)}
                          className="border-none hover:border hover:border-gray-300 focus:border-primary-500"
                        />
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-6 py-4">
                        <Input
                          value={category.description}
                          onChange={(e) => handleCategoryChange(category.id, 'description', e.target.value)}
                          className="border-none hover:border hover:border-gray-300 focus:border-primary-500"
                        />
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                        <Input
                          type="number"
                          min="1"
                          max="5"
                          value={category.weight}
                          onChange={(e) => handleCategoryChange(category.id, 'weight', e.target.value)}
                          className="w-20 border-none hover:border hover:border-gray-300 focus:border-primary-500"
                        />
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="text-center py-4 text-gray-500">No categories defined yet.</div>
          )}
        </Card.Content>
      </Card>

      {/* Questions Scoring Section */}
      <Card>
        <Card.Header>
          <Card.Title>Question Scoring</Card.Title>
          <Card.Description>
            Configure how each question contributes to the overall score
          </Card.Description>
        </Card.Header>
        <Card.Content>
          {questions.length > 0 ? (
            <div className="border rounded-md overflow-hidden">
              <table className="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-200">
                <thead className="bg-gray-50">
                  <tr>
                    <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                      Question
                    </th>
                    <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                      Category
                    </th>
                    <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                      Max Score
                    </th>
                    <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                      Weight
                    </th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-200">
                  {questions.map((question) => (
                    <tr key={question.id}>
                      <td className="px-6 py-4">
                        <div className="font-medium text-gray-900">{question.question_text}</div>
                        <div className="text-xs text-gray-500">{question.question_type}</div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                        <Select
                          value={question.category_id}
                          onChange={(e) => handleQuestionChange(question.id, 'category_id', e.target.value)}
                        >
                          <option value="">No Category</option>
                          {categories.map(cat => (
                            <option key={cat.id} value={cat.id}>
                              {cat.name}
                            </option>
                          ))}
                        </Select>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                        <Input
                          type="number"
                          min="1"
                          max="10"
                          value={question.max_score}
                          onChange={(e) => handleQuestionChange(question.id, 'max_score', e.target.value)}
                          className="w-20"
                        />
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                        <Input
                          type="number"
                          min="1"
                          max="5"
                          value={question.score_weight}
                          onChange={(e) => handleQuestionChange(question.id, 'score_weight', e.target.value)}
                          className="w-20"
                        />
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="text-center py-8 text-gray-500">
              <p>This form has no questions yet.</p>
              <Link href={`/forms/${id}/edit`}>
                <a className="mt-4 inline-flex items-center text-primary-600 hover:text-primary-700">
                  <FiList className="mr-2" />
                  Add questions to your form
                </a>
              </Link>
            </div>
          )}
        </Card.Content>
        <Card.Footer className="flex justify-end space-x-2 border-t pt-6">
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            onClick={() => router.push(`/forms/${id}`)}
            disabled={isSaving}
          >
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleSave}
            disabled={isSaving || questions.length === 0}
            className="flex items-center"
          >
            <FiSave className="mr-2" />
            {isSaving ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Score Settings'}
          </Button>
        </Card.Footer>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/router';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { 
  FiMail, FiPhone, FiBriefcase, 
  FiEdit, FiFileText, FiUser
} from 'react-icons/fi';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { getUser } from '../../lib/auth';
import { 
  getEmployeeById, 
  getDepartmentById
} from '../../lib/data';
import { Button } from '../../components/Button';
import { Card } from '../../components/Card';
import { Avatar } from '../../components/Avatar';

export default function ProfilePage({ user }) {
  const [employee, setEmployee] = useState(null);
  const [department, setDepartment] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const router = useRouter();

  useEffect(() => {
    loadEmployeeData();
  }, []);

  const loadEmployeeData = () => {
    try {
      const currentUser = user || getUser();
      
      if (!currentUser) {
        router.push('/login');
        return;
      }
      
      const employeeData = getEmployeeById(currentUser.id);
      
      if (!employeeData) {
        toast.error('Employee profile not found');
        return;
      }
      
      // Load department if exists
      let departmentData = null;
      if (employeeData.departmentId) {
        departmentData = getDepartmentById(employeeData.departmentId);
      }
      
      setEmployee(employeeData);
      setDepartment(departmentData);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to load employee data:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to load employee data');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex justify-center items-center h-64">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-t-2 border-b-2 border-primary-600"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!employee) {
    return (
      <div className="text-center py-12">
        <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold mb-2">Profile not found</h2>
        <p className="text-gray-500 mb-6">We couldn't find your employee profile.</p>
        <Button onClick={() => router.push('/')}>
          Return to Dashboard
        </Button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 fade-in">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">My Profile</h1>
        <div className="flex space-x-2">
          <Link href="/reports">
            <a>
              <Button variant="outline" className="flex items-center">
                <FiFileText className="mr-2" />
                My Reports
              </Button>
            </a>
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Employee Profile */}
        <Card className="md:col-span-1">
          <Card.Header className="text-center pb-2">
            <div className="flex justify-center mb-4">
              <Avatar 
                fallback={employee.name} 
                size="xl" 
              />
            </div>
            <Card.Title>{employee.name}</Card.Title>
            <p className="text-gray-500 mt-1">{employee.designation}</p>
          </Card.Header>
          <Card.Content>
            <div className="space-y-4 mt-4">
              <div className="flex items-center">
                <FiMail className="text-gray-400 mr-3" />
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">Email</p>
                  <p className="font-medium">{employee.email}</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center">
                <FiPhone className="text-gray-400 mr-3" />
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">Phone</p>
                  <p className="font-medium">{employee.phoneNumber}</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center">
                <FiBriefcase className="text-gray-400 mr-3" />

                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">Department</p>
