import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { FiPlusCircle, FiSearch, FiFilter, FiX, FiCalendar, FiUsers } from 'react-icons/fi';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { Button } from '../../components/Button';
import { Input } from '../../components/Input';
import { Select } from '../../components/Select';
import { ProjectCard } from '../../components/ProjectCard';
import { EmptyState } from '../../components/EmptyState';
import { Modal } from '../../components/Modal';
import { Label } from '../../components/Label';
import { getMonthsArray, getYearsArray } from '../../lib/utils';

export async function getServerSideProps() {
  // Import database functions only on server-side
  const { 
    getProjects, 
    getProjectManagers 
  } = require('../../lib/data');

  try {
    const [projects, projectManagers] = await Promise.all([
      getProjects(),
      getProjectManagers()
    ]);

    // Serialize dates
    const serializedProjects = Array.isArray(projects) ? projects.map(project => ({
      ...project,
      created_at: project.created_at ? project.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: project.updated_at ? project.updated_at.toISOString() : null
    })) : [];

    const serializedProjectManagers = Array.isArray(projectManagers) ? projectManagers.map(pm => ({
      ...pm,
      created_at: pm.created_at ? pm.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: pm.updated_at ? pm.updated_at.toISOString() : null
    })) : [];

    return {
      props: {
        initialProjects: serializedProjects,
        initialProjectManagers: serializedProjectManagers
      }
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching projects data:', error);
    return {
      props: {
        initialProjects: [],
        initialProjectManagers: []
      }
    };
  }
}

export default function Projects({ initialProjects, initialProjectManagers }) {
  const [projects, setProjects] = useState(initialProjects);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [isDeleteModalOpen, setIsDeleteModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [projectToDelete, setProjectToDelete] = useState(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  
  // Add filter states
  const [monthFilter, setMonthFilter] = useState('');
  const [yearFilter, setYearFilter] = useState('');
  const [showFilters, setShowFilters] = useState(false);
  
  // Get filter options
  const months = getMonthsArray();
  const years = getYearsArray();

  const refreshProjects = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/projects');
      if (response.ok) {
        const projectData = await response.json();
        setProjects(projectData);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to refresh projects:', error);
    }
  };

  const handleSearchChange = (e) => {
    setSearchQuery(e.target.value);
  };

  const handleMonthFilterChange = (e) => {
    setMonthFilter(e.target.value);
  };

  const handleYearFilterChange = (e) => {
    setYearFilter(e.target.value);
  };

  const clearFilters = () => {
    setSearchQuery('');
    setMonthFilter('');
    setYearFilter('');
  };

  const toggleFilters = () => {
    setShowFilters(!showFilters);
  };

  const handleDeleteClick = (project) => {
    setProjectToDelete(project);
    setIsDeleteModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleEditClick = (project) => {
    // Navigate to edit page
    window.location.href = `/projects/${project.id}/edit`;
  };

  const confirmDelete = async () => {
    if (!projectToDelete) return;
    
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`/api/projects/${projectToDelete.id}`, {
        method: 'DELETE'
      });
      
      if (response.ok) {
        toast.success(`${projectToDelete.name} has been deleted`);
        await refreshProjects();
      } else {
        toast.error('Failed to delete project');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('An error occurred while deleting');
      console.error(error);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
      setIsDeleteModalOpen(false);
      setProjectToDelete(null);
    }
  };

  // Filter projects based on search, month, and year
  const filteredProjects = projects.filter(proj => {
    const matchesSearch = proj.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
    const matchesMonth = !monthFilter || proj.startMonth === monthFilter;
    const matchesYear = !yearFilter || proj.startYear === yearFilter;
    
    return matchesSearch && matchesMonth && matchesYear;
  });

  const hasActiveFilters = searchQuery || monthFilter || yearFilter;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 fade-in">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">Projects</h1>
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2">
          <Link href="/projects/new">
            <a>
              <Button className="w-full sm:w-auto flex items-center justify-center">
                <FiPlusCircle className="mr-2" />
                New Project
              </Button>
            </a>
          </Link>
          <Link href="/projects/allocations">
            <a>
              <Button variant="outline" className="w-full sm:w-auto flex items-center justify-center">
                <FiUsers className="mr-2" />
                Project Allocations
              </Button>
            </a>
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Search and Filter Controls */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-4">
          <div className="relative flex-grow">
            <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-gray-400">
              <FiSearch />
            </div>
            <Input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search projects..."
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={handleSearchChange}
              className="pl-10"
            />
          </div>
          
          <Button 
            variant="outline" 
            onClick={toggleFilters}
            className="flex items-center"
          >
            <FiFilter className="mr-2" />
            {showFilters ? 'Hide Filters' : 'Show Filters'}
          </Button>
        </div>

        {/* Expanded Filters */}
        {showFilters && (
          <div className="bg-gray-50 p-4 rounded-md border border-gray-200 animate-in slide-in">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="monthFilter">Filter by Month</Label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-gray-400">
                    <FiCalendar />
                  </div>
                  <Select
                    id="monthFilter"
                    value={monthFilter}
                    onChange={handleMonthFilterChange}
                    className="pl-10"
                  >
                    <option value="">All Months</option>
                    {months.map(month => (
                      <option key={month.value} value={month.value}>
                        {month.label}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </Select>
                </div>
              </div>
              
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="yearFilter">Filter by Year</Label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-gray-400">
                    <FiCalendar />
                  </div>
                  <Select
                    id="yearFilter"
                    value={yearFilter}
                    onChange={handleYearFilterChange}
                    className="pl-10"
                  >
                    <option value="">All Years</option>
                    {years.map(year => (
                      <option key={year.value} value={year.value}>
                        {year.label}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </Select>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      
      {/* Active Filters Indicator */}
      {hasActiveFilters && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center bg-gray-100 px-4 py-2 rounded-md">
          <span className="text-sm text-gray-600 mr-2">Filters applied:</span>
          {searchQuery && (
            <span className="bg-primary-100 text-primary-800 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-full flex items-center mr-2 mb-2 sm:mb-0">
              Search: "{searchQuery}"
              <button 
                onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')}
                className="ml-1 text-primary-600 hover:text-primary-800"
              >
                <FiX size={14} />
              </button>
            </span>
          )}
          {monthFilter && (
            <span className="bg-primary-100 text-primary-800 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-full flex items-center mr-2 mb-2 sm:mb-0">
              Month: {months.find(m => m.value === monthFilter)?.label}
              <button 
                onClick={() => setMonthFilter('')}
                className="ml-1 text-primary-600 hover:text-primary-800"
              >
                <FiX size={14} />
              </button>
            </span>
          )}
          {yearFilter && (
            <span className="bg-primary-100 text-primary-800 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-full flex items-center mr-2 mb-2 sm:mb-0">
              Year: {yearFilter}
              <button 
                onClick={() => setYearFilter('')}
                className="ml-1 text-primary-600 hover:text-primary-800"
              >
                <FiX size={14} />
              </button>
            </span>
          )}
          <button 
            onClick={clearFilters}
            className="text-xs text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 ml-auto"
          >
            Clear all
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Project Grid */}
      {projects.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState 
          title="No projects yet"
          description="Get started by creating your first project"
          action={() => window.location.href = '/projects/new'}
        />
      ) : filteredProjects.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState 
          title="No matching projects"
          description="Try different search terms or filters"
          action={clearFilters}
          actionText="Clear Filters"
        />
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          {filteredProjects.map((proj) => (
            <ProjectCard
              key={proj.id}
              project={proj}
              memberCount={proj.memberCount}
              projectManager={proj.projectManager}
              onEdit={handleEditClick}
              onDelete={handleDeleteClick}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Delete Confirmation Modal */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={isDeleteModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsDeleteModalOpen(false)}
        title="Delete Project"
        description="Are you sure you want to delete this project? This action cannot be undone."
        footer={
          <>
            <Button 
              variant="outline" 
              onClick={() => setIsDeleteModalOpen(false)}
              disabled={isLoading}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button 
              variant="destructive" 
              onClick={confirmDelete}
              disabled={isLoading}
            >
              {isLoading ? 'Deleting...' : 'Delete'}
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        {projectToDelete && (
          <div className="text-sm text-gray-500">
            <p>
              This will permanently delete the project 
              <span className="font-semibold text-gray-700"> {projectToDelete.name} </span>
              and remove all team member associations.
            </p>
            <p className="mt-2">
              The employees will not be deleted, but they will no longer be associated with this project.
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/router';
import { FiArrowLeft, FiSave } from 'react-icons/fi';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { Button } from '../../components/Button';
import { Input } from '../../components/Input';
import { Select } from '../../components/Select';
import { Label } from '../../components/Label';
import { Card } from '../../components/Card';
import { getMonthsArray, getYearsArray } from '../../lib/utils';

export default function NewProject({ projectManagers }) {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: '',
    startMonth: new Date().getMonth() + 1 < 10 
      ? `0${new Date().getMonth() + 1}` 
      : `${new Date().getMonth() + 1}`,
    startYear: new Date().getFullYear().toString(),
    status: 'active',
    projectManagerId: ''
  });
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const router = useRouter();
  const months = getMonthsArray();
  const years = getYearsArray();

  const validateForm = () => {
    const newErrors = {};
    
    if (!formData.name.trim()) {
      newErrors.name = 'Project name is required';
    }
    
    setErrors(newErrors);
    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;
  };

  const handleChange = (e) => {
    const { name, value } = e.target;
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: value }));
    
    // Clear error when field is edited
    if (errors[name]) {
      setErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: undefined }));
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if (!validateForm()) return;
    
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/projects', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(formData),
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        const newProject = await response.json();
        toast.success(`Project "${newProject.name}" has been created`);
        router.push('/projects');
      } else {
        const error = await response.json();
        throw new Error(error.message || 'Failed to create project');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to create project:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to create project');
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto fade-in">
      <div className="mb-6">
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          onClick={() => router.push('/projects')}
          className="mb-2"
        >
          <FiArrowLeft className="mr-2" />
          Back to Projects
        </Button>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">Create New Project</h1>
      </div>

      <Card>
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
          <Card.Content className="space-y-6">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="name">
                Project Name <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="name"
                name="name"
                value={formData.name}
                onChange={handleChange}
                placeholder="e.g. Website Redesign, Mobile App Development"
                className={errors.name ? 'border-red-500' : ''}
              />
              {errors.name && (
                <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-1">{errors.name}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="startMonth">
                  Start Month <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                </Label>
                <Select
                  id="startMonth"
                  name="startMonth"
                  value={formData.startMonth}
                  onChange={handleChange}
                >
                  {months.map(month => (
                    <option key={month.value} value={month.value}>
                      {month.label}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </Select>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="startYear">
                  Start Year <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                </Label>
                <Select
                  id="startYear"
                  name="startYear"
                  value={formData.startYear}
                  onChange={handleChange}
                >
                  {years.map(year => (
                    <option key={year.value} value={year.value}>
                      {year.label}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </Select>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="projectManagerId">Project Manager</Label>
              <Select
                id="projectManagerId"
                name="projectManagerId"
                value={formData.projectManagerId}
                onChange={handleChange}
              >
                <option value="">-- Select Project Manager (Optional) --</option>
                {projectManagers.map(pm => (
                  <option key={pm.id} value={pm.id}>
                    {pm.name} - {pm.designation}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </Select>
              {projectManagers.length === 0 && (
                <p className="text-amber-600 text-sm mt-1">
                  No project managers available. You can assign employees with the "Project Manager (PM)" job role.
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
          </Card.Content>

          <Card.Footer className="flex justify-end space-x-2 border-t pt-6">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => router.push('/projects')}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="submit"
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              className="flex items-center"
            >
              <FiSave className="mr-2" />
              {isSubmitting ? 'Creating...' : 'Create Project'}
            </Button>
          </Card.Footer>
        </form>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

export async function getServerSideProps(context) {
  // Import database functions only on server-side
  const { 
    getProjectById, 
    getProjectManagers
  } = require('../../../lib/data');
  const { id } = context.params;

  try {
    const [projectData, pmData] = await Promise.all([
      getProjectById(id),
      getProjectManagers()
    ]);
    
    if (!projectData) {
      return {
        notFound: true
      };
    }
    
    // Serialize dates
    const serializedProject = {
      ...projectData,
      created_at: projectData.created_at ? projectData.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: projectData.updated_at ? projectData.updated_at.toISOString() : null
    };

    const serializedProjectManagers = pmData.map(pm => ({
      ...pm,
      created_at: pm.created_at ? pm.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: pm.updated_at ? pm.updated_at.toISOString() : null
    }));

    return {
      props: {
        project: serializedProject,
        projectManagers: serializedProjectManagers
      }
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching project data:', error);
    return {
      notFound: true
    };
  }
}

export default function EditProject({ project, projectManagers }) {

    startYear: project.startYear,
    status: project.status || 'active',
    projectManagerId: project.projectManagerId || ''
  });
  const [originalData, setOriginalData] = useState(project);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const router = useRouter();
  const { id } = router.query;
  const months = getMonthsArray();
  const years = getYearsArray();

  const validateForm = () => {
    const newErrors = {};
    
    if (!formData.name.trim()) {
      newErrors.name = 'Project name is required';
    }
    
    setErrors(newErrors);
    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;
  };

  const handleChange = (e) => {
    const { name, value } = e.target;
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: value }));
    
    // Clear error when field is edited
    if (errors[name]) {
      setErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: undefined }));
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if (!validateForm()) return;
    
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`/api/projects/${id}`, {
        method: 'PUT',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(formData),
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        const updatedProject = await response.json();
        toast.success(`Project "${updatedProject.name}" has been updated`);

        const error = await response.json();
        throw new Error(error.message || 'Failed to update project');

      console.error('Failed to update project:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to update project');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {

      <Card>
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
          <Card.Content className="space-y-6">

              <Label htmlFor="name">
                Project Name <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="name"
                name="name"
                value={formData.name}
                onChange={handleChange}
                placeholder="e.g. Website Redesign, Mobile App Development"
                className={errors.name ? 'border-red-500' : ''}
              />
              {errors.name && (
                <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-1">{errors.name}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="startMonth">
                  Start Month <span className="text-red-500">*</span>

                      {year.label}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </Select>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="status">Status</Label>
              <Select
                id="status"
                name="status"
                value={formData.status}
                onChange={handleChange}

                <option value="active">Active</option>
                <option value="inactive">Inactive</option>
                <option value="completed">Completed</option>
              </Select>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="projectManagerId">Project Manager</Label>
              <Select
                id="projectManagerId"
                name="projectManagerId"

export async function getServerSideProps(context) {
  // Import database functions only on server-side
  const { 
    getProjectById, 
    getProjectMembers, 
    getProjectManager,
    getEmployees
  } = require('../../../lib/data');
  const { id } = context.params;

  try {
    const [projectData, memberData, managerData, allEmployees] = await Promise.all([
      getProjectById(id),
      getProjectMembers(id),
      getProjectManager(id),
      getEmployees()
    ]);
    
    if (!projectData) {
      return {
        notFound: true
      };
    }
    
    // Get available employees (employees not in this project)
    const memberIds = memberData.map(member => member.id);
    const availableEmps = allEmployees.filter(emp => !memberIds.includes(emp.id));
    
    // Serialize dates
    const serializedProject = {
      ...projectData,
      created_at: projectData.created_at ? projectData.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: projectData.updated_at ? projectData.updated_at.toISOString() : null
    };

    const serializedMembers = memberData.map(member => ({
      ...member,
      created_at: member.created_at ? member.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: member.updated_at ? member.updated_at.toISOString() : null
    }));

    const serializedManager = managerData ? {
      ...managerData,
      created_at: managerData.created_at ? managerData.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: managerData.updated_at ? managerData.updated_at.toISOString() : null
    } : null;

    const serializedAvailableEmployees = availableEmps.map(emp => ({
      ...emp,
      created_at: emp.created_at ? emp.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: emp.updated_at ? emp.updated_at.toISOString() : null
    }));

    return {
      props: {
        project: serializedProject,
        members: serializedMembers,
        projectManager: serializedManager,
        availableEmployees: serializedAvailableEmployees
      }
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching project data:', error);
    return {
      notFound: true
    };
  }
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/router';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { 
  FiArrowLeft, FiEdit, FiTrash2, FiPlus, 
  FiUsers, FiUser, FiMail, FiPhone, FiCalendar
} from 'react-icons/fi';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { Button } from '../../../components/Button';
import { Card } from '../../../components/Card';
import { Avatar } from '../../../components/Avatar';
import { Modal } from '../../../components/Modal';
import { EmptyState } from '../../../components/EmptyState';
import { Select } from '../../../components/Select';
import { Label } from '../../../components/Label';
import { getMonthsArray } from '../../../lib/utils';

export default function ProjectDetails({ project: initialProject, members: initialMembers, projectManager: initialProjectManager, availableEmployees: initialAvailableEmployees }) {
  const [project, setProject] = useState(initialProject);
  const [members, setMembers] = useState(initialMembers);
  const [projectManager, setProjectManager] = useState(initialProjectManager);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [isDeleteModalOpen, setIsDeleteModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isDeleting, setIsDeleting] = useState(false);
  const [isAddMemberModalOpen, setIsAddMemberModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [availableEmployees, setAvailableEmployees] = useState(initialAvailableEmployees);
  const [selectedEmployeeId, setSelectedEmployeeId] = useState('');
  const [isAddingMember, setIsAddingMember] = useState(false);
  const [isRemoveMemberModalOpen, setIsRemoveMemberModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [memberToRemove, setMemberToRemove] = useState(null);
  const [isRemovingMember, setIsRemovingMember] = useState(false);
  const router = useRouter();
  const { id } = router.query;
  const months = getMonthsArray();

  const loadProjectData = async () => {
    try {
      // Refresh data via API calls
      const response = await fetch(`/api/projects/${id}`);
      if (response.ok) {
        const projectData = await response.json();
        setProject(projectData);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to load project data:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to load project data');
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    setIsDeleting(true);
    
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`/api/projects/${id}`, {
        method: 'DELETE'
      });
      
      if (response.ok) {
        toast.success(`Project "${project.name}" has been deleted`);
        router.push('/projects');
      } else {
        throw new Error('Failed to delete project');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to delete project:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to delete project');
      setIsDeleting(false);
      setIsDeleteModalOpen(false);
    }
  };

  const handleAddMemberClick = () => {
    setSelectedEmployeeId('');
    setIsAddMemberModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleEmployeeSelect = (e) => {
    setSelectedEmployeeId(e.target.value);
  };

  const handleAddMember = async () => {
    if (!selectedEmployeeId) {
      toast.error('Please select an employee');
      return;
    }

    setIsAddingMember(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`/api/projects/${id}/members`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ employeeId: selectedEmployeeId }),
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        const employee = availableEmployees.find(emp => emp.id === selectedEmployeeId);
        toast.success(`${employee?.name} has been added to this project`);
        setIsAddMemberModalOpen(false);
        // Refresh the page to show updated data
        window.location.reload();
      } else {
        const error = await response.json();
        throw new Error(error.message || 'Failed to add member to project');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to add member:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to add member to project');
    } finally {
      setIsAddingMember(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRemoveMemberClick = (member) => {
    setMemberToRemove(member);
    setIsRemoveMemberModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleRemoveMember = async () => {
    if (!memberToRemove) return;

    setIsRemovingMember(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`/api/projects/${id}/members`, {
        method: 'DELETE',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ employeeId: memberToRemove.id }),
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        toast.success(`${memberToRemove.name} has been removed from this project`);
        setIsRemoveMemberModalOpen(false);
        // Refresh the page to show updated data
        window.location.reload();
      } else {
        const error = await response.json();
        throw new Error(error.message || 'Failed to remove member from project');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to remove member:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to remove member from project');
    } finally {
      setIsRemovingMember(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex justify-center items-center h-64">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-t-2 border-b-2 border-primary-600"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!project) {
    return (
      <div className="text-center py-12">
        <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold mb-2">Project not found</h2>
        <p className="text-gray-500 mb-6">The project you're looking for doesn't exist or has been removed.</p>
        <Link href="/projects">
          <a>
            <Button>Return to Projects</Button>
          </a>
        </Link>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const monthName = months.find(m => m.value === project.startMonth)?.label || '';

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 fade-in">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => router.push('/projects')}
            className="mb-2"
          >
            <FiArrowLeft className="mr-2" />
            Back to Projects
          </Button>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">{project.name}</h1>
        </div>
        <div className="flex space-x-2">
          <Link href={`/projects/${id}/edit`}>
            <a>
              <Button variant="outline" className="flex items-center">
                <FiEdit className="mr-2" />
                Edit
              </Button>
            </a>
          </Link>
          <Button 
            variant="outline" 
            className="flex items-center text-red-600 border-red-200 hover:bg-red-50"
            onClick={() => setIsDeleteModalOpen(true)}
          >
            <FiTrash2 className="mr-2" />
            Delete
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Project Info */}
        <Card className="lg:col-span-1">
          <Card.Header>
            <Card.Title>Project Info</Card.Title>
          </Card.Header>
          <Card.Content>
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-500">Name</h3>
                <p className="mt-1">{project.name}</p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-500">Start Date</h3>
                <p className="mt-1">{monthName} {project.startYear}</p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-500">Status</h3>
                <div className="mt-1">
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-green-100 text-green-800">
                    {project.status === 'active' ? 'Active' : 'Inactive'}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-500">Team Size</h3>
                <p className="mt-1">{members.length} member{members.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </Card.Content>
        </Card>

        {/* Project Manager */}
        <Card className="lg:col-span-2">
          <Card.Header>
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
              <Card.Title>Project Manager</Card.Title>
              <Link href={`/projects/${id}/edit`}>
                <a>
                  <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">
                    Change
                  </Button>
                </a>
              </Link>
            </div>
          </Card.Header>
          <Card.Content>
            {projectManager ? (
              <div className="flex items-center">
                <Avatar 
                  fallback={projectManager.name} 
                  size="lg" 
                  className="mr-4"
                />
                <div>
                  <h3 className="font-medium">{projectManager.name}</h3>
                  <p className="text-gray-500">{projectManager.designation}</p>
                  <div className="flex items-center mt-2 text-sm text-gray-500">
                    <FiMail className="mr-1" />
                    <span>{projectManager.email}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-center py-6 text-gray-500">
                <FiUser className="mx-auto h-12 w-12 text-gray-400 mb-3" />
                <p>No project manager assigned to this project.</p>
                <Link href={`/projects/${id}/edit`}>
                  <a>
                    <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="mt-3">
                      Assign Project Manager
                    </Button>
                  </a>
                </Link>
              </div>
            )}
          </Card.Content>
        </Card>

        {/* Project Team */}
        <Card className="lg:col-span-3">
          <Card.Header>
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
              <Card.Title>Project Team</Card.Title>
              <Button 
                size="sm" 
                className="flex items-center"
                onClick={handleAddMemberClick}
              >
                <FiPlus className="mr-1" />
                Add Team Member
              </Button>
            </div>
          </Card.Header>
          <Card.Content>
            {members.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState 
                title="No team members yet"
                description="This project doesn't have any team members yet. Add employees to this project."
                icon={<FiUsers className="h-12 w-12" />}
                action={handleAddMemberClick}
                actionText="Add Team Member"
              />
            ) : (
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-200">
                  <thead className="bg-gray-50">
                    <tr>
                      <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                        Employee
                      </th>
                      <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                        Contact
                      </th>
                      <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                        Department
                      </th>
                      <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                        Actions
                      </th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-200">
                    {members.map((member) => {
                      const department = member.departmentId ? getDepartmentById(member.departmentId) : null;
                      return (
                        <tr key={member.id} className="hover:bg-gray-50">
                          <td className="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                            <div className="flex items-center">
                              <Avatar 
                                fallback={member.name} 
                                size="sm" 
                                className="mr-3"
                              />
                              <div>
                                <div className="font-medium">{member.name}</div>
                                <div className="text-sm text-gray-500">{member.designation}</div>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap text-sm text-gray-500">
                            <div className="flex items-center">
                              <FiMail className="mr-2" />
                              {member.email}
                            </div>
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap text-sm">
                            {department ? (
                              <Link href={`/departments/${department.id}`}>
                                <a className="text-primary-600 hover:text-primary-800">
                                  {department.name}
                                </a>
                              </Link>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="text-gray-500">No Department</span>
                            )}
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap text-sm">
                            <div className="flex space-x-2">
                              <Link href={`/employees/${member.id}`}>
                                <a className="text-primary-600 hover:text-primary-800 font-medium">
                                  View
                                </a>
                              </Link>
                              <button
                                onClick={() => handleRemoveMemberClick(member)}
                                className="text-red-600 hover:text-red-800 font-medium"
                              >
                                Remove
                              </button>
                            </div>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      );
                    })}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            )}
          </Card.Content>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Delete Confirmation Modal */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={isDeleteModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsDeleteModalOpen(false)}
        title="Delete Project"
        description="Are you sure you want to delete this project? This action cannot be undone."
        footer={
          <>
            <Button 
              variant="outline" 
              onClick={() => setIsDeleteModalOpen(false)}
              disabled={isDeleting}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button 
              variant="destructive" 
              onClick={handleDelete}
              disabled={isDeleting}
            >
              {isDeleting ? 'Deleting...' : 'Delete Project'}
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <div className="text-sm text-gray-500">
          <p>
            This will permanently delete the project 
            <span className="font-semibold text-gray-700"> {project.name} </span>
            and remove all team member associations.
          </p>
          <p className="mt-2">
            The employees will not be deleted, but they will no longer be associated with this project.
          </p>
        </div>
      </Modal>

      {/* Add Member Modal */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={isAddMemberModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsAddMemberModalOpen(false)}
        title="Add Team Member"
        description="Select an employee to add to this project"
        size="lg"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button 
              variant="outline" 
              onClick={() => setIsAddMemberModalOpen(false)}
              disabled={isAddingMember}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button 
              onClick={handleAddMember}
              disabled={isAddingMember || !selectedEmployeeId}
            >
              {isAddingMember ? 'Adding...' : 'Add to Project'}
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {availableEmployees.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="text-center py-6">
              <p className="text-gray-500">No available employees to add to this project.</p>
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-400 mt-2">All employees are already assigned to this project.</p>
              <Link href="/employees/new">
                <a>
                  <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="mt-4">
                    Create New Employee
                  </Button>

          ) : (

                <Label htmlFor="employeeId">Select Employee</Label>
                <Select
                  id="employeeId"
                  value={selectedEmployeeId}
                  onChange={handleEmployeeSelect}
                  className={!selectedEmployeeId ? 'border-gray-300' : ''}
                >
                  <option value="">-- Select an Employee --</option>
                  {availableEmployees.map(emp => (
                    <option key={emp.id} value={emp.id}>
                      {emp.name} - {emp.designation}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </Select>
              </div>
              
              {selectedEmployeeId && (
                <div className="bg-gray-50 p-4 rounded-md mt-4">
                  <h3 className="font-medium mb-2">Employee Details</h3>
                  {(() => {
                    const employee = availableEmployees.find(e => e.id === selectedEmployeeId);
                    const department = employee?.departmentId 
                      ? getDepartmentById(employee.departmentId) 
                      : null;
                    
                    return employee ? (
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-sm">
                        <div>
                          <p className="text-gray-500">Name</p>
                          <p className="font-medium">{employee.name}</p>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <p className="text-gray-500">Email</p>
                          <p className="font-medium">{employee.email}</p>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <p className="text-gray-500">Phone</p>
                          <p className="font-medium">{employee.phoneNumber}</p>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <p className="text-gray-500">Department</p>
                          <p className="font-medium">{department ? department.name : 'None'}</p>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <p className="text-gray-500">Designation</p>
                          <p className="font-medium">{employee.designation}</p>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <p className="text-gray-500">Job Role</p>
                          <p className="font-medium">{employee.jobRole}</p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ) : null;
                  })()}
                </div>
              )}
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </Modal>

      {/* Remove Member Modal */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={isRemoveMemberModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsRemoveMemberModalOpen(false)}
        title="Remove Team Member"
        description="Are you sure you want to remove this member from the project?"

          <>
            <Button 
              variant="outline"

export async function getServerSideProps() {
  // Import database functions only on server-side
  const { getProjects } = require('../../../lib/data');

  try {
    const projectData = await getProjects();

    // Serialize dates
    const serializedProjects = Array.isArray(projectData) ? projectData.map(project => ({
      ...project,
      created_at: project.created_at ? project.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: project.updated_at ? project.updated_at.toISOString() : null
    })) : [];

    return {
      props: {
        initialProjects: serializedProjects
      }
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching projects:', error);
    return {
      props: {
        initialProjects: []
      }
    };
  }
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/router';
import { FiArrowLeft, FiCopy, FiCalendar, FiCheck, FiAlertCircle } from 'react-icons/fi';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { Button } from '../../../components/Button';
import { Select } from '../../../components/Select';
import { Label } from '../../../components/Label';
import { Card } from '../../../components/Card';
import { getMonthsArray, getYearsArray } from '../../../lib/utils';

export default function CopyAllocations({ initialProjects }) {
  const [sourceFormData, setSourceFormData] = useState({
    month: new Date().getMonth() === 0 
      ? '12' 
      : (new Date().getMonth() < 10 
        ? `0${new Date().getMonth()}` 
        : `${new Date().getMonth()}`),
    year: new Date().getMonth() === 0 
      ? (new Date().getFullYear() - 1).toString() 
      : new Date().getFullYear().toString(),
  });
  
  const [targetFormData, setTargetFormData] = useState({
    month: new Date().getMonth() + 1 < 10 
      ? `0${new Date().getMonth() + 1}` 
      : `${new Date().getMonth() + 1}`,
    year: new Date().getFullYear().toString(),
  });
  
  const [projects, setProjects] = useState(initialProjects);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [results, setResults] = useState(null);
  const router = useRouter();
  const months = getMonthsArray();
  const years = getYearsArray();

  const handleSourceChange = (e) => {
    const { name, value } = e.target;
    setSourceFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: value }));
  };

  const handleTargetChange = (e) => {
    const { name, value } = e.target;
    setTargetFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: value }));
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    
    try {
      // Validate that source and target aren't the same
      if (sourceFormData.month === targetFormData.month && sourceFormData.year === targetFormData.year) {
        toast.error('Source and target months cannot be the same');
        setIsSubmitting(false);
        return;
      }
      
      // Call the copy API
      const response = await fetch('/api/project-allocations/copy', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          sourceMonth: sourceFormData.month,
          sourceYear: sourceFormData.year,
          targetMonth: targetFormData.month,
          targetYear: targetFormData.year
        }),
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        const data = await response.json();
        setResults(data.results);
        
        if (!data.hasSourceAllocations) {
          toast.info(`No allocations found in ${getMonthLabel(sourceFormData.month)} ${sourceFormData.year}. Projects exist but have no allocations for this month.`);
        } else {
          if (data.successCount > 0) {
            toast.success(`Successfully copied ${data.successCount} project allocations`);
          } else {
            toast.error('Failed to copy any project allocations');
          }
        }
      } else {
        const errorData = await response.json();
        toast.error(errorData.error || 'Failed to copy allocations');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to copy allocations:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to copy allocations');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const getMonthLabel = (monthValue) => {
    return months.find(m => m.value === monthValue)?.label || '';
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto fade-in">
      <div className="mb-6">
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          onClick={() => router.push('/projects/allocations')}
          className="mb-2"
        >
          <FiArrowLeft className="mr-2" />
          Back to Allocations
        </Button>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">Copy Project Allocations</h1>
        <p className="text-gray-500 mt-1">
          Copy project allocations from a source month to a target month, including team members and project managers.
        </p>
      </div>

      <Card>
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
          <Card.Content className="space-y-6">
            <div className="bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 rounded-md p-4 mb-4">
              <div className="flex items-start">
                <FiCalendar className="text-blue-500 mt-1 mr-3 flex-shrink-0" />
                <div>
                  <h3 className="font-medium text-blue-800">Copy project allocations</h3>
                  <p className="text-sm text-blue-600 mt-1">
                    Select both source and target months to copy project allocations
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <h3 className="text-lg font-medium">Source Month</h3>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label htmlFor="sourceMonth">Source Month</Label>
                  <Select
                    id="sourceMonth"
                    name="month"
                    value={sourceFormData.month}
                    onChange={handleSourceChange}
                  >
                    {months.map(month => (
                      <option key={month.value} value={month.value}>
                        {month.label}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </Select>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label htmlFor="sourceYear">Source Year</Label>
                  <Select
                    id="sourceYear"
                    name="year"
                    value={sourceFormData.year}
                    onChange={handleSourceChange}
                  >
                    {years.map(year => (
                      <option key={year.value} value={year.value}>
                        {year.label}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </Select>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="border-t border-gray-200 pt-4 space-y-4">
              <h3 className="text-lg font-medium">Target Month</h3>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label htmlFor="targetMonth">Target Month</Label>
                  <Select
                    id="targetMonth"
                    name="month"
                    value={targetFormData.month}
                    onChange={handleTargetChange}
                  >
                    {months.map(month => (
                      <option key={month.value} value={month.value}>
                        {month.label}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </Select>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label htmlFor="targetYear">Target Year</Label>
                  <Select
                    id="targetYear"
                    name="year"
                    value={targetFormData.year}
                    onChange={handleTargetChange}
                  >
                    {years.map(year => (
                      <option key={year.value} value={year.value}>
                        {year.label}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </Select>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-md p-4">
              <div className="flex items-start">
                <FiCalendar className="text-amber-500 mt-1 mr-3 flex-shrink-0" />
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm text-amber-700">
                    You will be copying all project allocations from <strong>{getMonthLabel(sourceFormData.month)} {sourceFormData.year}</strong> to <strong>{getMonthLabel(targetFormData.month)} {targetFormData.year}</strong>
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            {results && (
              <div className="mt-4 border rounded-md overflow-hidden">
                <div className="bg-gray-50 px-4 py-2 border-b">
                  <h3 className="font-medium">Copy Results</h3>
                </div>
                <div className="p-4">
                  {results.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="flex items-center text-amber-600">
                      <FiAlertCircle className="mr-2" />
                      No projects found to copy allocations from
                    </div>
                  ) : !results.some(r => !r.noSourceAllocation) ? (
                    <div className="flex items-center text-amber-600">
                      <FiAlertCircle className="mr-2" />
                      Projects exist but no allocations found in {getMonthLabel(sourceFormData.month)} {sourceFormData.year} to copy
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      {results.map((result, index) => (
                        <div 
                          key={index} 
                          className={`flex items-center p-2 rounded ${
                            result.success ? 'bg-green-50 text-green-800' : 
                            result.noSourceAllocation ? 'bg-gray-50 text-gray-500' : 'bg-red-50 text-red-800'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {result.success ? (
                            <FiCheck className="mr-2 flex-shrink-0" />
                          ) : (
                            <FiAlertCircle className="mr-2 flex-shrink-0" />
                          )}
                          <div>
                            <span className="font-medium">{result.projectName}</span>
                            <span className="text-sm ml-2">
                              {result.success 
                                ? 'Successfully copied' 
                                : result.noSourceAllocation 
                                ? 'No allocation in source month' 
                                : 'Failed to copy'}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          {result.success && (
                            <Button
                              variant="ghost"
                              size="sm"
                              className="ml-auto"
                              onClick={() => router.push(`/projects/allocations/${result.allocationId}`)}
                            >
                              View
                            </Button>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </Card.Content>

          <Card.Footer className="flex justify-end space-x-2 border-t pt-6">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => router.push('/projects/allocations')}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="submit"
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              className="flex items-center"
            >
              <FiCopy className="mr-2" />
              {isSubmitting ? 'Copying...' : 'Copy Allocations'}
            </Button>
          </Card.Footer>
        </form>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

export async function getServerSideProps() {
  // Import database functions only on server-side
  const { getProjects, getEmployees, getProjectMembers } = require('../../../lib/data');

  try {
    const [projects, employees] = await Promise.all([
      getProjects(),
      getEmployees()
    ]);

    // Get member counts for each project
    const projectsWithMembers = await Promise.all(
      projects.map(async (project) => {
        const members = await getProjectMembers(project.id);
        return {
          ...project,
          memberCount: members.length,
          created_at: project.created_at ? project.created_at.toISOString() : null,
          updated_at: project.updated_at ? project.updated_at.toISOString() : null
        };
      })
    );

    const serializedEmployees = Array.isArray(employees) ? employees.map(emp => ({
      ...emp,
      created_at: emp.created_at ? emp.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: emp.updated_at ? emp.updated_at.toISOString() : null
    })) : [];

    return {
      props: {
        initialProjects: projectsWithMembers,
        initialEmployees: serializedEmployees
      }
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching allocations data:', error);
    return {
      props: {
        initialProjects: [],
        initialEmployees: []
      }
    };
  }
}

                    <div className="flex items-center text-sm text-gray-500">
                      <FiCopy className="mr-1" />
                      <span>{project.memberCount} members</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </Card.Header>
                <Card.Content>
                  <div className="space-y-4">
                    <div>
                      <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">Project Manager</p>
                      <p className="font-medium">
                        {project.manager ? project.manager.name : 'None assigned'}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">Team Members</p>
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mt-1">
                        {project.members.slice(0, 3).map(member => (
                          <span 
                            key={member.id} 
                            className="inline-block bg-gray-100 rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-xs"
                          >
                            {member.name}
                          </span>
                        ))}
                        {project.memberCount > 3 && (
                          <span className="inline-block bg-gray-100 rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-xs">
                            +{project.memberCount - 3} more
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </Card.Content>
                <Card.Footer>
                  <Link href={`/projects/allocations/${project.id}`}>
                    <a className="text-primary-600 hover:text-primary-700 text-sm font-medium w-full text-center py-1 hover:bg-primary-50 rounded transition-colors">
                      View Allocation
                    </a>
                  </Link>
                </Card.Footer>
              </Card>
            ))}
          </div>
        )
      ) : (
        <EmptyState 
          title="Select a project"
          description="Please select a project to view its allocations"
          icon={<FiSearch className="h-12 w-12" />}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export async function getServerSideProps() {
  // Import database functions only on server-side
  const { getProjects, getEmployees } = require('../../../lib/data');

  try {
    const [projects, employees] = await Promise.all([
      getProjects(),
      getEmployees()
    ]);

    const serializedProjects = Array.isArray(projects) ? projects.map(project => ({
      ...project,
      created_at: project.created_at ? project.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: project.updated_at ? project.updated_at.toISOString() : null
    })) : [];

    const serializedEmployees = Array.isArray(employees) ? employees.map(emp => ({
      ...emp,
      created_at: emp.created_at ? emp.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: emp.updated_at ? emp.updated_at.toISOString() : null
    })) : [];

    return {
      props: {
        projects: serializedProjects,
        employees: serializedEmployees
      }
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching allocation data:', error);
    return {
      props: {
        projects: [],
        employees: []
      }
    };
  }
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/router';
import { FiArrowLeft, FiSave, FiPlus, FiX, FiCopy } from 'react-icons/fi';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { Button } from '../../../components/Button';
import { Input } from '../../../components/Input';
import { Select } from '../../../components/Select';
import { Label } from '../../../components/Label';
import { Card } from '../../../components/Card';
import { Avatar } from '../../../components/Avatar';
import { getMonthsArray, getYearsArray } from '../../../lib/utils';

export default function NewProjectAllocation({ projects, employees }) {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    projectId: '',
    month: new Date().getMonth() + 1,
    year: new Date().getFullYear(),
    projectManagerId: ''
  });
  const [selectedEmployees, setSelectedEmployees] = useState([]);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const router = useRouter();
  const months = getMonthsArray();
  const years = getYearsArray(2020, new Date().getFullYear() + 2);

  // Get project managers (employees with role 'project_manager')
  const projectManagers = employees.filter(emp => emp.job_role === 'project_manager' || emp.jobRole === 'project_manager');

  const validateForm = () => {
    const newErrors = {};
    
    if (!formData.projectId) {
      newErrors.projectId = 'Project is required';
    }
    
    if (!formData.month) {
      newErrors.month = 'Month is required';
    }
    
    if (!formData.year) {
      newErrors.year = 'Year is required';
    }
    
    setErrors(newErrors);
    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;
  };

  const handleChange = (e) => {
    const { name, value } = e.target;
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: value }));
    
    // Clear error when field is edited
    if (errors[name]) {
      setErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: undefined }));
    }
  };

  const handleEmployeeToggle = (employeeId) => {
    setSelectedEmployees(prev => {
      if (prev.includes(employeeId)) {
        return prev.filter(id => id !== employeeId);
      } else {
        return [...prev, employeeId];
      }
    });
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if (!validateForm()) return;
    
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      // Create the allocation via API
      const response = await fetch('/api/project-allocations', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          projectId: formData.projectId,
          month: formData.month,
          year: formData.year,
          projectManagerId: formData.projectManagerId,
          employeeIds: selectedEmployees
        }),
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        const newAllocation = await response.json();
        toast.success('Project allocation has been created');
        router.push(`/projects/allocations`);
      } else {
        const errorData = await response.json();
        if (errorData.error) {
          setErrors({ general: errorData.error });
        } else {
          toast.error('Failed to create allocation');
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to create allocation:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to create allocation');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto fade-in">
      <div className="mb-6">
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          onClick={() => router.push('/projects/allocations')}
          className="mb-2"
        >
          <FiArrowLeft className="mr-2" />
          Back to Allocations
        </Button>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">Create New Project Allocation</h1>
      </div>

      <Card>
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
          <Card.Content className="space-y-6">
            {errors.general && (
              <div className="bg-red-50 text-red-600 p-3 rounded-md text-sm">
                {errors.general}
              </div>
            )}
            
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="projectId">
                  Project <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                </Label>
                <Select
                  id="projectId"
                  name="projectId"
                  value={formData.projectId}
                  onChange={handleChange}
                  className={errors.projectId ? 'border-red-500' : ''}
                >
                  <option value="">-- Select Project --</option>
                  {projects.map(project => (
                    <option key={project.id} value={project.id}>
                      {project.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </Select>
                {errors.projectId && (
                  <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-1">{errors.projectId}</p>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="projectManagerId">Project Manager</Label>
                <Select
                  id="projectManagerId"
                  name="projectManagerId"
                  value={formData.projectManagerId}
                  onChange={handleChange}
                >
                  <option value="">-- No Project Manager --</option>
                  {projectManagers.map(pm => (
                    <option key={pm.id} value={pm.id}>
                      {pm.name} - {pm.designation}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </Select>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="month">
                  Month <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                </Label>
                <Select
                  id="month"
                  name="month"
                  value={formData.month}
                  onChange={handleChange}
                  className={errors.month ? 'border-red-500' : ''}
                >
                  {months.map(month => (
                    <option key={month.value} value={month.value}>
                      {month.label}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </Select>
                {errors.month && (
                  <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-1">{errors.month}</p>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="year">
                  Year <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                </Label>
                <Select
                  id="year"
                  name="year"
                  value={formData.year}
                  onChange={handleChange}
                  className={errors.year ? 'border-red-500' : ''}
                >
                  {years.map(year => (
                    <option key={year.value} value={year.value}>
                      {year.label}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </Select>
                {errors.year && (
                  <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-1">{errors.year}</p>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>
                Team Members <span className="text-gray-500 text-sm">(Optional)</span>
              </Label>
              <div className="border border-gray-300 rounded-md p-4 max-h-60 overflow-y-auto">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  {employees.length === 0 ? (
                    <p className="text-gray-500 text-sm">No employees available</p>
                  ) : (
                    employees.map(employee => (
                      <div key={employee.id} className="flex items-center">
                        <input
                          type="checkbox"
                          id={`employee-${employee.id}`}
                          checked={selectedEmployees.includes(employee.id)}
                          onChange={() => handleEmployeeToggle(employee.id)}
                          className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 text-primary-600 focus:ring-primary-500 border-gray-300 rounded"
                        />
                        <label htmlFor={`employee-${employee.id}`} className="text-sm">
                          {employee.name} - {employee.designation}
                        </label>
                      </div>
                    ))
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-sm text-gray-500">
                <span>
                  {selectedEmployees.length} employees selected
                </span>
                {selectedEmployees.length > 0 && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setSelectedEmployees([])}
                    className="text-primary-600 hover:text-primary-800"
                  >
                    Clear selection
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </Card.Content>

          <Card.Footer className="flex justify-end space-x-2 border-t pt-6">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => router.push('/projects/allocations')}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="submit"
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              className="flex items-center"
            >
              <FiSave className="mr-2" />
              {isSubmitting ? 'Creating...' : 'Create Allocation'}
            </Button>
          </Card.Footer>
        </form>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">

              <Select

                name="projectManagerId"
                value={formData.projectManagerId}
                onChange={handleChange}
              >
                <option value="">-- No Project Manager --</option>
                {projectManagers.map(pm => (
                  <option key={pm.id} value={pm.id}>
                    {pm.name} - {pm.designation}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </Select>
              {projectManagers.length === 0 && (
                <p className="text-amber-600 text-sm mt-1">
                  No project managers available. You can assign employees with the "Project Manager (PM)" job role.
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
          </Card.Content>

          <Card.Footer className="flex justify-end space-x-2 border-t pt-6">
            <Button

  );
