import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/router';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { 
  FiArrowLeft, FiEdit, FiTrash2, FiPlus, FiUsers, 
  FiUser, FiCopy, FiCalendar, FiCheck 
} from 'react-icons/fi';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { 
  getProjectAllocationById, 
  getAllocationMembers, 
  getProjectById,
  getEmployees,
  getEmployeeById,
  getProjectManager,
  addAllocationMember,
  removeAllocationMember,
  deleteProjectAllocation,
  updateProjectAllocation,
  getProjectAllocation,
  copyAllocationFromMonth
} from '../../../../lib/data';
import { Button } from '../../../../components/Button';
import { Card } from '../../../../components/Card';
import { Avatar } from '../../../../components/Avatar';
import { Modal } from '../../../../components/Modal';
import { EmptyState } from '../../../../components/EmptyState';
import { Select } from '../../../../components/Select';
import { Label } from '../../../../components/Label';
import { getMonthsArray } from '../../../../lib/utils';

export default function AllocationDetails() {
  const [allocation, setAllocation] = useState(null);
  const [project, setProject] = useState(null);
  const [members, setMembers] = useState([]);
  const [projectManager, setProjectManager] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isDeleteModalOpen, setIsDeleteModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isDeleting, setIsDeleting] = useState(false);
  const [isAddMemberModalOpen, setIsAddMemberModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [availableEmployees, setAvailableEmployees] = useState([]);
  const [selectedEmployeeId, setSelectedEmployeeId] = useState('');
  const [isAddingMember, setIsAddingMember] = useState(false);
  const [isRemoveMemberModalOpen, setIsRemoveMemberModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [memberToRemove, setMemberToRemove] = useState(null);
  const [isRemovingMember, setIsRemovingMember] = useState(false);
  const [isCopyModalOpen, setIsCopyModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [copyFormData, setCopyFormData] = useState({ month: '', year: '' });
  const [isCopying, setIsCopying] = useState(false);
  const [months, setMonths] = useState([]);
  const router = useRouter();
  const { id } = router.query;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (id) {
      loadAllocationData();
      setMonths(getMonthsArray());
    }
  }, [id]);

  const loadAllocationData = () => {
    try {
      const allocationData = getProjectAllocationById(id);
      
      if (!allocationData) {
        toast.error('Allocation not found');
        router.push('/projects/allocations');
        return;
      }
      
      const projectData = getProjectById(allocationData.projectId);
      const memberData = getAllocationMembers(id);
      const managerData = allocationData.projectManagerId 
        ? getEmployeeById(allocationData.projectManagerId) 
        : null;
      
      // Get available employees (employees not in this allocation)
      const allEmployees = getEmployees();
      const memberIds = memberData.map(member => member.id);
      const availableEmps = allEmployees.filter(emp => !memberIds.includes(emp.id));
      
      setAllocation(allocationData);
      setProject(projectData);
      setMembers(memberData);
      setProjectManager(managerData);
      setAvailableEmployees(availableEmps);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to load allocation data:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to load allocation data');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    setIsDeleting(true);
    
    try {
      const success = deleteProjectAllocation(id);
      
      if (success) {
        toast.success(`Allocation has been deleted`);
        router.push('/projects/allocations');
      } else {
        throw new Error('Failed to delete allocation');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to delete allocation:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to delete allocation');
      setIsDeleting(false);
      setIsDeleteModalOpen(false);
    }
  };

  const handleAddMemberClick = () => {
    setSelectedEmployeeId('');
    setIsAddMemberModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleEmployeeSelect = (e) => {
    setSelectedEmployeeId(e.target.value);
  };

  const handleAddMember = async () => {
    if (!selectedEmployeeId) {
      toast.error('Please select an employee');
      return;
    }

    setIsAddingMember(true);
    try {
      // Add employee to allocation
      const newMember = addAllocationMember(id, selectedEmployeeId);
      
      if (newMember) {
        const employee = getEmployees().find(emp => emp.id === selectedEmployeeId);
        toast.success(`${employee?.name} has been added to this allocation`);
        setIsAddMemberModalOpen(false);
        loadAllocationData(); // Reload allocation data
      } else {
        throw new Error('Failed to add employee to allocation');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to add member:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to add member to allocation');
    } finally {
      setIsAddingMember(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRemoveMemberClick = (member) => {
    setMemberToRemove(member);
    setIsRemoveMemberModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleRemoveMember = async () => {
    if (!memberToRemove) return;

    setIsRemovingMember(true);
    try {
      const success = removeAllocationMember(id, memberToRemove.id);
      
      if (success) {
        toast.success(`${memberToRemove.name} has been removed from this allocation`);
        setIsRemoveMemberModalOpen(false);
        loadAllocationData(); // Reload allocation data
      } else {
        throw new Error('Failed to remove member from allocation');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to remove member:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to remove member from allocation');
    } finally {
      setIsRemovingMember(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopyToMonth = async () => {
    if (!copyFormData.month || !copyFormData.year) {
      toast.error('Please select month and year');
      return;
    }

    setIsCopying(true);
    try {
      const result = copyAllocationFromMonth(
        allocation.projectId,
        allocation.month,
        allocation.year,
        copyFormData.month,
        copyFormData.year
      );
      
      if (result) {
        toast.success(`Allocation has been copied to ${
          months.find(m => m.value === copyFormData.month)?.label
        } ${copyFormData.year}`);
        setIsCopyModalOpen(false);
        
        // Navigate to the new allocation
        router.push(`/projects/allocations/${result.id}`);
      } else {
        throw new Error('Failed to copy allocation');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to copy allocation:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to copy allocation');
    } finally {
      setIsCopying(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopyFormChange = (e) => {
    const { name, value } = e.target;
    setCopyFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: value }));
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex justify-center items-center h-64">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-t-2 border-b-2 border-primary-600"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!allocation || !project) {
    return (
      <div className="text-center py-12">
        <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold mb-2">Allocation not found</h2>
        <p className="text-gray-500 mb-6">The allocation you're looking for doesn't exist or has been removed.</p>
        <Link href="/projects/allocations">
          <a>
            <Button>Return to Allocations</Button>
          </a>
        </Link>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const monthName = months.find(m => m.value === allocation.month)?.label || '';

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 fade-in">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => router.push('/projects/allocations')}
            className="mb-2"
          >
            <FiArrowLeft className="mr-2" />
            Back to Allocations
          </Button>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">
            {project.name} - {monthName} {allocation.year}
          </h1>
        </div>
        <div className="flex space-x-2">
          <Button 
            variant="outline" 
            className="flex items-center"
            onClick={() => setIsCopyModalOpen(true)}
          >
            <FiCopy className="mr-2" />
            Copy to Month
          </Button>
          <Link href={`/projects/allocations/${id}/edit`}>
            <a>
              <Button variant="outline" className="flex items-center">
                <FiEdit className="mr-2" />
                Edit
              </Button>
            </a>
          </Link>
          <Button 
            variant="outline" 
            className="flex items-center text-red-600 border-red-200 hover:bg-red-50"
            onClick={() => setIsDeleteModalOpen(true)}
          >
            <FiTrash2 className="mr-2" />
            Delete
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Allocation Info */}
        <Card className="lg:col-span-1">
          <Card.Header>
            <Card.Title>Allocation Info</Card.Title>
          </Card.Header>
          <Card.Content>
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-500">Project</h3>
                <p className="mt-1">{project.name}</p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-500">Month/Year</h3>
                <p className="mt-1">{monthName} {allocation.year}</p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-500">Team Size</h3>
                <p className="mt-1">{members.length} member{members.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-500">Project Status</h3>
                <div className="mt-1">
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-green-100 text-green-800">
                    {project.status === 'active' ? 'Active' : 'Inactive'}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </Card.Content>
        </Card>

        {/* Project Manager */}
        <Card className="lg:col-span-2">
          <Card.Header>
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
              <Card.Title>Project Manager</Card.Title>
              <Link href={`/projects/allocations/${id}/edit`}>
                <a>
                  <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">
                    Change
                  </Button>
                </a>
              </Link>
            </div>
          </Card.Header>
          <Card.Content>
            {projectManager ? (
              <div className="flex items-center">
                <Avatar 
                  fallback={projectManager.name} 
                  size="lg" 
                  className="mr-4"
                />
                <div>
                  <h3 className="font-medium">{projectManager.name}</h3>
                  <p className="text-gray-500">{projectManager.designation}</p>
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">{projectManager.email}</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-center py-6 text-gray-500">
                <FiUser className="mx-auto h-12 w-12 text-gray-400 mb-3" />

                <Link href={`/projects/allocations/${id}/edit`}>
                  <a>
                    <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="mt-3">
                      Assign Project Manager
                    </Button>
                  </a>
                </Link>
              </div>
            )}
          </Card.Content>
        </Card>

        {/* Team Members */}
        <Card className="lg:col-span-3">
          <Card.Header>
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
              <Card.Title>Team Members</Card.Title>
              <Button 
                size="sm" 
                className="flex items-center"
                onClick={handleAddMemberClick}
              >
                <FiPlus className="mr-1" />
                Add Team Member
              </Button>
            </div>
          </Card.Header>
          <Card.Content>
            {members.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState 
                title="No team members yet"
                description="This allocation doesn't have any team members yet."
                icon={<FiUsers className="h-12 w-12" />}
                action={handleAddMemberClick}
                actionText="Add Team Member"
              />
            ) : (
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-200">
                  <thead className="bg-gray-50">
                    <tr>
                      <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                        Employee
                      </th>
                      <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                        Contact
                      </th>
                      <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                        Department
                      </th>
                      <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                        Actions
                      </th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-200">

      {/* Add Member Modal */}
      <Modal

        onClose={() => setIsAddMemberModalOpen(false)}

        description="Select an employee to add to this allocation"
        size="lg"
        footer={
          <>

              variant="outline" 
              onClick={() => setIsAddMemberModalOpen(false)}
              disabled={isAddingMember}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button 
              onClick={handleAddMember}
              disabled={isAddingMember || !selectedEmployeeId}
            >
              {isAddingMember ? 'Adding...' : 'Add to Allocation'}

          </>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          {availableEmployees.length === 0 ? (

                  className={!selectedEmployeeId ? 'border-gray-300' : ''}
                >
                  <option value="">-- Select an Employee --</option>

                    <option key={emp.id} value={emp.id}>
                      {emp.name} - {emp.designation}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </Select>
              </div>
              
              {selectedEmployeeId && (
                <div className="bg-gray-50 p-4 rounded-md mt-4">
                  <h3 className="font-medium mb-2">Employee Details</h3>
                  {(() => {
                    const employee = availableEmployees.find(e => e.id === selectedEmployeeId);
                    return employee ? (
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-sm">
                        <div>
                          <p className="text-gray-500">Name</p>
                          <p className="font-medium">{employee.name}</p>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <p className="text-gray-500">Email</p>
                          <p className="font-medium">{employee.email}</p>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <p className="text-gray-500">Phone</p>
                          <p className="font-medium">{employee.phoneNumber}</p>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <p className="text-gray-500">Designation</p>
                          <p className="font-medium">{employee.designation}</p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ) : null;
                  })()}
                </div>
              )}
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </Modal>

      {/* Remove Member Modal */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={isRemoveMemberModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsRemoveMemberModalOpen(false)}
        title="Remove Team Member"
        description="Are you sure you want to remove this member from the allocation?"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button 
              variant="outline" 
              onClick={() => setIsRemoveMemberModalOpen(false)}
              disabled={isRemovingMember}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button 
              variant="destructive" 
              onClick={handleRemoveMember}
              disabled={isRemovingMember}
            >
              {isRemovingMember ? 'Removing...' : 'Remove Member'}
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        {memberToRemove && (
          <div className="text-sm text-gray-500">
            <p>
              This will remove 
              <span className="font-semibold text-gray-700"> {memberToRemove.name} </span>
              from this allocation.
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </Modal>

      {/* Copy to Month Modal */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={isCopyModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsCopyModalOpen(false)}
        title="Copy Allocation to Another Month"
        description="Select a target month and year to copy this allocation to"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button 
              variant="outline" 
              onClick={() => setIsCopyModalOpen(false)}
              disabled={isCopying}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button 
              onClick={handleCopyToMonth}
              disabled={isCopying || !copyFormData.month || !copyFormData.year}
            >
              {isCopying ? 'Copying...' : 'Copy Allocation'}
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">

            <span className="font-semibold text-gray-700"> {monthName} {allocation.year} </span>

          </p>
          
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="month">Target Month</Label>
              <Select
                id="month"
                name="month"
                value={copyFormData.month}
                onChange={handleCopyFormChange}
              >
                <option value="">-- Select Month --</option>
                {months.map(month => (
                  <option 
                    key={month.value} 
                    value={month.value}
                    disabled={month.value === allocation.month && copyFormData.year === allocation.year}
                  >
                    {month.label}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </Select>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="year">Target Year</Label>
              <Select
                id="year"
                name="year"
                value={copyFormData.year}
                onChange={handleCopyFormChange}
              >
                <option value="">-- Select Year --</option>
                {[...Array(5)].map((_, i) => {
                  const year = (new Date().getFullYear() - 1 + i).toString();
                  return (
                    <option key={year} value={year}>
                      {year}
                    </option>
                  );
                })}
              </Select>
            </div>
          </div>
          
          {copyFormData.month && copyFormData.year && (
            <div className="mt-4">
              {(() => {
                const existingAllocation = getProjectAllocation(
                  allocation.projectId, 
                  copyFormData.month, 
                  copyFormData.year
                );
                
                if (existingAllocation) {
                  return (
                    <div className="bg-yellow-50 p-3 rounded-md text-sm text-yellow-700 flex items-start">
                      <FiCheck className="mt-0.5 mr-2 flex-shrink-0" />
                      <p>
                        An allocation already exists for 
                        <span className="font-semibold"> {
                          months.find(m => m.value === copyFormData.month)?.label
                        } {copyFormData.year}</span>.
                        The existing allocation will be updated with these team members and project manager.
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  );
                }
                
                return (
                  <div className="bg-green-50 p-3 rounded-md text-sm text-green-700 flex items-start">
                    <FiCheck className="mt-0.5 mr-2 flex-shrink-0" />
                    <p>
                      A new allocation will be created for 
                      <span className="font-semibold"> {
                        months.find(m => m.value === copyFormData.month)?.label
                      } {copyFormData.year}</span>.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                );
              })()}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/router';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { FiBarChart2, FiFileText, FiUser, FiUsers, FiCalendar, FiFilter, FiSearch, FiDownload, FiChevronDown, FiChevronRight, FiX } from 'react-icons/fi';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';

import { Card } from '../../components/Card';
import { Input } from '../../components/Input';
import { Select } from '../../components/Select';
import { Label } from '../../components/Label';
import { isSupabaseConfigured, supabase } from '../../lib/supabase-client';
import { getMonthsArray, getYearsArray } from '../../lib/utils';
import { isAuthenticated, getUser, isAdmin, isTeamLead, isProjectManager } from '../../lib/auth';

export async function getServerSideProps() {
  // Import database functions only on server-side
  const { 
    getEmployees, 
    getDepartments, 
    getForms, 
    getFormAssignments, 
    getFormResponses 
  } = require('../../lib/data');

  try {
    const [employees, departments, forms, assignments, responses] = await Promise.all([
      getEmployees(),
      getDepartments(),
      getForms(),
      getFormAssignments(),
      getFormResponses()
    ]);

    // Serialize dates for all data
    const serializedEmployees = employees.map(emp => ({
      ...emp,
      created_at: emp.created_at ? emp.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: emp.updated_at ? emp.updated_at.toISOString() : null
    }));

    const serializedDepartments = departments.map(dept => ({
      ...dept,
      created_at: dept.created_at ? dept.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: dept.updated_at ? dept.updated_at.toISOString() : null
    }));

    const serializedForms = forms.map(form => ({
      ...form,
      created_at: form.created_at ? form.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      updated_at: form.updated_at ? form.updated_at.toISOString() : null,
      published_at: form.published_at ? form.published_at.toISOString() : null
    }));

    // Form analytics
    const formAnalytics = forms.map(form => {
      const assigned = assignments.filter(a => a.form_id === form.id);
      const filled = responses.filter(r => r.form_id === form.id);
      return {
        form: serializedForms.find(f => f.id === form.id),
        assignedCount: assigned.length,
        filledCount: filled.length,
        assignedEmployees: assigned.map(a => serializedEmployees.find(e => e.id === a.employee_id)).filter(Boolean),
        filledEmployees: filled.map(r => serializedEmployees.find(e => e.id === r.employee_id)).filter(Boolean)
      };
    });

    return {
      props: {
        initialEmployees: serializedEmployees,
        initialDepartments: serializedDepartments,
        initialForms: serializedForms,
        initialFormAnalytics: formAnalytics
      }
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching reports data:', error);
    return {
      props: {
        initialEmployees: [],
        initialDepartments: [],
        initialForms: [],
        initialFormAnalytics: []
      }
    };
  }
}

export default function ScoreReports({ initialEmployees, initialDepartments, initialForms, initialFormAnalytics }) {
  const [reports, setReports] = useState([]);
  const [employees, setEmployees] = useState(initialEmployees);
  const [departments, setDepartments] = useState(initialDepartments);
  const [forms, setForms] = useState(initialForms);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [expandedItems, setExpandedItems] = useState({});
  const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] = useState(null);
  const [isAdminUser, setIsAdminUser] = useState(false);
  const [isTeamLeadUser, setIsTeamLeadUser] = useState(false);
  const [isPMUser, setIsPMUser] = useState(false);
  const [userTeamMembers, setUserTeamMembers] = useState([]);
  const [userProjectMembers, setUserProjectMembers] = useState([]);
  const [formAnalytics, setFormAnalytics] = useState(initialFormAnalytics);
  
  // Filters
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState({
    search: '',
    department: '',
    employee: '',
    form: '',
    month: '',
    year: new Date().getFullYear().toString(),
    status: ''
  });
  
  const router = useRouter();
  const months = getMonthsArray();
  const years = getYearsArray(2020, new Date().getFullYear());
  
  useEffect(() => {
    const user = getUser();
    setCurrentUser(user);
    setIsAdminUser(isAdmin());
    setIsTeamLeadUser(isTeamLead());
    setIsPMUser(isProjectManager());
    
    if (user && !isAdmin()) {
      filterEmployeesBasedOnRole(user);
    }
    
    // Generate some mock reports for demo
    generateMockReports();
  }, []);

  const filterEmployeesBasedOnRole = (user) => {
    if (isTeamLead()) {
      // For demo purposes, show all employees for team leads
      // In a real implementation, this would be filtered based on user's teams
    } else if (isProjectManager()) {
      // For demo purposes, show all employees for project managers
      // In a real implementation, this would be filtered based on user's projects
    } else {
      // Regular employees can only see themselves
      const userEmployee = employees.find(emp => emp.email === user.email);
      if (userEmployee) {
        setEmployees([userEmployee]);
      }
    }
  };

  const generateMockReports = () => {
    // Generate some mock report data for demonstration
    const mockReports = employees.slice(0, 5).map((emp, index) => ({
      id: `report-${index + 1}`,
      employee: emp,
      form: forms[index % forms.length] || { id: 'form-1', title: 'Performance Review' },
      score: Math.floor(Math.random() * 50) + 50, // Score between 50-100
      maxScore: 100,
      status: ['completed', 'pending', 'in_progress'][Math.floor(Math.random() * 3)],
      submittedAt: new Date(Date.now() - Math.random() * 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(),
      department: departments.find(d => d.id === emp.department_id) || { name: 'No Department' }
    }));
    
    setReports(mockReports);
  };

  const loadTeamMembersForTeamLead = () => {
    try {
      // Note: This would need to be implemented via API calls in a real implementation
      // For now, showing all employees for team leads
      console.log('Team lead member loading would be implemented via API');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error loading team members for team lead:', error);
    }
  };

  const loadTeamMembersForProjectManager = () => {
    try {
      // Note: This would need to be implemented via API calls in a real implementation
      // For now, showing all employees for project managers
      console.log('Project manager member loading would be implemented via API');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error loading team members for project manager:', error);
    }
  };
  
  const fetchReports = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    
    try {
      let reportData = [];
      
      if (isSupabaseConfigured()) {
        // Start building the query
        let query = supabase
          .from('employee_score_reports')
          .select('*');
        
        if (isAdmin()) {
          // Admin can see all reports, so no additional filtering needed
        } else if (isTeamLead() && userTeamMembers.length > 0) {
          // Team leads can see their own reports and their team members' reports
          const employeeIds = [currentUser.id, ...userTeamMembers.map(m => m.id)];
          query = query.in('employee_id', employeeIds);
        } else if (isProjectManager() && userProjectMembers.length > 0) {
          // Project managers can see their own reports and their project members' reports
          const employeeIds = [currentUser.id, ...userProjectMembers.map(m => m.id)];
          query = query.in('employee_id', employeeIds);
        } else {
          // Regular employees can only see their own reports
          query = query.eq('employee_id', currentUser.id);
        }
        
        // Apply other filters
        if (filters.department) {
          query = query.eq('department_id', filters.department);
        }
        
        if (filters.employee) {
          query = query.eq('employee_id', filters.employee);
        }
        
        if (filters.form) {
          query = query.eq('form_id', filters.form);
        }
        
        if (filters.month) {
          query = query.eq('submission_month', filters.month);
        }
        
        if (filters.year) {
          query = query.eq('submission_year', filters.year);
        }
        
        if (filters.status) {
          query = query.eq('status', filters.status);
        }
        
        // Execute the query
        const { data, error } = await query.order('submitted_at', { ascending: false });
        
        if (error) throw error;
        reportData = data;
      } else {
        // Mock data for demo
        reportData = generateMockReports();
        
        // Filter mock data
        reportData = reportData.filter(report => {
          // Apply role-based filtering
          if (isAdmin()) {
            // Admin can see all reports
            return true;
          } else if (isTeamLead() && userTeamMembers.length > 0) {
            // Team leads can see their own reports and their team members' reports
            const teamMemberIds = userTeamMembers.map(m => m.id);
            return report.employee_id === currentUser.id || teamMemberIds.includes(report.employee_id);
          } else if (isProjectManager() && userProjectMembers.length > 0) {
            // Project managers can see their own reports and their project members' reports
            const projectMemberIds = userProjectMembers.map(m => m.id);
            return report.employee_id === currentUser.id || projectMemberIds.includes(report.employee_id);
          } else {
            // Regular employees can only see their own reports
            return report.employee_id === currentUser.id;
          }
          
          // Apply other filters
          if (filters.department && report.department_id !== filters.department) return false;
          if (filters.employee && report.employee_id !== filters.employee) return false;
          if (filters.form && report.form_id !== filters.form) return false;
          if (filters.month && report.submission_month !== filters.month) return false;
          if (filters.year && report.submission_year !== filters.year) return false;
          if (filters.status && report.status !== filters.status) return false;
          
          return true;
        });
      }
      
      // Apply search filter
      if (filters.search) {
        const searchLower = filters.search.toLowerCase();
        reportData = reportData.filter(report => 
          (report.employee_name && report.employee_name.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower)) ||
          (report.form_title && report.form_title.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower)) ||
          (report.department_name && report.department_name.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower)) ||
          (report.user_email && report.user_email.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower))
        );
      }
      
      setReports(reportData);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching reports:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to load reports');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };
  
  const handleFilterChange = (name, value) => {
    setFilters(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: value }));
  };
  
  const clearFilters = () => {
    setFilters({
      search: '',
      department: '',
      employee: '',
      form: '',
      month: '',
      year: new Date().getFullYear().toString(),
      status: ''
    });
  };
  
  const toggleExpand = (id) => {
    setExpandedItems(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      [id]: !prev[id]
    }));
  };
  
  const handleExport = () => {
    toast.success('Reports exported successfully');
  };
  
  const getStatusBadgeClass = (status) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'completed':
        return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';
      case 'pending':
        return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800';
      case 'reviewed':
        return 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800';
      default:
        return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';
    }
  };
  
  const getScoreColorClass = (score, maxScore) => {
    if (!score || !maxScore) return 'text-gray-500';
    
    const percentage = (score / maxScore) * 100;
    
    if (percentage >= 80) return 'text-green-600';
    if (percentage >= 60) return 'text-blue-600';
    if (percentage >= 40) return 'text-yellow-600';
    return 'text-red-600';
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 fade-in">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">Score Reports</h1>
          <p className="text-gray-500">
            {isAdmin() ? 'View and analyze employee performance scores' : 
             isTeamLead() ? 'View your team\'s performance scores' :
             isProjectManager() ? 'View your project team\'s performance scores' :
             'View your performance scores'}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2">
          {isAdmin() && (
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              className="flex items-center"
              onClick={handleExport}
            >
              <FiDownload className="mr-2" />
              Export Reports
            </Button>
          )}
          {isAdmin() && (
            <Link href="/analytics">
              <a>
                <Button className="w-full sm:w-auto flex items-center justify-center">
                  <FiBarChart2 className="mr-2" />
                  View Analytics
                </Button>
              </a>
            </Link>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Filters */}
      <Card>
        <Card.Header>
          <Card.Title>Filter Reports</Card.Title>
        </Card.Header>
        <Card.Content className="space-y-4 p-6">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            {/* Search */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="search">Search</Label>
              <div className="relative">
                <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-gray-400">
                  <FiSearch />
                </div>
                <Input
                  id="search"
                  placeholder="Search by name, email..."
                  value={filters.search}
                  onChange={(e) => handleFilterChange('search', e.target.value)}
                  className="pl-10"
                />
                {filters.search && (
                  <button 
                    className="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 pr-3 flex items-center text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600"
                    onClick={() => handleFilterChange('search', '')}
                  >
                    <FiX size={16} />
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
            
            {/* Department Filter - Only show for admins and team leads */}
            {(isAdminUser || isTeamLeadUser) && (
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="department">Department</Label>
                <Select
                  id="department"
                  value={filters.department}
                  onChange={(e) => handleFilterChange('department', e.target.value)}
                >
                  <option value="">All Departments</option>
                  {departments.map(dept => (
                    <option key={dept.id} value={dept.id}>
                      {dept.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </Select>
              </div>
            )}
            
            {/* Employee Filter */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="employee">Employee</Label>
              <Select
                id="employee"
                value={filters.employee}
                onChange={(e) => handleFilterChange('employee', e.target.value)}
              >
                <option value="">All Employees</option>
                {employees.map(emp => (
                  <option key={emp.id} value={emp.id}>
                    {emp.name} {emp.id === currentUser?.id ? '(You)' : ''}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </Select>
            </div>
            
            {/* Form Filter */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="form">Form</Label>
              <Select
                id="form"
                value={filters.form}
                onChange={(e) => handleFilterChange('form', e.target.value)}
              >
                <option value="">All Forms</option>
                {forms.map(form => (
                  <option key={form.id} value={form.id}>
                    {form.title}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </Select>
            </div>
            
            {/* Month Filter */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="month">Month</Label>
              <Select
                id="month"
                value={filters.month}
                onChange={(e) => handleFilterChange('month', e.target.value)}
              >
                <option value="">All Months</option>
                {months.map(month => (
                  <option key={month.value} value={month.value}>
                    {month.label}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </Select>
            </div>
            
            {/* Year Filter */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="year">Year</Label>
              <Select
                id="year"
                value={filters.year}
                onChange={(e) => handleFilterChange('year', e.target.value)}
              >
                <option value="">All Years</option>
                {years.map(year => (
                  <option key={year.value} value={year.value}>
                    {year.label}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </Select>
            </div>
            
            {/* Status Filter */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="status">Status</Label>
              <Select
                id="status"
                value={filters.status}
                onChange={(e) => handleFilterChange('status', e.target.value)}
              >
                <option value="">All Statuses</option>
                <option value="pending">Pending</option>
                <option value="completed">Completed</option>
                <option value="reviewed">Reviewed</option>
              </Select>
            </div>
          </div>
          
          {/* Clear Filters Button */}
          <div className="flex justify-end mt-4">
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={clearFilters}
              className="text-gray-600"
            >
              Clear Filters
            </Button>
          </div>
        </Card.Content>
      </Card>

      {/* Reports List */}
      <Card>
        <Card.Header>
          <Card.Title>Results</Card.Title>
          <Card.Description>
            {reports.length} {reports.length === 1 ? 'report' : 'reports'} found
          </Card.Description>
        </Card.Header>
        
        {isLoading ? (
          <div className="flex justify-center items-center h-64">
            <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-t-2 border-b-2 border-primary-600"></div>
          </div>
        ) : reports.length === 0 ? (
          <Card.Content>
            <div className="text-center py-12">
              <FiFileText className="mx-auto h-12 w-12 text-gray-400 mb-4" />
              <h3 className="text-lg font-medium text-gray-900 mb-2">No reports found</h3>
              <p className="text-gray-500 max-w-md mx-auto mb-6">
                There are no score reports matching your current filters.

                variant="outline"

                    Score
                  </th>
                  <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                    Status
                  </th>
                  <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                    Actions
                  </th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-200">
                {reports.map((report) => (
                  <React.Fragment key={report.submission_id}>
                    <tr className={`hover:bg-gray-50 ${expandedItems[report.submission_id] ? 'bg-gray-50' : ''}`}>
                      <td className="px-6 py-4">
                        <div className="flex flex-col">
                          <div className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900">{report.form_title}</div>
                          <div className="text-sm text-gray-500">
                            {report.employee_name}
                            {report.employee_id === currentUser?.id ? ' (You)' : ''}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-xs text-gray-400">{report.user_email}</div>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      {(isAdminUser || isTeamLeadUser) && (
                        <td className="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap text-sm text-gray-500">
                          {report.department_name || 'N/A'}
                        </td>
                      )}
                      <td className="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                        <div className="text-sm text-gray-900">
                          {months.find(m => m.value === report.submission_month)?.label} {report.submission_year}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-xs text-gray-500">
                          {new Date(report.submitted_at).toLocaleDateString()}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                        {report.total_score ? (
                          <div className={`text-lg font-bold ${getScoreColorClass(report.total_score, report.max_possible_score)}`}>
                            {report.total_score}/{report.max_possible_score}
                            <div className="text-xs font-normal text-gray-500">

                            </div>

                            )}
                          </button>
                          <Link href={`/reports/view/${report.submission_id}`}>
                            <a className="text-primary-600 hover:text-primary-800">
                              View
                            </a>
                          </Link>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                    {expandedItems[report.submission_id] && (
                      <tr>
                        <td colSpan={(isAdminUser || isTeamLeadUser) ? 6 : 5} className="px-6 py-4 bg-gray-50">
                          <div className="text-sm">
                            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                              <div>
                                <h4 className="font-medium mb-2">Submission Details</h4>
                                <div className="space-y-2 text-gray-600">
                                  <div>
                                    <span className="font-medium text-gray-500">Submitted:</span>{' '}
                                    {new Date(report.submitted_at).toLocaleString()}
                                  </div>
                                  {report.reviewed_at && (
                                    <div>
                                      <span className="font-medium text-gray-500">Reviewed:</span>{' '}
                                      {new Date(report.reviewed_at).toLocaleString()}
                                    </div>
                                  )}
                                  <div>
                                    <span className="font-medium text-gray-500">Form:</span>{' '}
                                    {report.form_title}
                                  </div>
                                </div>
                              </div>
                              
                              <div>
                                <h4 className="font-medium mb-2">Performance Summary</h4>
                                <div className="h-2 bg-gray-200 rounded-full mb-2">
                                  <div 
                                    className="h-2 bg-primary-600 rounded-full" 
                                    style={{ width: `${(report.total_score / report.max_possible_score) * 100}%` }}
                                  ></div>
                                </div>
                                <div className="flex justify-between text-xs text-gray-600">
                                  <span>0%</span>
                                  <span>50%</span>
                                  <span>100%</span>
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                            
                            <div className="mt-4 flex justify-end">
                              <Link href={`/reports/view/${report.submission_id}`}>
                                <a>
                                  <Button size="sm">
                                    View Full Report
                                  </Button>
                                </a>
                              </Link>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    )}
                  </React.Fragment>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>

      {/* Form Analytics Section for Admin */}
      {isAdminUser && (
        <div className="mb-8">
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4">Form Analytics</h2>
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="min-w-full border text-sm">
              <thead>
                <tr className="bg-gray-100">
                  <th className="px-4 py-2 border">Form</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2 border">Filled</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2 border">Assigned</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2 border">Completion %</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {formAnalytics.map(a => (
                  <tr key={a.form.id}>
                    <td className="px-4 py-2 border">{a.form.title}</td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-2 border">{a.filledCount}</td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-2 border">{a.assignedCount}</td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-2 border">{a.assignedCount > 0 ? ((a.filledCount / a.assignedCount) * 100).toFixed(0) + '%' : 'N/A'}</td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export async function getServerSideProps(context) {
  // Import database functions only on server-side
  const { getEmployeeById, getDepartmentById } = require('../../../lib/data');
  const { id } = context.params;

  try {
    // For now, return empty props since this is a complex page
    // In a real implementation, you would fetch the report data here
    return {
      props: {
        reportId: id
      }
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching report data:', error);
    return {
      props: {
        reportId: id
      }
    };
  }
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/router';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { FiArrowLeft, FiEdit, FiDownload, FiUser, FiCalendar, FiFileText, FiCheckSquare, FiCheck, FiSave } from 'react-icons/fi';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { Button } from '../../../components/Button';
import { Card } from '../../../components/Card';
import { Input } from '../../../components/Input';
import { Select } from '../../../components/Select';
import { Label } from '../../../components/Label';
import { Avatar } from '../../../components/Avatar';
import { isSupabaseConfigured, supabase } from '../../../lib/supabase-client';
import { getMonthsArray } from '../../../lib/utils';
import { isAuthenticated, getUser, isAdmin, isTeamLead, isProjectManager, canViewReport } from '../../../lib/auth';

export default function ViewScoreReport({ reportId, user }) {
  const [report, setReport] = useState(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState(null);
  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState([]);
  const [categories, setCategories] = useState([]);
  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState([]);
  const [employee, setEmployee] = useState(null);
  const [department, setDepartment] = useState(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isReviewing, setIsReviewing] = useState(false);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] = useState(user);
  const [isAdminUser, setIsAdminUser] = useState(false);
  const [canEdit, setCanEdit] = useState(false);
  const [editMode, setEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [accessDenied, setAccessDenied] = useState(false);
  
  const router = useRouter();
  const months = getMonthsArray();
  
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!currentUser) {
      setCurrentUser(getUser());
    }
    setIsAdminUser(isAdmin());
    
    if (reportId) {
      fetchReportData();
    }
  }, [reportId, currentUser]);
  
  const fetchReportData = async () => {
    try {
      setIsLoading(true);
      
      if (isSupabaseConfigured()) {
        // Fetch report data from Supabase
        const { data: reportData, error: reportError } = await supabase
          .from('form_submissions')
          .select('*')
          .eq('id', reportId)
          .single();
        
        if (reportError) throw reportError;
        
        // Check if user has permission to view this report
        if (!canViewReport(reportData.employee_id)) {
          setAccessDenied(true);
          setIsLoading(false);
          return;
        }
        
        // Fetch form data
        const { data: formData, error: formError } = await supabase
          .from('score_forms')
          .select('*')
          .eq('id', reportData.form_id)
          .single();
        
        if (formError) throw formError;
        
        // Fetch questions
        const { data: questionsData, error: questionsError } = await supabase
          .from('form_questions')
          .select('*, score_categories(*)')
          .eq('form_id', reportData.form_id)
          .order('order_number');
        
        if (questionsError) throw questionsError;
        
        // Fetch answers
        const { data: answersData, error: answersError } = await supabase
          .from('submission_answers')
          .select('*')
          .eq('submission_id', reportId);
        
        if (answersError) throw answersError;
        
        // Fetch categories
        const { data: categoriesData, error: categoriesError } = await supabase
          .from('score_categories')
          .select('*')
          .eq('form_id', reportData.form_id);
        
        if (categoriesError) throw categoriesError;
        
        setReport(reportData);
        setForm(formData);
        setQuestions(questionsData);
        setCategories(categoriesData);
        setAnswers(answersData);
        
        // Determine if current user can edit this report
        setCanEdit(isAdmin() || (isTeamLead() && reportData.status !== 'reviewed'));
        
        // Fetch employee data via API
        if (reportData.employee_id) {
          try {
            const empResponse = await fetch(`/api/employees/${reportData.employee_id}`);
            if (empResponse.ok) {
              const employeeData = await empResponse.json();
              setEmployee(employeeData);
              
              if (employeeData && employeeData.departmentId) {
                const deptResponse = await fetch(`/api/departments/${employeeData.departmentId}`);
                if (deptResponse.ok) {
                  const departmentData = await deptResponse.json();
                  setDepartment(departmentData);
                }
              }
            }
          } catch (error) {
            console.error('Error fetching employee/department data:', error);
          }
        }
      } else {
        // Mock data for demo
        const mockReport = {
          id: reportId,
          form_id: 'form-1',
          user_email: 'john.doe@example.com',
          employee_id: 'emp-1',
          status: 'completed',
          submitted_at: '2023-05-15T10:30:00Z',
          reviewed_at: null,
          total_score: 85,
          max_possible_score: 100,
          submission_month: '05',
          submission_year: '2023'
        };
        
        // Check if user has permission to view this report
        if (!canViewReport(mockReport.employee_id)) {
          setAccessDenied(true);
          setIsLoading(false);
          return;
        }
        
        const mockForm = {
          id: 'form-1',
          title: 'Performance Review Q1',
          description: 'Quarterly performance evaluation form',
          status: 'published'
        };
        
        const mockCategories = [
          { 
            id: 'cat1', 
            form_id: 'form-1', 
            name: 'Technical Skills', 
            description: 'Assessment of technical abilities',
            weight: 3
          },
          {
            id: 'cat2',
            form_id: 'form-1',
            name: 'Communication',
            description: 'Assessment of communication effectiveness',
            weight: 2
          }
        ];
        
        const mockQuestions = [
          {
            id: 'q1',
            form_id: 'form-1',
            question_text: 'How would you rate your technical knowledge?',
            question_type: 'linear_scale',
            is_required: true,
            order_number: 0,
            category_id: 'cat1',
            max_score: 5,
            score_weight: 2,
            score_categories: mockCategories[0]
          },
          {
            id: 'q2',
            form_id: 'form-1',
            question_text: 'Rate your problem-solving abilities',
            question_type: 'linear_scale',
            is_required: true,
            order_number: 1,
            category_id: 'cat1',
            max_score: 5,
            score_weight: 2,
            score_categories: mockCategories[0]
          },
          {
            id: 'q3',
            form_id: 'form-1',
            question_text: 'How effectively do you communicate with team members?',
            question_type: 'linear_scale',
            is_required: true,
            order_number: 2,
            category_id: 'cat2',
            max_score: 5,
            score_weight: 1,
            score_categories: mockCategories[1]
          },
          {
            id: 'q4',
            form_id: 'form-1',
            question_text: 'What are your goals for the next quarter?',
            question_type: 'long_text',
            is_required: false,
            order_number: 3,
            category_id: null,
            max_score: 0,
            score_weight: 0,
            score_categories: null
          }
        ];
        
        const mockAnswers = [
          {
            id: 'ans1',
            submission_id: reportId,
            question_id: 'q1',
            answer_text: '4',
            score: 8,
            max_score: 10,
            comments: 'Good technical knowledge with room for improvement'
          },
          {
            id: 'ans2',
            submission_id: reportId,
            question_id: 'q2',
            answer_text: '5',
            score: 10,
            max_score: 10,
            comments: 'Excellent problem solving skills'
          },
          {
            id: 'ans3',
            submission_id: reportId,
            question_id: 'q3',
            answer_text: '4',
            score: 4,
            max_score: 5,
            comments: 'Good communicator'
          },
          {
            id: 'ans4',
            submission_id: reportId,
            question_id: 'q4',
            answer_text: 'I want to improve my React skills and contribute more to the project architecture.',
            score: null,
            max_score: null,
            comments: 'Good goals'
          }
        ];
        
        const employeeData = getEmployeeById('emp-1');
        const departmentData = employeeData?.departmentId ? getDepartmentById(employeeData.departmentId) : null;
        
        setReport(mockReport);
        setForm(mockForm);
        setQuestions(mockQuestions);
        setCategories(mockCategories);
        setAnswers(mockAnswers);
        setEmployee(employeeData);
        setDepartment(departmentData);
        
        // Determine if current user can edit this report
        setCanEdit(isAdmin() || (isTeamLead() && mockReport.status !== 'reviewed'));
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching report data:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to load report data');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };
  
  const handleScoreChange = (answerId, field, value) => {
    setAnswers(prev => 
      prev.map(ans => 
        ans.id === answerId 
          ? { ...ans, [field]: field === 'score' ? parseInt(value) || 0 : value } 
          : ans
      )
    );
  };
  
  const handleSaveReview = async () => {
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    
    try {
      if (isSupabaseConfigured()) {
        // Update answers
        const answerUpdates = answers.map(answer => ({
          id: answer.id,
          score: answer.score,
          comments: answer.comments
        }));
        
        const { error: answersError } = await supabase
          .from('submission_answers')
          .upsert(answerUpdates);
        
        if (answersError) throw answersError;
        
        // Calculate total score
        const totalScore = answers.reduce((sum, ans) => {
          return sum + (ans.score || 0);
        }, 0);
        
        const maxPossibleScore = answers.reduce((sum, ans) => {
          return sum + (ans.max_score || 0);
        }, 0);
        
        // Update report status
        const { error: reportError } = await supabase
          .from('form_submissions')
          .update({
            status: 'reviewed',
            reviewed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
            reviewed_by: currentUser?.id,
            total_score: totalScore,
            max_possible_score: maxPossibleScore
          })
          .eq('id', reportId);
        
        if (reportError) throw reportError;
      }
      
      toast.success('Review saved successfully');
      setReport(prev => ({
        ...prev,
        status: 'reviewed',
        reviewed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        reviewed_by: currentUser?.id,
        total_score: answers.reduce((sum, ans) => sum + (ans.score || 0), 0),
        max_possible_score: answers.reduce((sum, ans) => sum + (ans.max_score || 0), 0)
      }));
      setEditMode(false);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error saving review:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to save review');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };
  
  const getCategoryScores = () => {
    const categoryScores = {};
    
    // Initialize categories
    categories.forEach(cat => {
      categoryScores[cat.id] = {
        name: cat.name,
        score: 0,
        maxScore: 0,
        weight: cat.weight || 1
      };
    });
    
    // Calculate scores per category
    answers.forEach(answer => {
      const question = questions.find(q => q.id === answer.question_id);
      if (question && question.category_id && answer.score) {
        categoryScores[question.category_id].score += answer.score;
        categoryScores[question.category_id].maxScore += answer.max_score;
      }
    });
    
    return Object.values(categoryScores);
  };
  
  const getScoreColorClass = (score, maxScore) => {
    if (!score || !maxScore) return 'text-gray-500';
    
    const percentage = (score / maxScore) * 100;
    
    if (percentage >= 80) return 'text-green-600';
    if (percentage >= 60) return 'text-blue-600';
    if (percentage >= 40) return 'text-yellow-600';
    return 'text-red-600';
  };
  
  const getScoreText = (score, maxScore) => {
    if (!score || !maxScore) return 'Not Rated';
    
    const percentage = (score / maxScore) * 100;
    
    if (percentage >= 90) return 'Outstanding';
    if (percentage >= 80) return 'Excellent';
    if (percentage >= 70) return 'Very Good';
    if (percentage >= 60) return 'Good';
    if (percentage >= 50) return 'Satisfactory';
    if (percentage >= 40) return 'Needs Improvement';
    return 'Unsatisfactory';
  };
  
  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex justify-center items-center h-64">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-t-2 border-b-2 border-primary-600"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }
  
  if (accessDenied) {
    return (
      <div className="text-center py-12">
        <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold mb-2">Access Denied</h2>
        <p className="text-gray-500 mb-6">You don't have permission to view this report.</p>
        <Link href="/reports">
          <a>
            <Button>Return to Reports</Button>
          </a>
        </Link>
      </div>
    );
  }
  
  if (!report || !form) {
    return (
      <div className="text-center py-12">
        <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold mb-2">Report not found</h2>
        <p className="text-gray-500 mb-6">The report you're looking for doesn't exist or has been removed.</p>
        <Link href="/reports">
          <a>
            <Button>Return to Reports</Button>
          </a>
        </Link>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 fade-in pb-16">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => router.push('/reports')}
            className="mb-2"
          >
            <FiArrowLeft className="mr-2" />
            Back to Reports
          </Button>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">{form.title}</h1>
          <p className="text-gray-500">
            {months.find(m => m.value === report.submission_month)?.label} {report.submission_year} Assessment
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex space-x-2">
          {canEdit && !editMode && (
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              className="flex items-center"
              onClick={() => setEditMode(true)}
            >
              <FiEdit className="mr-2" />
              Edit Review
            </Button>
          )}
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            className="flex items-center"
            onClick={() => toast.success('Report downloaded successfully')}
          >
            <FiDownload className="mr-2" />
            Download
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Summary Card */}
      <Card>
        <div className="md:flex md:items-stretch">
          <div className="md:w-2/3 p-6">
            <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center mb-6">
              <div className="flex-shrink-0 mb-4 md:mb-0 md:mr-6">
                <Avatar 
                  fallback={employee?.name || report.user_email} 
                  size="xl" 
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h2 className="text-xl font-bold">
                  {employee?.name || 'Unknown Employee'}
                  {employee?.id === currentUser?.id ? ' (You)' : ''}
                </h2>
                <p className="text-gray-600">{employee?.designation || 'No Designation'}</p>
                <div className="flex items-center mt-1 text-gray-500 text-sm">
                  <FiUser className="mr-1" />
                  {report.user_email}
                </div>
                {department && (
                  <div className="mt-2">
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-blue-100 text-blue-800">
                      {department.name}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-sm text-gray-500">Submitted on</span>
                <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                  {new Date(report.submitted_at).toLocaleDateString()} 
                  {new Date(report.submitted_at).toLocaleTimeString()}
                </span>
              </div>
              {report.reviewed_at && (
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-sm text-gray-500">Reviewed on</span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                    {new Date(report.reviewed_at).toLocaleDateString()} 
                    {new Date(report.reviewed_at).toLocaleTimeString()}
                  </span>
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-sm text-gray-500">Status</span>
                <span className={`inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium ${
                  report.status === 'reviewed' ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-800' : 
                  report.status === 'completed' ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800' : 
                  'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800'
                }`}>
                  {report.status.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + report.status.slice(1)}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="bg-gray-50 md:w-1/3 p-6 flex flex-col justify-center border-t md:border-t-0 md:border-l border-gray-200">
            <div className="text-center">
              <h3 className="text-lg font-medium text-gray-900 mb-2">Overall Score</h3>
              {report.total_score ? (
                <>
                  <div className={`text-5xl font-bold mb-2 ${getScoreColorClass(report.total_score, report.max_possible_score)}`}>
                    {Math.round((report.total_score / report.max_possible_score) * 100)}%
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-lg font-medium mb-4">
                    {getScoreText(report.total_score, report.max_possible_score)}
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">
                    {report.total_score} out of {report.max_possible_score} points
                  </p>
                </>
              ) : (
                <p className="text-lg text-gray-400">Not yet scored</p>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Card>

      {/* Category Scores */}
      {report.total_score && categories.length > 0 && (
        <Card>
          <Card.Header>
            <Card.Title>Performance by Category</Card.Title>
          </Card.Header>
          <Card.Content>
            <div className="space-y-6">
              {getCategoryScores().map((category, index) => (
                <div key={index} className="space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                    <div>
                      <h3 className="font-medium">{category.name}</h3>
                      <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">Weight: {category.weight}x</p>
                    </div>
                    <div className={`text-xl font-bold ${getScoreColorClass(category.score, category.maxScore)}`}>
                      {category.maxScore > 0 ? Math.round((category.score / category.maxScore) * 100) : 0}%
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="w-full bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-2.5">
                    <div 
                      className="bg-primary-600 h-2.5 rounded-full" 
                      style={{ width: `${category.maxScore > 0 ? (category.score / category.maxScore) * 100 : 0}%` }}
                    ></div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </Card.Content>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* Responses and Scores */}
      <Card>
        <Card.Header>
          <Card.Title>Responses & Scores</Card.Title>
          {editMode ? (
            <Card.Description>Updating scores and feedback</Card.Description>
          ) : (
            <Card.Description>Detailed responses and evaluations</Card.Description>
          )}
        </Card.Header>
        <Card.Content>
          <div className="space-y-8">
            {questions.map((question, qIndex) => {
              const answer = answers.find(a => a.question_id === question.id);
              const category = question.score_categories;
              
              return (
                <div key={question.id} className={`pb-6 ${qIndex < questions.length - 1 ? 'border-b border-gray-200' : ''}`}>
                  <div className="mb-2 flex justify-between">
                    <div>
                      <h3 className="font-medium text-gray-900">{qIndex + 1}. {question.question_text}</h3>
                      {category && (
                        <span className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500">
                          Category: {category.name}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    {answer?.score && !editMode && (
                      <div className={`text-lg font-bold ${getScoreColorClass(answer.score, answer.max_score)}`}>
                        {answer.score}/{answer.max_score}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  
                  {/* Display the answer */}
                  <div className="bg-gray-50 p-3 rounded-md mb-4">
                    {question.question_type === 'long_text' ? (
                      <p className="text-gray-700 whitespace-pre-wrap">{answer?.answer_text || 'No response'}</p>
                    ) : question.question_type === 'multiple_choice' || question.question_type === 'checkbox' ? (
                      <p className="text-gray-700">{answer?.answer_text || 'No response'}</p>
                    ) : question.question_type === 'linear_scale' ? (
                      <div className="flex items-center">
                        <div className="w-full max-w-xs bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-2.5 mr-2">
                          <div 
                            className="bg-blue-600 h-2.5 rounded-full" 
                            style={{ width: `${answer?.answer_text ? (parseInt(answer.answer_text) / 5) * 100 : 0}%` }}
                          ></div>
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-gray-700 font-medium">{answer?.answer_text || '0'}/5</span>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <p className="text-gray-700">{answer?.answer_text || 'No response'}</p>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  
                  {/* Scoring section - visible to admins and team leads */}
                  {canEdit && question.max_score > 0 && (
                    <div className={`mt-4 ${editMode ? 'space-y-4' : ''}`}>
                      {editMode ? (
                        <>
                          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                            <div className="space-y-2">
                              <Label htmlFor={`score-${question.id}`}>Score (max: {answer?.max_score || question.max_score})</Label>
                              <Input
                                id={`score-${question.id}`}
                                type="number"
                                min="0"
                                max={answer?.max_score || question.max_score}
                                value={answer?.score || 0}
                                onChange={(e) => handleScoreChange(answer?.id, 'score', e.target.value)}
                                className="w-full"
                              />
                            </div>
                            
                            <div className="space-y-2">
                              <Label htmlFor={`comments-${question.id}`}>Feedback/Comments</Label>
                              <Input
                                id={`comments-${question.id}`}
                                value={answer?.comments || ''}
                                onChange={(e) => handleScoreChange(answer?.id, 'comments', e.target.value)}
                                placeholder="Provide feedback on this response"
                                className="w-full"
                              />
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </>
                      ) : answer?.score !== undefined && answer?.score !== null ? (
                        <div className="border-t border-gray-100 pt-4 mt-2">
                          <div className="flex justify-between items-start">
                            <div>
                              <h4 className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-500">Reviewer Feedback</h4>
                              <p className="text-gray-700 mt-1">{answer.comments || 'No comments provided'}</p>
                            </div>
                            <div className="bg-gray-100 px-3 py-2 rounded-md">
                              <div className="text-xs text-gray-500">Score</div>
                              <div className={`text-lg font-bold ${getScoreColorClass(answer.score, answer.max_score)}`}>
                                {answer.score}/{answer.max_score}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ) : null}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </Card.Content>
        
        {editMode && (
          <Card.Footer className="flex justify-end space-x-2 border-t pt-6">
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => setEditMode(false)}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              onClick={handleSaveReview}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              className="flex items-center"
            >
              <FiSave className="mr-2" />
              {isSubmitting ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Review'}
            </Button>
          </Card.Footer>
        )}
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
